app.post('/api/gemini/generate-script', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { slides, folderName } = req.body;
    if (!slides || !Array.isArray(slides)) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid slides payload' });
    }

    const ai = getAiClient();

    const prompt = `You are an expert Hollywood screenplay writer. 
Write a highly polished, professional, standard-format Screenplay Script based on this storyboard sequence titled "${folderName || 'My Storyboard'}".

The storyboard slides are:
${JSON.stringify(slides, null, 2)}

Format Instructions:
1. Write in standard professional screenplay format:
   - Scene Headings: e.g., "INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY" (All Caps, bold, spaced)
   - Action Descriptions: Normal descriptive text.
   - Character Names: ALL CAPS on their own line (e.g., "HERO") before their dialogue.
   - Dialogue: Spoken words, indented.
   - Parenthetical cues: e.g. "(nervously)"
2. Correlate and integrate the storyboard frames. For EACH slide, insert a clear marker tag in the script on its own line:
   "[Frame: Scene X, Shot Y]"
   where X is the scene number and Y is the shot number. Place this marker exactly at the beat where the slide's visual direction should occur.
3. Be descriptive, cinematic, and dramatic. Ensure the screenplay reads beautifully and maintains the exact visual details, action directions, and audio cues provided in the slides.
4. Output only the plain script content, no wrapping markdown blocks (like \`\`\`fountain or \`\`\`text) or conversational text.`;

    const response = await generateContentWithFallback(ai, {
      model: 'gemini-3.5-flash',
      contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
    });

    res.json({ script: response.text });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Gemini generate script error:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: formatGeminiError(err) });
  }
});

app.post('/api/gemini/extract-frames', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { scriptText } = req.body;
    if (!scriptText || typeof scriptText !== 'string') {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No script text provided' });
    }

    const ai = getAiClient();

    const prompt = `You are an expert film director and storyboard artist. 
Analyze the following screenplay script and break it down into a sequence of individual storyboard slides/frames.

Script:
${scriptText}

Extract up to 10 sequential cinematic frames from this script. For each frame, provide:
- sceneNo: number (the scene number from the script, starting at 1)
- shotNo: number (the sequential shot number within that scene, starting at 1)
- shotType: string (one of: 'WS', 'MS', 'CU', 'ECU', 'OTS', 'POV', 'INSERT', 'EST', 'TWO')
- duration: number (estimated screen duration in milliseconds, e.g. 3000 for 3 seconds)
- action: string (detailed camera direction, character movement, framing, or visual action)
- dialogue: string (the character dialogue or voiceover or crucial audio cue spoken in this shot)
- notes: string (notes about lighting, lens choice, emotional tone, or camera movement)

Output your response strictly as a JSON array of objects with the exact schema. Do not wrap the JSON in markdown code blocks like \`\`\`json. Output nothing else but the pure parsable JSON array.
Each object must have the fields: "sceneNo", "shotNo", "shotType", "duration", "action", "dialogue", "notes".`;

    const response = await generateContentWithFallback(ai, {
      model: 'gemini-3.5-flash',
      contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
      config: {
        responseMimeType: 'application/json'
      }
    });

    let cleanText = response.text || '';
    cleanText = cleanText.replace(/^```json\s*/i, '').replace(/```\s*$/, '').trim();

    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanText);
      res.json({ frames: parsed });
    } catch (parseErr) {
      console.error('Failed to parse JSON response from Gemini:', cleanText);
      res.status(500).json({ 
        error: 'Failed to parse extracted frames from AI response.', 
        rawResponse: cleanText 
      });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Gemini extract frames error:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: formatGeminiError(err) });
  }
});

// Secure server-side proxy for Custom OpenAI-Compatible endpoints
app.post('/api/custom-ai', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { baseUrl, apiKey, modelName, apiPath, messages } = req.body;

    if (!baseUrl) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing Base URL configuration for Custom AI provider.' });
    }

    let cleanBaseUrl = baseUrl.trim();
    if (cleanBaseUrl.endsWith('/')) {
      cleanBaseUrl = cleanBaseUrl.slice(0, -1);
    }
    
    let cleanApiPath = (apiPath || '/v1/chat/completions').trim();
    if (!cleanApiPath.startsWith('/')) {
      cleanApiPath = '/' + cleanApiPath;
    }

    const fullUrl = `${cleanBaseUrl}${cleanApiPath}`;

    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    };

    if (apiKey) {
      headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${apiKey.trim()}`;
    }

    const body = {
      model: modelName || 'gpt-4o-mini',
      messages: messages || [],
    };

    const response = await fetch(fullUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errorText = await response.text();
      return res.status(response.status).json({
        error: `Custom AI Provider returned error status ${response.status}: ${errorText}`
      });
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    res.json(data);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Custom AI Proxy Error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.message || 'Internal proxy server error processing Custom AI request.' });
  }
});

app.post('/api/gemini/bring-to-life', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prompt, imageBase64, mimeType, modelName = 'gemini-3.5-flash' } = req.body;
    const ai = getAiClient();
    const parts: any[] = [];

    if (imageBase64 && mimeType) {
      parts.push({
        inlineData: {
          data: imageBase64,
          mimeType: mimeType,
        },
      });
    }

    const systemPrompt = `You are a creative UI developer. Bring the user's idea to life by generating a COMPLETE, SELF-CONTAINED HTML5 file. 
    Include all necessary CSS within <style> tags and JavaScript within <script> tags. 
    You may use Tailwind CSS via CDN: <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>.
    Ensure the design is modern, responsive, and interactive. 
    Return ONLY the HTML code. Do not include any Markdown formatting like \`\`\`html.`;

    parts.push({ text: `${systemPrompt}\n\nUser Request: ${prompt}` });

    const finalModelName = normalizeModel(modelName);

    const response = await generateContentWithFallback(ai, {
        model: finalModelName,
        contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: parts }],
    });

    let html = response.text || "";
    html = html.replace(/```html/gi, '').replace(/```/gi, '').trim();
    
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.json({ html });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Bring To Life Error:', error);
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.status(error.message?.includes('API key') ? 401 : 500).json({ error: formatGeminiError(error) });
  }
});

app.post('/api/gemini/generate', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { contents, config, model = 'gemini-3.5-flash' } = req.body;
    const ai = getAiClient();
    const finalModel = normalizeModel(model);
    const response = await generateContentWithFallback(ai, {
        model: finalModel,
        contents,
        config,
    });
    
    const jsonResponse = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(response));
    try {
      jsonResponse.text = response.text;
    } catch (e) {
      const parts = response.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts;
      if (Array.isArray(parts)) {
        jsonResponse.text = parts.map((p: any) => p.text || '').join('');
      }
    }
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.json(jsonResponse);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Gemini Generate Error:', error);
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.status(error.message?.includes('API key') ? 401 : 500).json({ error: formatGeminiError(error) });
  }
});

app.post('/api/gemini/cache', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { model, contents, config, ttlSeconds } = req.body;
    const ai = getAiClient();
    const finalModel = normalizeModel(model);
    const cache = await callWithRetry(async () => {
        return await (ai.caches as any).create({
            model: finalModel,
            contents,
            config,
            ttlSeconds,
        });
    });
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.json(cache);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Gemini Cache Error:', error);
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.status(error.message?.includes('API key') ? 401 : 500).json({ error: formatGeminiError(error) });
  }
});

// Proxy for other Gemini calls to keep key safe
app.post('/api/gemini/proxy', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { method, params } = req.body;
    const ai = getAiClient();
    
    if (params && params.model) {
      params.model = normalizeModel(params.model);
    }
    
    let result;
    if (method === 'generateContent' || method === 'generateContentStream') {
      const resp = await generateContentWithFallback(ai, params);
      const jsonResp = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(resp));
      try {
        jsonResp.text = resp.text;
      } catch (e) {
        const parts = resp.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts;
        if (Array.isArray(parts)) {
          jsonResp.text = parts.map((p: any) => p.text || '').join('');
        }
      }
      result = jsonResp;
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported method: ${method}`);
    }

    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.json(result);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Gemini Proxy Error:', error);
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0');
    res.status(error.message?.includes('API key') ? 401 : 500).json({ error: formatGeminiError(error) });
  }
});

// Proxy for Crypto APIs
// Cache for Crypto API responses to handle rate limits
const cryptoCache: Record<string, { data: any, timestamp: number }> = {};
const CACHE_TTL = 60000; // 1 minute focus on fresh data
const STALE_TTL = 1800000; // 30 minutes for emergency stale data

const SERVER_FALLBACK_PRICES: Record<string, { usd: number, usd_24h_change: number }> = {
  bitcoin: { usd: 65420, usd_24h_change: 2.5 },
  ethereum: { usd: 3450, usd_24h_change: 1.8 },
  ripple: { usd: 0.62, usd_24h_change: -0.5 },
  solana: { usd: 145, usd_24h_change: 4.2 },
  cardano: { usd: 0.45, usd_24h_change: 0.2 },
  polkadot: { usd: 7.20, usd_24h_change: -1.2 },
  chainlink: { usd: 18.50, usd_24h_change: 3.1 },
  stellar: { usd: 0.12, usd_24h_change: -0.8 },
  'hedera-hashgraph': { usd: 0.08, usd_24h_change: 1.5 },
  sui: { usd: 1.15, usd_24h_change: 5.6 },
  'xdce-utility-token': { usd: 0.045, usd_24h_change: -1.0 },
  'avalanche-2': { usd: 35.80, usd_24h_change: 2.7 },
  'polygon-ecosystem-token': { usd: 0.68, usd_24h_change: -0.4 },
  near: { usd: 5.40, usd_24h_change: 3.8 },
  'crypto-com-chain': { usd: 0.12, usd_24h_change: 1.2 },
  'ondo-finance': { usd: 0.75, usd_24h_change: 2.5 },
  algorand: { usd: 0.18, usd_24h_change: -0.5 },
  vechain: { usd: 0.035, usd_24h_change: 0.8 },
  'research-coin': { usd: 0.42, usd_24h_change: 15.2 },
  astar: { usd: 0.08, usd_24h_change: -1.2 },
  'kata-exchange': { usd: 0.00045, usd_24h_change: 5.4 },
  'superior-coin': { usd: 0.0012, usd_24h_change: -2.1 },
};

// Keep track of active requests to prevent concurrent duplicate calls
const inFlightRequests: Record<string, Promise<any>> = {};

const fetchWithCache = async (cacheKey: string, fetcher: () => Promise<any>) => {
  const now = Date.now();
  const entry = cryptoCache[cacheKey];

  // Return fresh cache immediately
  if (entry && (now - entry.timestamp) < CACHE_TTL) {
    return { data: entry.data, source: 'cache' };
  }

  // If a request is already in progress, wait for it
  if (inFlightRequests[cacheKey]) {
    try {
      const data = await inFlightRequests[cacheKey];
      return { data, source: 'coalesced' };
    } catch (e) {
      // If the coalesced request failed, we might still have stale data
    }
  }

  // Fetch new data
  const request = (async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetcher();
      cryptoCache[cacheKey] = { data, timestamp: Date.now() };
      return data;
    } finally {
      delete inFlightRequests[cacheKey];
    }
  })();

  inFlightRequests[cacheKey] = request;

  try {
    const data = await request;
    return { data, source: 'live' };
  } catch (error: any) {
    // If live fetch fails (e.g. 429), fall back to stale cache if available
    if (entry && (now - entry.timestamp) < STALE_TTL) {
      console.warn(`Fetch for ${cacheKey} failed (${error.message}). Serving stale cache.`);
      return { data: entry.data, source: 'stale', warning: 'Upstream rate limit reached' };
    }
    throw error;
  }
};

app.get('/api/crypto/prices', async (req, res) => {
  const { ids } = req.query;
  const cacheKey = `prices_${ids}`;
  
  try {
    const result = await fetchWithCache(cacheKey, async () => {
      const url = `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=${ids}&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true&include_last_updated_at=true`;
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (!response.ok) {
        const text = await response.text();
        const err = new Error(`CoinGecko status: ${response.status} - ${text.substring(0, 100)}`);
        (err as any).status = response.status;
        throw err;
      }
      return await response.json();
    });
    res.json(result);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.log('[Crypto Prices] Serving resilient fallback values.');
    
    // Construct robust fallback data
    const idList = typeof ids === 'string' ? ids.split(',') : [];
    const fallbackData: Record<string, any> = {};
    const nowSecs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    
    idList.forEach(id => {
      const fixed = SERVER_FALLBACK_PRICES[id];
      if (fixed) {
        const variation = 1 + (Math.random() * 0.008 - 0.004); // subtle fluctuation
        const finalUsd = parseFloat((fixed.usd * variation).toFixed(fixed.usd < 1 ? 6 : 2));
        const finalChange = parseFloat((fixed.usd_24h_change + (Math.random() * 0.4 - 0.2)).toFixed(2));
        fallbackData[id] = {
          usd: finalUsd,
          usd_24h_change: finalChange,
          last_updated_at: nowSecs
        };
      } else {
        // Unknown / custom coin
        let hashSeed = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i++) hashSeed += id.charCodeAt(i);
        const randPrice = parseFloat((0.85 + (hashSeed % 150) * 0.08).toFixed(3));
        const randChange = parseFloat(((hashSeed % 20) - 10).toFixed(2));
        fallbackData[id] = {
          usd: randPrice,
          usd_24h_change: randChange,
          last_updated_at: nowSecs
        };
      }
    });

    res.json({
      data: fallbackData,
      source: 'fallback_mock',
      warning: 'Using resilient mock fallback due to rate limit/connection issue'
    });
  }
});

app.get('/api/crypto/coin-info', async (req, res) => {
  const { id } = req.query;
  if (!id) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing coin id' });
  }
  const cacheKey = `coin_info_${id}`;
  
  try {
    const result = await fetchWithCache(cacheKey, async () => {
      const url = `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/${id}?localization=false&tickers=false&market_data=true&community_data=false&developer_data=false&sparkline=false`;
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`CoinGecko status: ${response.status}`);
      }
      return await response.json();
    });
    const info = result.data;
    res.json({
      id: info.id,
      symbol: info.symbol?.toUpperCase(),
      name: info.name,
      icon: info.image?.small || info.image?.thumb || '',
      priceUsd: info.market_data?.current_price?.usd,
      change24h: info.market_data?.price_change_percentage_24h
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.log('[Crypto Info] Serving resilient fallback detail for:', id);
    // Guesses / procedurally generated fallback if coingecko rate limits or fails in live environment
    let hashSeed = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < (id as string).length; i++) hashSeed += (id as string).charCodeAt(i);
    const randPrice = parseFloat((0.85 + (hashSeed % 150) * 0.08).toFixed(3));
    const randChange = parseFloat(((hashSeed % 20) - 10).toFixed(2));
    const guessedName = (id as string).split('-').map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)).join(' ');
    const guessedSymbol = guessedName.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').substring(0, 4).toUpperCase();
    res.json({
      id,
      symbol: guessedSymbol || 'CUST',
      name: guessedName,
      icon: '',
      priceUsd: randPrice,
      change24h: randChange
    });
  }
});

app.get('/api/crypto/ohlc', async (req, res) => {
  const { id, days } = req.query;
  const cacheKey = `ohlc_${id}_${days}`;

  try {
    const result = await fetchWithCache(cacheKey, async () => {
      const url = `https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/${id}/ohlc?vs_currency=usd&days=${days}`;
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (!response.ok) {
        const text = await response.text();
        const err = new Error(`CoinGecko status: ${response.status} - ${text.substring(0, 100)}`);
        (err as any).status = response.status;
        throw err;
      }
      return await response.json();
    });
    res.json(result);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.log('[Crypto OHLC] Serving procedural fallback candles for:', id);
    
    // Create clean sequence of pseudo-random candles
    const numDays = parseInt(days as string) || 7;
    const now = Date.now();
    
    const basePrice = SERVER_FALLBACK_PRICES[id as string]?.usd || 1.25;
    const candlesList: any[] = [];
    
    let numCandles = 30;
    let stepMs = 24 * 3600 * 1000;
    
    if (numDays === 1) {
      numCandles = 24;
      stepMs = 3600 * 1000;
    } else if (numDays === 7) {
      numCandles = 28;
      stepMs = 6 * 3600 * 1000;
    } else {
      numCandles = Math.min(100, Math.max(30, numDays));
      stepMs = Math.round((numDays * 24 * 3600 * 1000) / numCandles);
    }
    
    let currentCandlePrice = basePrice;
    for (let i = 0; i < numCandles; i++) {
      const candleTime = now - i * stepMs;
      const changePercent = (Math.random() * 0.05 - 0.024); // -2.4% to +2.6%
      const nextCandlePrice = currentCandlePrice * (1 - changePercent);
      
      const open = nextCandlePrice;
      const close = currentCandlePrice;
      const high = Math.max(open, close) * (1 + Math.random() * 0.008);
      const low = Math.min(open, close) * (1 - Math.random() * 0.008);
      
      candlesList.unshift([candleTime, open, high, low, close]);
      currentCandlePrice = nextCandlePrice;
    }

    res.json({
      data: candlesList,
      source: 'fallback_procedural_candles',
      warning: 'Procedural chart rendered due to rate-limiting/error'
    });
  }
});

const getGeminiFallbackNews = async (symbol: string): Promise<any[]> => {
  if (!process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY) {
    console.warn('GEMINI_API_KEY not found in environment, skipping Gemini news fallback');
    return [];
  }
  try {
    const ai = getAiClient();
    const prompt = `Generate 5 realistic, professional financial/cryptocurrency/stock market news articles for the trading asset symbol "${symbol}". 
The news must be high-quality, timely, and analytical, similar to Reuters, Bloomberg, or CoinDesk.
Return the response as a JSON array of objects. Do NOT wrap it in any Markdown codeblocks or other text.
Each object in the array MUST have the following structure:
{
  "id": "string (unique random numerical id, e.g., '1023245')",
  "title": "string (engaging, professional headline)",
  "url": "string (realistic news source URL or '#')",
  "source_info": {
    "name": "string (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph)"
  },
  "published_on": number (current UNIX timestamp in seconds, slightly staggered, e.g. within the last 24 hours),
  "imageurl": "string (high-quality Unsplash image URL related to crypto/stocks/finance)",
  "body": "string (2-3 sentences of detailed, insightful news body/summary)"
}
Only output the raw JSON array of objects.`;

    const response = await generateContentWithFallback(ai, {
      model: 'gemini-3.5-flash',
      contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }],
      config: {
        responseMimeType: 'application/json'
      }
    });

    const text = response.text;
    if (text) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to generate fallback news with Gemini:', error);
  }
  return [];
};

    {
      title: `${cleanSymbol} Intraday Volatility Decreases as Liquidations Stabilize`,
      body: `Volatility metrics for ${cleanSymbol} cooled down during early trading sessions today. Deleveraging events have largely run their course, paving the way for structured support levels to establish.`,
      source: "CoinDesk Terminal"
    }
  ];

  return newsTemplates.map((tpl, idx) => ({
    id: `fallback_${cleanSymbol}_${idx}_${nowSecs}`,
    title: tpl.title,
    url: "#",
    source_info: { name: tpl.source },
    published_on: nowSecs - (idx * 7200) - Math.floor(Math.random() * 3600),
    imageurl: (cleanSymbol === 'EUR' || cleanSymbol === 'USD' || cleanSymbol === 'SEK' || cleanSymbol === 'GBP')
      ? "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1621416894569-0f39ed31d247?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"
      : ((cleanSymbol === 'BTC' || cleanSymbol === 'ETH' || cleanSymbol === 'SOL' || cleanSymbol === 'USDT')
        ? "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516245834210-c4c142787335?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"
        : "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1590283603385-17ffb3a7f29f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"),
    body: tpl.body
  }));
};

const getGoogleFinanceNews = async (symbol: string): Promise<any[]> => {
  try {
    const query = encodeURIComponent(`${symbol} finance stock market`);
    const url = `https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${query}&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en`;
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'
      }
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Google News RSS failed: status ${response.status}`);
    }
    const xml = await response.text();
    const itemMatches = xml.match(/<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/g);
    if (!itemMatches) {
      return [];
    }

    const newsItems: any[] = [];
    const nowSecs = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

    for (const itemXml of itemMatches.slice(0, 8)) {
      const titleMatch = itemXml.match(/<title>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/);
      const linkMatch = itemXml.match(/<link>([\s\S]*?)<\/link>/);
      const pubDateMatch = itemXml.match(/<pubDate>([\s\S]*?)<\/pubDate>/);
      const sourceMatch = itemXml.match(/<source[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/source>/);

      if (titleMatch) {
        let rawTitle = titleMatch[1].replace(/<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/g, '$1').trim();
        const link = linkMatch ? linkMatch[1].replace(/<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/g, '$1').trim() : '#';
        const pubDateStr = pubDateMatch ? pubDateMatch[1].trim() : '';
        let sourceName = sourceMatch ? sourceMatch[1].replace(/<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/g, '$1').trim() : 'Google Finance News';

        let title = rawTitle;
        if (title.includes(' - ')) {
          const parts = title.split(' - ');
          const potentialSource = parts[parts.length - 1];
          if (potentialSource.toLowerCase() === sourceName.toLowerCase() || sourceName === 'Google Finance News') {
            sourceName = potentialSource;
            title = parts.slice(0, parts.length - 1).join(' - ');
          }
        }

        title = title
          .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
          .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
          .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
          .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
          .replace(/&#39;/g, "'");

        let publishedOn = nowSecs;
        if (pubDateStr) {
          try {
            publishedOn = Math.floor(new Date(pubDateStr).getTime() / 1000);
          } catch (e) {
            // ignore
          }
        }

        const id = `google_news_${symbol}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
        const stockImages = [
          "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1611974789855-9c2a0a7236a3?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
          "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1590283603385-17ffb3a7f29f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
          "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1621416894569-0f39ed31d247?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
          "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1642543492481-44e81e3914a7?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80"
        ];
        const imageurl = stockImages[Math.floor(Math.random() * stockImages.length)];

        newsItems.push({
          id,
          title,
          url: link,
          source_info: {
            name: sourceName
          },
          published_on: publishedOn,
          imageurl,
          body: `Latest developments regarding ${symbol} market action. Reported by ${sourceName} via Google Finance Syndicate.`
        });
      }
    }
    return newsItems;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Google Finance News parser failed:', error);
    return [];
  }
};

app.get('/api/crypto/news', async (req, res) => {
  const symbol = String(req.query.symbol || 'BTC');
  const cacheKey = `news_${symbol}`;
  
  try {
    const apiKeySuffix = process.env.CRYPTOCOMPARE_API_KEY ? `&api_key=${process.env.CRYPTOCOMPARE_API_KEY}` : '';
    const url = `https://min-api.cryptocompare.com/data/v2/news/?lang=EN&categories=${symbol}${apiKeySuffix}`;
    const response = await fetch(url);
    
    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      if (data && data.Response !== 'Error' && Array.isArray(data.Data)) {
        cryptoCache[cacheKey] = { data, timestamp: Date.now() };
        return res.json({ data, source: 'live' });
      }
    }

    if (cryptoCache[cacheKey]) {
      return res.json({ data: cryptoCache[cacheKey].data, source: 'cache', warning: 'Upstream feed unavailable' });
    }

    // Instead of throwing an error, we log a status info line and try fallbacks directly.
    console.log(`[News Feed Info] Upstream feed status ${response.status}. Attempting fallbacks.`);
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.log(`[News Feed Info] Upstream connection issue: ${err.message || err}. Attempting fallbacks.`);
  }

  // Fallback chain:
  // 1. Google Finance RSS
  try {
    const googleNews = await getGoogleFinanceNews(symbol);
    if (googleNews && googleNews.length > 0) {
      const payload = { Data: googleNews };
      cryptoCache[cacheKey] = { data: payload, timestamp: Date.now() };
      return res.json({ data: payload, source: 'google_finance_fallback' });
    }
  } catch (googleNewsErr: any) {
    console.log('[News Feed Info] Google Finance news fallback did not yield results:', googleNewsErr.message || googleNewsErr);
  }

  // 2. Gemini fallback
  try {
    const geminiNews = await getGeminiFallbackNews(symbol);
    if (geminiNews && geminiNews.length > 0) {
      const payload = { Data: geminiNews };
      cryptoCache[cacheKey] = { data: payload, timestamp: Date.now() };
      return res.json({ data: payload, source: 'gemini_fallback' });
    }
  } catch (geminiErr: any) {
    console.log('[News Feed Info] Gemini news fallback did not yield results:', geminiErr.message || geminiErr);
  }

  // 3. Cache fallback
  if (cryptoCache[cacheKey]) {
    return res.json({ data: cryptoCache[cacheKey].data, source: 'cache', info: 'returned cached data' });
  }

  // 4. Programmatic high-fidelity news fallback
  const programmaticNews = getProgrammaticFallbackNews(symbol);
  const payload = { Data: programmaticNews };
  cryptoCache[cacheKey] = { data: payload, timestamp: Date.now() };
  return res.json({ data: payload, source: 'programmatic_fallback' });
});

// Vite Middleware for Dev / Static Files for Prod
async function setupVite() {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    const vite = await createViteServer({
      server: { middlewareMode: true },
      appType: 'spa',
    });
    app.use(vite.middlewares);
  } else {
    const distPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist');
    app.use(express.static(distPath));
    app.get('*all', (req, res) => {
      res.sendFile(path.join(distPath, 'index.html'));
    });
  }
}

setupVite().then(() => {
  const PORT = 3000;
  app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
    console.log(`Server running on http://0.0.0.0:${PORT}`);
  });
});

### --- START FILE: applet/components/ArtifactPreview.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';

interface ArtifactPreviewProps {
  code: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onMinimize?: () => void;
  onToggleFullWidth?: () => void;
  onSaveToSession?: (code: string, title: string) => void;
  onSaveToMIPrOMPT?: (title: string) => void;
  isFullWidth?: boolean;
  theme?: string;
}

const ArtifactPreview: React.FC<ArtifactPreviewProps> = ({ 
  code, 
  onClose, 
  onMinimize,
  onToggleFullWidth,
  onSaveToSession,
  onSaveToMIPrOMPT,
  isFullWidth,
  theme
}) => {
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [qrUrl, setQrUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isQrVisible, setIsQrVisible] = useState(false);

  // Read active CSS variables from DOM to match theme perfectly
  const [themeStyles, setThemeStyles] = useState({
    bgApp: '#121212',
    bgPanel: '#1a1a1a',
    bgCard: '#262626',
    bgInput: '#000000',
    border: '#333333',
    textMain: '#ffffff',
    textMuted: '#d4d4d8',
    textDim: '#71717a',
    isDark: true
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const computed = getComputedStyle(root);
    
    const readVar = (name: string, fallback: string) => {
      const val = computed.getPropertyValue(name).trim();
      return val || fallback;
    };

    const bgApp = readVar('--c-bg-app', '#121212');
    
    // Determine active theme
    let activeTheme = theme || localStorage.getItem('gemini_media_aggregator_theme') || 'dark';
    const isDark = activeTheme !== 'light' && activeTheme !== 'olive';

    setThemeStyles({
      bgApp,
      bgPanel: readVar('--c-bg-panel', isDark ? '#1a1a1a' : '#f8fafc'),
      bgCard: readVar('--c-bg-card', isDark ? '#262626' : '#f1f5f9'),
      bgInput: readVar('--c-bg-input', isDark ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'),
      border: readVar('--c-border', isDark ? '#333333' : '#e4e4e7'),
      textMain: readVar('--c-text-main', isDark ? '#ffffff' : '#0f172a'),
      textMuted: readVar('--c-text-muted', isDark ? '#d4d4d8' : '#3f3f46'),
      textDim: readVar('--c-text-dim', isDark ? '#71717a' : '#71717a'),
      isDark
    });
  }, [code, theme]);

  // Extract title for filename
  const title = useMemo(() => {
      // Try H1 first
      let match = code.match(/<h1[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h1>/i);
      if (match) return match[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();
      
      // Try H2
      match = code.match(/<h2[^>]*>(.*?)<\/h2>/i);
      if (match) return match[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();

      // Try Title tag
      match = code.match(/<title[^>]*>(.*?)<\/title>/i);
      if (match) return match[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();

      return 'artifact';
  }, [code]);

  // Extract audio base64 for download
  const audioBase64 = useMemo(() => {
      const match = code.match(/src="data:audio\/wav;base64,([^"]+)"/);
      return match ? match[1] : null;
  }, [code]);

  // Detect Map Coordinates for QR Code
  useEffect(() => {
      // Look for Leaflet setView([lat, lng]) or similar pattern
      const match = code.match(/setView\(\s*\[\s*(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*,\s*(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*\]/);
      if (match) {
          const lat = match[1];
          const lng = match[2];
          // Create Google Maps Universal Link
          setQrUrl(`https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${lat},${lng}`);
      } else {
          setQrUrl(null);
      }
      setIsQrVisible(false);
  }, [code]);

  // Inject Custom Styles to enforce absolute readability for the given theme
  const themedCode = useMemo(() => {
      const isPodcast = title === 'Podcast Script';
      
      // Build CSS to embed inside iframe
      const systemColorsOverride = `
        <style>
          /* Base Theme Styles */
          body, html { 
            background-color: ${themeStyles.bgApp} !important; 
            color: ${isPodcast ? '#4ade80' : themeStyles.textMain} !important; 
            font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; 
            margin: 0;
            padding: 8px; /* Extra padding for edge-to-edge readability */
            min-height: 100vh;
          }
          
          /* Forced podcast green or normal theme main color */
          h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { 
            color: ${isPodcast ? '#4ade80' : themeStyles.textMain} !important; 
            border-color: ${themeStyles.border} !important; 
          }
          
          p, li, span, div, td, th, article, section, main { 
            color: ${isPodcast ? '#4ade80' : themeStyles.textMuted} !important; 
          }
          
          strong, b { 
            color: ${isPodcast ? '#86efac' : themeStyles.textMain} !important; 
          }
          
          a { 
            color: ${isPodcast ? '#86efac' : '#3b82f6'} !important; 
            text-decoration: underline; 
          }
          
          /* Override light theme artifacts on dark elements & vice versa depending on active theme */
          ${!themeStyles.isDark ? `
            /* Remap dark tailwind background utility classes in light/olive mood to maintain high contrast */
            .bg-slate-900, .bg-slate-850, .bg-black, .bg-gray-900, .bg-neutral-900, .bg-slate-950, .bg-gray-950, .bg-\\[\\#121212\\], .bg-\\[\\#1a1a1a\\], .bg-\\[\\#1c1c1c\\], .bg-\\[\\#0c0c0c\\] {
              background-color: ${themeStyles.bgApp} !important;
              color: ${themeStyles.textMain} !important;
            }
            .bg-slate-800, .bg-gray-800, .bg-neutral-800, .bg-slate-700, .bg-gray-700 {
              background-color: ${themeStyles.bgCard} !important;
              color: ${themeStyles.textMain} !important;
              border-color: ${themeStyles.border} !important;
            }
            /* Remap high-contrast white texts to theme main text */
            .text-white, .text-slate-100, .text-slate-200, .text-slate-300, .text-gray-100, .text-gray-200, .text-gray-300, .text-zinc-100, .text-zinc-200, .text-zinc-300, .text-neutral-100, .text-neutral-200, .text-neutral-300 {
              color: ${themeStyles.textMain} !important;
            }
            .text-slate-400, .text-gray-400, .text-gray-500, .text-slate-500 {
              color: ${themeStyles.textMuted} !important;
            }
            .border-slate-800, .border-slate-700, .border-gray-800, .border-gray-700, .border-neutral-800, .border-neutral-700 {
              border-color: ${themeStyles.border} !important;
            }
          ` : `
            /* Remap light background classes in dark mode to dark background to protect eyes */
            .bg-white, .bg-slate-50, .bg-gray-50, .bg-slate-100, .bg-gray-100 {
              background-color: ${themeStyles.bgCard} !important;
              color: ${themeStyles.textMain} !important;
            }
            .text-gray-900, .text-slate-900, .text-black, .text-neutral-900 {
              color: ${themeStyles.textMain} !important;
            }
          `}
          
          /* Audio player overrides */
          div[style*="background: #1a1a1a"],
          div[style*="background-color: #1a1a1a"],
          div[style*="background: #f3f4f6"], 
          div[style*="background-color: #f3f4f6"] { 
            background-color: ${themeStyles.bgPanel} !important; 
            border-bottom: 1px solid ${themeStyles.border} !important;
            color: ${isPodcast ? '#4ade80' : themeStyles.textMain} !important;
          }
          
          ${isPodcast ? `h3[style*="color: #374151"] { color: #4ade80 !important; }` : ''}

          /* General Scrollbar Styling */
          ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: ${themeStyles.bgApp}; }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: ${themeStyles.border}; border-radius: 4px; }
          ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: ${themeStyles.textDim}; }

          /* Leaflet Map elements */
          ${!themeStyles.isDark ? '' : `
            .leaflet-tile { filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg); }
          `}
          .leaflet-container { background: ${themeStyles.bgApp} !important; }
        </style>
      `;

      let finalCode = code;
      
      // Auto-inject Tailwind CDN if missing to ensure utility classes run flawlessly
      if (!finalCode.includes('cdn.tailwindcss.com') && !finalCode.includes('tailwindcss')) {
          const tailwindCdn = '<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>';
          if (finalCode.includes('</head>')) {
              finalCode = finalCode.replace('</head>', `${tailwindCdn}</head>`);
          } else if (finalCode.includes('<head>')) {
              finalCode = finalCode.replace('<head>', `<head>${tailwindCdn}`);
          } else if (finalCode.includes('<body>')) {
              finalCode = finalCode.replace('<body>', `<head>${tailwindCdn}</head><body>`);
          } else {
              finalCode = `<head>${tailwindCdn}</head>` + finalCode;
          }
      }

      // Inject custom tailwind.config object inside iframe tailwind parser to map custom variable classes
      const tailwindConfig = `
        <script>
          if (window.tailwind) {
            tailwind.config = {
              theme: {
                extend: {
                  colors: {
                    app: {
                      bg: '${themeStyles.bgApp}',
                      panel: '${themeStyles.bgPanel}',
                      card: '${themeStyles.bgCard}',
                      input: '${themeStyles.bgInput}',
                      border: '${themeStyles.border}',
                      text: '${themeStyles.textMain}',
                      muted: '${themeStyles.textMuted}',
                      dim: '${themeStyles.textDim}',
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        </script>
      `;

      // Prepend/Inject into the iframe head
      const totalInjected = systemColorsOverride + tailwindConfig;
      if (finalCode.includes('</head>')) {
          return finalCode.replace('</head>', `${totalInjected}</head>`);
      } else if (finalCode.includes('<body>')) {
          return finalCode.replace('<body>', `<body>${totalInjected}`);
      }
      return totalInjected + finalCode;
  }, [code, title, themeStyles]);

  const handleDownloadHtml = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([code], { type: 'text/html' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${title.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase()}.html`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setIsMenuOpen(false);
  };

  const handleDownloadText = () => {
    // Create a temporary DOM element to strip HTML tags safely
    const tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
    tempDiv.innerHTML = code;
    
    // Remove scripts and styles
    const scripts = tempDiv.getElementsByTagName('script');
    while(scripts.length > 0) scripts[0].parentNode?.removeChild(scripts[0]);
    const styles = tempDiv.getElementsByTagName('style');
    while(styles.length > 0) styles[0].parentNode?.removeChild(styles[0]);
    
    const text = tempDiv.innerText || tempDiv.textContent || "";
    
    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${title.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase()}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    setIsMenuOpen(false);
  };

  const handleDownloadAudio = () => {
      if (!audioBase64) return;
      try {
          const byteCharacters = atob(audioBase64);
          const byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length);
          for (let i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
              byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i);
          }
          const byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers);
          const blob = new Blob([byteArray], { type: 'audio/wav' });
          
          let safeTitle = title.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase();
          if (!safeTitle || safeTitle.trim().length === 0) safeTitle = 'wav001';
          
          const filename = safeTitle.startsWith('wav001') ? 'wav001.wav' : `${safeTitle}.wav`; 

          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const a = document.createElement('a');
          a.href = url;
          a.download = filename;
          document.body.appendChild(a);
          a.click();
          document.body.removeChild(a);
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      } catch (e) {
          console.error("Failed to process audio for download", e);
          alert("Could not process audio data.");
      }
      setIsMenuOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg border-l border-app-border text-app-text relative transition-colors duration-300">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b border-app-border bg-app-panel transition-colors duration-300">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-400" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M12.316 3.051a1 1 0 01.633 1.265l-4 12a1 1 0 11-1.898-.632l4-12a1 1 0 011.265-.633zM5.707 6.293a1 1 0 010 1.414L3.414 10l2.293 2.293a1 1 0 11-1.414 1.414l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414l3-3a1 1 0 011.414 0zm8.586 0a1 1 0 011.414 0l3 3a1 1 0 010 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 11-1.414-1.414L16.586 10l-2.293-2.293a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
          </svg>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-app-text truncate max-w-[150px]">{title}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            
            {/* Send To Phone Button */}
            {qrUrl && (
                <div className="relative">
                    <button 
                        onClick={() => setIsQrVisible(!isQrVisible)} 
                        className={`p-1 rounded transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 ${isQrVisible ? 'bg-green-600 text-white' : 'text-green-500 hover:text-white hover:bg-app-card'}`}
                        title="Send to Phone"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                           <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M7 2a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h6a2 2 0 002-2V4a2 2 0 00-2-2H7zm3 14a1 1 0 100-2 1 1 0 000 2z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    {isQrVisible && (
                        <div className="absolute top-full right-0 mt-2 bg-white p-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 border-4 border-white flex flex-col items-center animate-fade-in w-48">
                            <img src={`https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=150x150&data=${encodeURIComponent(qrUrl)}`} alt="QR Code" className="w-full h-auto" />
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-800 font-bold mt-2 text-center uppercase tracking-wider">Scan to Open Map</p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            )}

            {onToggleFullWidth && (
              <button onClick={onToggleFullWidth} className="text-app-muted hover:text-app-text p-1 rounded hover:bg-app-card transition-colors" title={isFullWidth ? "Split View" : "Full Width"}>
                 {isFullWidth ? (
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path d="M5 3a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5zM5 11a2 2 0 00-2 2v2a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2v-2a2 2 0 00-2-2H5zM11 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V5zM14 11a1 1 0 011-1h1a1 1 0 110 2h-1a1 1 0 01-1-1z" /></svg>
                 ) : (
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 4a1 1 0 011-1h4a1 1 0 010 2H6.414l2.293 2.293a1 1 0 11-1.414 1.414L5 6.414V8a1 1 0 01-2 0V4zm9 1a1 1 0 010-2h4a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 01-2 0V6.414l-2.293 2.293a1 1 0 11-1.414-1.414L13.586 5H12zm-9 7a1 1 0 011 1v1.586l2.293-2.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L5.414 15H7a1 1 0 110 2H3a1 1 0 01-1-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1zm13-1a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 01-1 1h-4a1 1 0 110-2h1.586l-2.293-2.293a1 1 0 111.414-1.414L15 13.586V12a1 1 0 011-1z" clipRule="evenodd" /></svg>
                 )}
              </button>
            )}

            {onMinimize && (
                <button onClick={onMinimize} className="text-app-muted hover:text-app-text p-1 rounded hover:bg-app-card transition-colors" title="Minimize (Keep Audio Playing)">
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 10a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 110 2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
            )}

            <div className="relative">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setIsMenuOpen(!isMenuOpen)} 
                  className="text-app-muted hover:text-app-text p-1 rounded hover:bg-app-card transition-colors"
                  title="More Options"
                >
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path d="M10 6a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4zM10 12a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4zM10 18a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4z" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
                {isMenuOpen && (
                    <>
                        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={() => setIsMenuOpen(false)}></div>
                        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded shadow-xl z-50 w-48 overflow-hidden">
                            {onSaveToMIPrOMPT && (
                                <button 
                                    onClick={() => { onSaveToMIPrOMPT(title); setIsMenuOpen(false); }} 
                                    className="flex items-center w-full text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white gap-2 border-b border-app-border"
                                >
                                    <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 8h14M5 8a2 2 0 110-4h14a2 2 0 110 4M5 8v10a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V8m-9 4h4" />
                                    </svg>
                                    Save to mIPrOMPT
                                </button>
                            )}
                            {onSaveToSession && (
                                <button 
                                    onClick={() => { onSaveToSession(code, title); setIsMenuOpen(false); }} 
                                    className="flex items-center w-full text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs text-green-500 hover:bg-green-600/10 hover:text-green-400 gap-2 border-b border-app-border bg-transparent"
                                >
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                                        <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 17a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 110 2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1zM6.293 6.707a1 1 0 010-1.414l3-3a1 1 0 011.414 0l3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L11 5.414V13a1 1 0 11-2 0V5.414L7.707 6.707a1 1 0 01-1.414 0z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                                    </svg>
                                    Save to Session
                                </button>
                            )}
                            {audioBase64 && (
                                <button onClick={handleDownloadAudio} className="flex items-center w-full text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs text-app-text hover:bg-app-panel gap-2 border-b border-app-border bg-transparent">
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9.383 3.076A1 1 0 0110 4v12a1 1 0 01-1.707.707L4.586 13H2a1 1 0 01-1-1V8a1 1 0 011-1h2.586l3.707-3.707a1 1 0 011.09-.217zM14.657 2.929a1 1 0 011.414 0A9.972 9.972 0 0119 10a9.972 9.972 0 01-2.929 7.071 1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414A7.971 7.971 0 0017 10c0-2.21-.894-4.208-2.343-5.657a1 1 0 010-1.414zm-2.829 2.828a1 1 0 011.415 0A5.983 5.983 0 0115 10a5.984 5.984 0 01-1.757 4.243 1 1 0 01-1.415-1.415A3.984 3.984 0 0013 10a3.983 3.983 0 00-1.172-2.828 1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" /></svg>
                                    Download Audio
                                </button>
                            )}
                            <button onClick={handleDownloadHtml} className="flex items-center w-full text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs text-app-text hover:bg-app-panel gap-2 border-b border-app-border bg-transparent">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 17a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 110 2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1zm3.293-7.707a1 1 0 011.414 0L9 10.586V3a1 1 0 112 0v7.586l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" /></svg>
                                Download HTML
                            </button>
                            <button onClick={handleDownloadText} className="flex items-center w-full text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs text-app-text hover:bg-app-panel gap-2 bg-transparent">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4 4a2 2 0 012-2h4.586A2 2 0 0112 2.586L15.414 6A2 2 0 0116 7.414V16a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V4z" clipRule="evenodd" /></svg>
                                Download Text
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </>
                )}
            </div>

            <button onClick={onClose} className="text-app-muted hover:text-app-text p-1 rounded hover:bg-app-card transition-colors" title="Close">
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
              </svg>
            </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative bg-app-bg transition-colors duration-300">
        <iframe 
          title="Artifact Preview"
          srcDoc={themedCode}
          className="w-full h-full border-none"
          sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals allow-same-origin allow-downloads"

### --- START FILE: applet/components/AudioInput.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Upload, FileAudio, Loader2, Sparkles, AlertCircle, Play, Check, ChevronDown, HelpCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { transcribeAudio } from '../services/gemini';

interface AudioInputProps {
  onTranscript: (text: string) => void;
  className?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
}

export const AudioInput: React.FC<AudioInputProps> = ({ onTranscript, className = '', placeholder = 'Audio input...' }) => {
  const [isTranscribing, setIsTranscribing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isDropdownOpen, setIsDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSimulating, setIsSimulating] = useState(false);
  const [simulationPrompt, setSimulationPrompt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragActive, setDragActive] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Close dropdown on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleOutsideClick);
  }, []);

  // Standard Voice Command Presets for trading analysis and general aggregation tasks
  const voicePresets = [
    {
      title: "Stock Analysis Setup",
      description: "Analyze stock metrics, key risks and technical trends",
      transcript: "Provide a detailed stock analysis report for NVIDIA. Evaluate its current moving averages, volume trends, and identify the primary key risk factors for the coming quarter."
    },
    {
      title: "Crypto Trend Spotter",
      description: "Scan recent cryptocurrency movements & market structures",
      transcript: "Perform a dual-curve technical analysis on Bitcoin and Ethereum. Compare their relative volume index, daily pivot points, and identify the next critical support levels."
    },
    {
      title: "Forex Market Outlook",
      description: "Evaluate major currency pair correlations & forecast outlook",
      transcript: "Generate a currency outlook report for EUR/USD and GBP/USD based on recent macroeconomic news. Highlight current trading ranges and risk-reward ratios."
    },
    {
      title: "Summarize History",
      description: "Create a rapid summary of active logs & session sources",
      transcript: "Please compile and summarize all active documents, transcripts, and session files. Outline the main takeaways and structure them into bullet points."
    },
    {
      title: "Build Pod Cast Synopsis",
      description: "Draft an engaging podcast overview",
      transcript: "Create a robust podcast outline covering current trading indicators. Assign clear roles for the Host and Expert characters, focusing on a dynamic, informative dialogue."
    }
  ];

  // Drag and Drop handlers
  const handleDrag = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (e.type === "dragenter" || e.type === "dragover") {
      setDragActive(true);
    } else if (e.type === "dragleave") {
      setDragActive(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    setDragActive(false);

    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files[0]) {
      await processAudioFile(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
    }
  };

  // Convert and Transcribe Audio file
  const processAudioFile = async (file: File) => {
    const isAudio = file.type.startsWith('audio/') || 
                    /\.(mp3|wav|m4a|webm|ogg|aac|flac)$/i.test(file.name);
    if (!isAudio) {
      setError("Please select a valid audio file (e.g. MP3, WAV, M4A, WEBM)");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsTranscribing(true);
      setError(null);

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      reader.onloadend = async () => {
        try {
          const base64String = reader.result as string;
          const base64Data = base64String.split(',')[1];
          const transcript = await transcribeAudio(base64Data, file.type || 'audio/mpeg');
          
          if (transcript && transcript.trim().length > 0) {
            onTranscript(transcript);
            // Flash simulated confirmation
            setError(null);
          } else {
            setError("No spoken words could be extracted from this audio file. Please ensure there is clear vocal content.");
          }
        } catch (transcribeError: any) {
          console.error("Audio uploader transcription failed:", transcribeError);
          setError(transcribeError.message || "Failed to transcribe audio file.");
        } finally {
          setIsTranscribing(false);
          if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ''; // Reset input element
        }
      };
    } catch (fileReadError: any) {
      setError(`Failed to read the audio file: ${fileReadError.message}`);
      setIsTranscribing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleManualUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      await processAudioFile(file);
    }
  };

  // Simulate a highly styled vocal speech-to-text dictation
  const handleSimulateSpeech = (presetText: string, title: string) => {
    setError(null);
    setIsDropdownOpen(false);
    setIsSimulating(true);
    setSimulationPrompt(title);

    // Beautiful simulated progress mimicking human typing / soundwave recognition
    setTimeout(() => {
      onTranscript(presetText);
      setIsSimulating(false);
      setSimulationPrompt(null);
    }, 1800);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`relative flex items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`} ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* Primary Audio File drag-drop/uploader */}
      <div 
        onDragEnter={handleDrag}
        onDragOver={handleDrag}
        onDragLeave={handleDrag}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
        className={`relative flex items-center transition-all ${
          dragActive ? 'scale-105 border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10' : ''
        }`}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          disabled={isTranscribing || isSimulating}
          className={`p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center relative group ${
            isTranscribing
              ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30'
              : 'bg-zinc-900/60 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-800 hover:text-emerald-400 hover:bg-zinc-800/80 hover:border-emerald-500/40'
          }`}
          title="Direct Speech Transcriber: Click to upload or drag & drop a voice clip/audio file"
        >
          {isTranscribing ? (
            <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
          ) : (
            <FileAudio className="w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105 group-hover:text-emerald-400" />
          )}

          {/* Quick Upload Indicator Dot */}
          <span className="absolute -top-0.5 -right-0.5 flex h-2 w-2">
            <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-emerald-500"></span>
          </span>
        </button>

        {/* Hidden File Input */}
        <input
          type="file"
          ref={fileInputRef}
          onChange={handleManualUpload}
          accept="audio/*"
          className="hidden"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Speech Simulator and Preset Trigger */}
      <div className="relative">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIsDropdownOpen(!isDropdownOpen)}
          disabled={isTranscribing || isSimulating}
          className={`px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
            isSimulating
              ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/40 animate-pulse'
              : 'bg-zinc-900/60 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-800'
          }`}
          title="Bypass Mic blocks: Select speech command presets or simulated vocals"
        >
          <Sparkles className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 ${isSimulating ? 'animate-bounce' : ''}`} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Voice Presets</span>
          <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 transition-transform duration-200 ${isDropdownOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-zinc-200' : 'text-zinc-500'}`} />
        </button>

        {/* Gorgeous custom dropdown menu of audio commands */}
        {isDropdownOpen && (
          <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-72 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 p-2 overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200">
            <div className="px-3.5 py-2 border-b border-zinc-900 flex justify-between items-center bg-zinc-900/20">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Voice Simulation Presets</span>
              <span title="Bypasses physical mic errors completely while keeping accurate transcriptions">
                <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 cursor-help" />
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar mt-1.5 flex flex-col gap-1">
              {voicePresets.map((preset, index) => (
                <button
                  key={index}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSimulateSpeech(preset.transcript, preset.title)}
                  className="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-900 transition-colors group flex items-start gap-2"
                >
                  <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 mt-1 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110 group-hover:text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-200 group-hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors">
                      {preset.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 leading-normal group-hover:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                      {preset.description}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="p-2 border-t border-zinc-900 mt-1 bg-zinc-900/10 flex flex-col gap-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 text-center font-normal">
              <span>💡 Select any preset above to stream simulated voice command waveforms.</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Wave visuals activated during simulated dictation or processing */}
      {(isSimulating || isTranscribing) && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 h-4 px-2.5 bg-zinc-900/80 rounded-full border border-zinc-800/80">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-500 animate-pulse mr-1">
            {isSimulating ? `Vocal: ${simulationPrompt}...` : 'AI Transcribe...'}
          </span>
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => {
            const h = i === 1 || i === 5 ? 'h-1.5' : i === 2 || i === 4 ? 'h-2.5' : 'h-3.5';
            return (
              <span
                key={i}
                className={`w-0.5 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full animate-bounce ${h}`}
                style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 120}ms` }}
              ></span>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Sleek inline error tracker for full visibility if needed */}
      {error && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 p-3 bg-zinc-950 border border-red-500/40 rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-72 text-left z-50 flex flex-col gap-1.5 backdrop-blur-md">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-red-400">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Transcriber Notice</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-300">{error}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError(null)}
            className="text-[10px] text-center font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 bg-zinc-900 p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 transition-colors mt-1"
          >
            Dismiss
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
