### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/BRollSearcher.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Film, Search, Download, Check, Sparkles, Loader2, Play } from 'lucide-react';
import { themeStyles } from '../../constants/creativeStudioTheme';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';

interface BRollSearcherProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
  localTheme: string;
}

export const BRollSearcher: React.FC<BRollSearcherProps> = ({ onBack, localTheme }) => {
  const [script, setScript] = useState('');
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [bRollPrompts, setBRollPrompts] = useState<{ scene: string; prompt: string; keyword: string }[]>([]);
  const st = themeStyles[localTheme as keyof typeof themeStyles] || themeStyles.charcoal;

  const handleGeneratePrompts = async () => {
    if (!script.trim()) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const prompt = `Analyze the following video script and break it down into scenes. For each scene, provide a highly descriptive prompt that can be used in an AI video generator (like Sora or Runway) to create matching B-roll footage. Also provide a 1-3 word search keyword to find stock footage on sites like Pexels or Shutterstock.
      
Format the response EXACTLY as a JSON array of objects with the keys "scene" (brief description of the scene context), "prompt" (detailed visual description), and "keyword" (short search term).

Script:
${script}`;

      const response = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt);
      
      const jsonStr = response.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        setBRollPrompts(parsed);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert('Failed to generate B-roll prompts. Please ensure the response is valid JSON.');
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden animate-fade-in relative z-10 w-full">
      <div className={`p-4 sm:p-8 flex-1 overflow-y-auto ${st.bgApp}`}>
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-4 mb-8">
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${st.cardBg} border ${st.border}`}>
              <Film className={`w-6 h-6 ${st.text}`} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className={`text-2xl font-bold ${st.text}`}>B-Roll Searcher & Generator</h1>
              <p className={st.textDim}>Analyze scripts to dynamically generate prompts and search keywords for B-roll footage.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <label className={`block text-sm font-medium ${st.text}`}>Source Video Script</label>
              <textarea
                value={script}
                onChange={(e) => setScript(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Paste your video script here to extract B-roll scenes..."
                className={`w-full h-[400px] bg-black/40 border rounded-xl p-4 resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-opacity-50 ${st.border} ${st.text} ${st.focusRing}`}
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleGeneratePrompts}
                disabled={!script.trim() || isGenerating}
                className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 transition-all ${isGenerating || !script.trim() ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : st.btnActive}`}
              >
                {isGenerating ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />}
                <span>{isGenerating ? 'Analyzing Script...' : 'Generate B-Roll Prompts'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              <label className={`block text-sm font-medium ${st.text}`}>Generated Footage Requirements</label>
              <div className={`w-full h-[460px] bg-black/40 border rounded-xl p-4 overflow-y-auto ${st.border} custom-scrollbar`}>
                {bRollPrompts.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className={`h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${st.textDim} text-center p-8`}>
                    <Search className="w-12 h-12 mb-4 opacity-20" />
                    <p>Generated prompts and search keywords will appear here once the script is analyzed.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    {bRollPrompts.map((item, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className={`p-4 rounded-xl border ${st.cardBg} ${st.border}`}>
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                          <h4 className={`font-semibold ${st.text}`}>Scene {idx + 1}: {item.scene}</h4>
                          <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-md bg-black/30 ${st.textDim} border ${st.border}`}>
                            {item.keyword}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className={`text-sm mb-3 ${st.textDim}`}>{item.prompt}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                           <button 
                             onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(item.prompt)}
                             className={`text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border flex items-center space-x-1 hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors ${st.border} ${st.text}`}
                           >
                             <CopyIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                             <span>Copy Prompt</span>
                           </button>
                           <a 
                             href={`https://www.pexels.com/search/videos/${encodeURIComponent(item.keyword)}/`}
                             target="_blank"
                             rel="noopener noreferrer"
                             className={`text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border flex items-center space-x-1 hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors ${st.border} ${st.text}`}
                           >
                             <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                             <span>Search Footage</span>
                           </a>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const CopyIcon = ({ className }: { className?: string }) => (
  <svg className={className} fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 16H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h8a2 2 0 012 2v2m-6 12h8a2 2 0 002-2v-8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-8a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
  </svg>
);

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/Brainstormer.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Lightbulb, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, Send, Sparkles, AlertCircle, Shuffle, Flame } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface BrainstormerProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface IdeaItem {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  concept: string;
  angle: string;
  viability: string; // "Wild", "Moderate", "Crazy But Genius"
}

export const Brainstormer: React.FC<BrainstormerProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [brainstormAngle, setBrainstormAngle] = useState('Silicon Valley Disruption');
  const [customVibe, setCustomVibe] = useState('');
  const [ideaDivergence, setIdeaDivergence] = useState<'high' | 'ultra-wild' | 'grounded'>('high');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [ideas, setIdeas] = useState<IdeaItem[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setIdeas([]);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an elite Innovation Consultant, Creative Director, and Futurist. 
Based on the provided ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'}, brainstorm 10 highly unconventional, "wild," and creative ideas or perspectives. 


USER SPECIFICATIONS:
- Creative Angle: ${brainstormAngle}
- Additional Vibe/Focus: ${customVibe || 'Surprise me with highly futuristic or lateral thinking.'}
- Divergence Intensity: ${ideaDivergence === 'ultra-wild' ? 'Unconstrained Sci-Fi & Lateral Leaps (Divergence level 10/10)' : ideaDivergence === 'high' ? 'High Creativity & Disruptive (Divergence level 8/10)' : 'Creative but Grounded (Divergence level 5/10)'}
- Source Context Active: ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'Yes' : 'No'}

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the ideas as a structured JSON array wrapped inside a codeblock. Each idea in the array must match this strict typescript structure:
interface IdeaItem {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  concept: string; // 2-3 sentences explaining the idea
  angle: string; // The specific lateral perspective used
  viability: string; // Choose one: "Wild", "Moderate", "Crazy But Genius"
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\[([\s\S]*?)\]/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (Array.isArray(parsedData)) {
        setIdeas(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed data was not a valid array.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to formulate wild ideas in a structured format. This can happen if the AI gets too creative. Please try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyIdea = (idea: IdeaItem) => {
    const text = `**Idea ${idea.id}: ${idea.title}**\n*Angle: ${idea.angle} [Viability: ${idea.viability}]*\nConcept: ${idea.concept}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedId(idea.id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownloadAll = () => {
    if (ideas.length === 0) return;
    
    let mdText = `# 💡 Creative Brainstorming Session\n\n`;
    mdText += `Generated on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()} // Angle: ${brainstormAngle}\n\n`;
    mdText += `---\n\n`;

    ideas.forEach(idea => {
      mdText += `## ${idea.id}. ${idea.title}\n`;
      mdText += `* **Perspective/Angle**: ${idea.angle}\n`;
      mdText += `* **Viability Rating**: ${idea.viability}\n\n`;
      mdText += `${idea.concept}\n\n`;
      mdText += `---\n\n`;
    });

    const blob = new Blob([mdText], { type: 'text/markdown' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `creative-ideas-${Date.now()}.md`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (ideas.length === 0 || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Creative Brainstorming Ideas</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 2rem; }
        .idea-card { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; transition: transform 0.2s; }
        .idea-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #f97316; }
        h1 { font-size: 2rem; color: #f97316; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 2px solid #ea580c; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; }
        .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <h1>💡 Creative Brainstorming: ${brainstormAngle}</h1>
        <p class="text-gray-400 mb-6">Unconventional perspectives and disruptive concepts generated from source media assets.</p>
        
        <div class="space-y-4">
            ${ideas.map(idea => `
            <div class="idea-card">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-orange-400">${idea.id}. ${idea.title}</h2>
                    <span class="badge ${
                      idea.viability === 'Crazy But Genius' 
                        ? 'bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-400 border border-purple-800' 
                        : idea.viability === 'Wild' 
                          ? 'bg-orange-900/40 text-orange-400 border border-orange-800' 
                          : 'bg-green-900/40 text-green-400 border border-green-800'
                    }">${idea.viability}</span>
                </div>
                <p class="text-sm font-mono text-gray-500 mb-2">Perspective: ${idea.angle}</p>
                <p class="text-gray-300 leading-relaxed">${idea.concept}</p>
            </div>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));
    
    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Brainstorm: ${brainstormAngle}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-orange-400">
            <Lightbulb className="w-6 h-6" /> Creative Brainstorm
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Generate 10 divergent, wild ideas and unconventional strategic perspectives based on your media files.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {ideas.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownloadAll}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download Markdown
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-orange-600/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30 hover:bg-orange-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save Ideas'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">
        
        {/* Left control board */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" /> Brainstorm Config
            </h3>

            {/* Context reference status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-orange-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected. Creative session will generate generic ideas.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Brainstorming Lens */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Lateral Thinking Lens</label>
              <select
                value={brainstormAngle}
                onChange={(e) => setBrainstormAngle(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500"
              >
                <option value="Silicon Valley Disruption">⚡ Silicon Valley Disruption (SaaS / Platforms)</option>
                <option value="Sci-Fi Future 2050">🪐 Sci-Fi Future (Neurotech, Ambient compute, AI overlords)</option>
                <option value="Extreme Minimalist / Retro-grade">📟 Retro / Low-Tech / Ultra-simple analog</option>
                <option value="Eco-Sustain & Solarpunk">🌱 Solarpunk & Regenerative Green-Tech</option>
                <option value="Reverse Psychology / Anti-Idea">🎭 Reverse Logic (What would fail spectacularly?)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Intensity */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Divergence Level</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 bg-app-bg p-1 rounded border border-app-border">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIdeaDivergence('grounded')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${
                    ideaDivergence === 'grounded'
                      ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white shadow'
                      : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  Grounded
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIdeaDivergence('high')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${
                    ideaDivergence === 'high'
                      ? 'bg-orange-600 text-white shadow'
                      : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  High
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIdeaDivergence('ultra-wild')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 ${
                    ideaDivergence === 'ultra-wild'
                      ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white shadow animate-pulse'
                      : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Flame className="w-3 h-3 text-yellow-300" /> Wild
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Custom vibe input */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Custom Context / Angle (Optional)</label>
              <textarea
                value={customVibe}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomVibe(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="e.g. Focus on physical-world gadgets, or gamification mechanics..."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Submit */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 disabled:bg-orange-850/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Cultivating Lateral Ideas...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Shuffle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Brainstorm Ideas
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right sandbox panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-orange-500/20 border-t-orange-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Extracting Divergent Ideas...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Parsing structures and creating high-divergence conceptual leaps based on your provided context.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && !isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Generation Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !error && ideas.length === 0 && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <Lightbulb className="w-12 h-12 text-orange-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Creative Output Board</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Select your brainstorming focus on the left and trigger compilation to see 10 unique lateral perspectives.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && ideas.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[70vh] space-y-4 pr-1">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {ideas.map((idea) => (
                  <div
                    key={idea.id}
                    className="p-5 bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:border-orange-500/45 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between transition-all group"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-app-text group-hover:text-orange-400 transition-colors">
                          {idea.id}. {idea.title}
                        </h4>
                        <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold shrink-0 ${
                          idea.viability === 'Crazy But Genius'
                            ? 'bg-purple-950/40 text-purple-400 border border-purple-900/30'
                            : idea.viability === 'Wild'
                              ? 'bg-orange-950/40 text-orange-400 border border-orange-900/30'
                              : 'bg-green-950/40 text-green-400 border border-green-900/30'
                        }`}>
                          {idea.viability}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-app-dim leading-relaxed mb-4">
                        {idea.concept}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-app-border/40 pt-3 text-[10px]">
                      <span className="text-app-dim italic font-mono truncate max-w-[150px]" title={idea.angle}>
                        Lens: {idea.angle}
                      </span>
                      
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleCopyIdea(idea)}
                        className="text-orange-400 hover:text-orange-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                      >
                        {copiedId === idea.id ? (
                          <>
                            <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-green-400" /> Copied!
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Copy className="w-3 h-3" /> Copy Idea
                          </>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/CodeExplainer.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Code, Cpu, ShieldCheck, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface CodeExplainerProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface ExplainerResult {
  summary: string;
  walkthrough: { block: string; explanation: string }[];
  complexity: { time: string; space: string; explanation: string };
  bugsAndOptimizations: string[];
}

export const CodeExplainer: React.FC<CodeExplainerProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [codeSnippet, setCodeSnippet] = useState('');
  const [targetAudience, setTargetAudience] = useState('Junior Developer');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ExplainerResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    if (!codeSnippet.trim()) {
      setError("Please paste a code snippet first.");
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an expert Software Engineer, Tech Lead, and Master Computer Science Educator.
Break down the provided code snippet into simple, easy-to-understand explanations customized for a ${targetAudience}.${selectedItems.length > 0 ? '\nRefer to the active session files for any domain logic, context, libraries, or architectural specifications.' : ''}

CODE SNIPPET:
\`\`\`
${codeSnippet}
\`\`\`

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the explanation as a structured JSON object wrapped inside a codeblock.
The object must follow this strict TypeScript structure:
{
  "summary": "High-level summary (1-2 sentences) of what the code is aiming to solve, tailored for ${targetAudience}.",
  "walkthrough": [
    {
      "block": "Line or structural block of code",
      "explanation": "Clear explanation of what this block does, using appropriate terminology matching the audience level."
    }
  ],
  "complexity": {
    "time": "O(N) or O(1) or O(N log N) etc.",
    "space": "O(1) or O(N) etc.",
    "explanation": "Brief context explaining why this is the case."
  },
  "bugsAndOptimizations": [
    "Potential optimization, edge-case vulnerability, or standard practice recommendation 1",
    "Potential optimization or recommendation 2"
  ]
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (parsedData && parsedData.summary && parsedData.walkthrough) {
        setResult(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed data was not structured correctly.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to compile code explanation. Make sure the code is valid syntax and try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!result) return;

    let text = `=========================================\n`;
    text += `CODE EXPLANATION FOR: ${targetAudience}\n`;
    text += `=========================================\n\n`;

    text += `### SUMMARY:\n${result.summary}\n\n`;

    text += `### CODE WALKTHROUGH:\n`;
    result.walkthrough.forEach((wt, idx) => {
      text += `--- BLOCK ${idx + 1} ---\n`;
      text += `${wt.block}\n`;
      text += `Explanation: ${wt.explanation}\n\n`;
    });

    text += `### COMPLEXITY ANALYTICS:\n`;
    text += `- Time Complexity: ${result.complexity.time}\n`;
    text += `- Space Complexity: ${result.complexity.space}\n`;
    text += `Context: ${result.complexity.explanation}\n\n`;

    text += `### SEC-AUDIT / REFACTOR RECOMMENDATIONS:\n`;
    result.bugsAndOptimizations.forEach(rec => {
      text += `- ${rec}\n`;
    });

    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `code-explanation-${targetAudience.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-${Date.now()}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!result || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Code Analysis Report</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 2rem; }
        .block-card { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
        code { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; background: #030712; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 4px; color: #a3e635; }
        pre code { display: block; padding: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; color: #f3f4f6; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <h1 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-lime-400 mb-2">⚡ Code Analysis & Walkthrough</h1>
        <p class="text-gray-400 mb-6">Configured Audience: <strong>${targetAudience}</strong></p>

        <div class="block-card">
            <h3 class="text-lime-400 font-bold mb-2">Overview</h3>
            <p class="text-gray-300 leading-relaxed text-sm">${result.summary}</p>
        </div>

        <div class="block-card">
            <h3 class="text-lime-400 font-bold mb-4">Step-by-Step Structural Breakdown</h3>
            <div class="space-y-4">
                ${result.walkthrough.map((wt, idx) => `
                <div class="p-4 bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800 rounded-lg">
                    <pre><code class="text-xs">${wt.block}</code></pre>
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-300 mt-2.5 leading-relaxed">${wt.explanation}</p>
                </div>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8">
            <div class="block-card mb-0">
                <h3 class="text-lime-400 font-bold mb-2">Time Complexity</h3>
                <span class="text-2xl font-mono text-white">${result.complexity.time}</span>
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2">${result.complexity.explanation}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="block-card mb-0">
                <h3 class="text-lime-400 font-bold mb-2">Space Complexity</h3>
                <span class="text-2xl font-mono text-white">${result.complexity.space}</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="block-card">
            <h3 class="text-lime-400 font-bold mb-3">Refactorings, Edge-Cases & Optimizations</h3>
            <ul class="space-y-1.5 text-sm list-disc pl-5 text-gray-300">
                ${result.bugsAndOptimizations.map(rec => `<li>${rec}</li>`).join('')}
            </ul>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Explanation: ${targetAudience}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-lime-400">
            <Code className="w-6 h-6" /> Code Explainer
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Deconstruct complex algorithms or application blocks into simple, readable explanations tailored for stakeholders or juniors.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {result && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download Analysis
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-lime-600/20 text-lime-400 border border-lime-500/30 hover:bg-lime-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save Report'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">

        {/* Input Column (Left) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 flex flex-col">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Code className="w-4 h-4 text-lime-400" /> Monospace Input Editor
            </h3>

            {/* Knowledge base status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-lime-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-lime-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Referencing' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected file(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected. Analysis will run purely on pasted snippet.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Target Audience */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Target Explanation Level</label>
              <select
                value={targetAudience}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetAudience(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-lime-500"
              >
                <option value="5-Year-Old (ELI5)">👶 ELI5 (Explain Like I'm 5)</option>
                <option value="Non-technical Business Stakeholder">👔 Business Stakeholder / Product Manager (No developer jargon)</option>
                <option value="Junior Developer">🌱 Junior Developer (Learn syntax, patterns & practices)</option>
                <option value="Security / Compliance Auditor">🔒 Security Auditor (Edge cases, buffer overflows, PII risks)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Code Text Area */}

              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Paste Code Snippet</label>
              <textarea
                value={codeSnippet}

              />

            {/* Action CTA */}
            <button

                  Deconstructing Code Snippet...

                  Explain Code Snippet
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Breakdown Output (Right) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-lime-500/20 border-t-lime-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <Code className="w-5 h-5 text-lime-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Generating Walkthrough...</p>

          )}

          {error && !isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Analysis Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !error && !result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <Code className="w-12 h-12 text-lime-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Interactive Deconstruction Desk</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Enter your codebase block on the left and select an explanation audience profile to begin analysis.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && result && (
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[70vh] pr-1">
              
              {/* Summary Card */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-lime-400 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" /> Strategic Core Objective
                </h4>
                <p className="text-sm text-app-text leading-relaxed">{result.summary}</p>
              </div>

              {/* Step by Step walkthrough */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-lime-400 pl-1">Structural Walkthrough</h4>
                {result.walkthrough.map((wt, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow">
                    <div className="bg-zinc-950 p-3 border-b border-app-border/40 font-mono text-xs text-lime-400 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre">
                      {wt.block}
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-4 text-xs text-app-dim leading-relaxed">
                      {wt.explanation}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Complexity Metrics */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="p-4 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-lime-400 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Cpu className="w-4 h-4" /> Time Complexity
                  </h4>
                  <span className="text-xl font-mono text-app-text font-extrabold">{result.complexity.time}</span>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-app-dim mt-2 leading-relaxed">{result.complexity.explanation}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="p-4 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-lime-400 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Zap className="w-4 h-4" /> Space Complexity
                    </h4>
                    <span className="text-xl font-mono text-app-text font-extrabold">{result.complexity.space}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Bug/Refactor List */}
              {result.bugsAndOptimizations && result.bugsAndOptimizations.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-5 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-lime-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" /> Secure Guardrails & Refactor Recommendations
                  </h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-2 text-xs text-app-dim list-disc pl-5">
                    {result.bugsAndOptimizations.map((rec, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="leading-relaxed">{rec}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}

            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/CreationHistory.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { History, Clock, FileText, Trash2, Edit2, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Creation } from './LivePreview';

interface CreationHistoryProps {
  history: Creation[];
  onSelect: (creation: Creation) => void;
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  onEdit?: (id: string, newName: string) => void;
}

export const CreationHistory: React.FC<CreationHistoryProps> = ({ history, onSelect, onDelete, onEdit }) => {
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingName, setEditingName] = useState('');

  if (history.length === 0) return null;

  const handleStartEdit = (e: React.MouseEvent, item: Creation) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setEditingId(item.id);
    setEditingName(item.name);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.FocusEvent | React.KeyboardEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (editingName.trim() && onEdit) {
      onEdit(id, editingName.trim());
    }
    setEditingId(null);
  };

  const handleCancelEdit = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setEditingId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2">
        <History className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-600" />
        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-600">Previous Artifacts</h3>
        <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-zinc-800 ml-2" />
      </div>
      
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        {history.slice(0, 12).map((item) => (
          <button
            key={item.id}
            onClick={() => {
              if (editingId !== item.id) {
                onSelect(item);
              }
            }}
            type="button"
            className="group relative aspect-[4/3] rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden hover:border-zinc-500 transition-all text-left"
          >
            {item.originalImage ? (
              <img src={item.originalImage} alt={item.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover opacity-40 group-hover:opacity-60 transition-opacity" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-blue-500/5 group-hover:bg-blue-500/10 transition-colors">
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500/20 group-hover:text-blue-500/40" />
              </div>
            )}
            
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent p-3 flex flex-col justify-end">
              {editingId === item.id ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-1 z-20">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={editingName}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditingName(e.target.value)}
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSaveEdit(e, item.id);
                      if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditingId(null);
                    }}
                    className="bg-zinc-800 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 w-full"
                    autoFocus
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => handleSaveEdit(e, item.id)}
                    className="p-1 bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 rounded text-white"
                  >
                    <Check className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleCancelEdit}
                    className="p-1 bg-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-600 rounded text-white"
                  >
                    <X className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-100 truncate mb-1">{item.name}</span>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Clock className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-zinc-500" />
                <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 font-medium">
                  {new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Top right actions hidden by default, visible on hover */}
            {editingId !== item.id && (
              <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all transform scale-75 group-hover:scale-100 z-10">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={(e) => handleStartEdit(e, item)}
                  className="p-1 bg-zinc-800/90 hover:bg-zinc-700 rounded text-zinc-200 hover:text-white transition-colors border border-zinc-700"
                  title="Rename"
                >
                  <Edit2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                </button>
                {onDelete && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      onDelete(item.id);
                    }}
                    className="p-1 bg-red-950/90 hover:bg-red-700 rounded text-red-100 transition-colors border border-red-800 hover:border-red-600"
                    title="Delete"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/CueSheetPlanner.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Volume2, Music, VolumeX, Plus, Trash2, Download, Play, 
  Pause, Square, Sparkles, ChevronRight, AlertTriangle, RefreshCw 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { themeStyles } from '../../constants/creativeStudioTheme';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';

interface SoundCue {
  id: string;
  time: number; // in seconds
  trackType: 'Music' | 'SFX' | 'Voiceover' | 'Ambience';
  label: string;
  volume: number; // 0 to 100
  fade: 'None' | 'Fade In' | 'Fade Out' | 'Crossfade';
  notes: string;
}

interface CueSheetProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
  localTheme: string;
}

export const CueSheetPlanner: React.FC<CueSheetProps> = ({ onBack, localTheme }) => {
  const st = themeStyles[localTheme] || themeStyles.charcoal;

  const [cues, setCues] = useState<SoundCue[]>([
    { id: 'cue-1', time: 0, trackType: 'Ambience', label: 'Heavy wind & rain howling', volume: 40, fade: 'Fade In', notes: 'Establishes cold outdoor mood.' },
    { id: 'cue-2', time: 3, trackType: 'Music', label: 'Dark synth pad starts', volume: 60, fade: 'Fade In', notes: 'Low frequency retro synth.' },
    { id: 'cue-3', time: 8, trackType: 'SFX', label: 'Glass shattering cue', volume: 90, fade: 'None', notes: 'Slightly panned to the left.' }
  ]);

  const [activeCueId, setActiveCueId] = useState<string>('');
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(0);
  const [totalDuration, setTotalDuration] = useState(30); // max timeline duration in seconds
  const [aiConcept, setAiConcept] = useState('');
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);

  // Playback timer loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: any;
    if (isPlaying) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setCurrentTime(prev => {
          if (prev >= totalDuration) {
            setIsPlaying(false);
            return 0;
          }
          const nextTime = Math.round((prev + 0.5) * 10) / 10;
          
          // Trigger a sound synthesizer pitch shift when crossing cues!
          const activeCues = cues.filter(c => Math.abs(c.time - nextTime) < 0.25);
          activeCues.forEach(ac => {
            let freq = 300;
            if (ac.trackType === 'Music') freq = 440;
            if (ac.trackType === 'SFX') freq = 880;
            if (ac.trackType === 'Voiceover') freq = 600;
            if (ac.trackType === 'Ambience') freq = 200;
            triggerAudioCue(freq, ac.trackType === 'SFX' ? 'triangle' : 'sine');
          });

          return nextTime;
        });
      }, 500);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, cues, totalDuration]);

  // Audio cue synth maker
  const triggerAudioCue = (freq = 440, type: OscillatorType = 'sine', duration = 0.1) => {
    try {
      const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
      
      osc.connect(gainNode);
      gainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
    } catch {}
  };

  const handleAddCue = () => {
    const newCue: SoundCue = {
      id: `cue-${Date.now()}`,
      time: Math.min(currentTime, totalDuration),
      trackType: 'SFX',
      label: 'New audio trigger description',
      volume: 80,
      fade: 'None',
      notes: ''
    };
    setCues([...cues, newCue]);
    setActiveCueId(newCue.id);
  };

  const handleDeleteCue = (id: string) => {
    setCues(cues.filter(c => c.id !== id));
  };

  const handleCueField = (id: string, field: keyof SoundCue, value: any) => {
    setCues(cues.map(c => c.id === id ? { ...c, [field]: value } : c));
  };

  // Generate dynamic cues using AI
  const handleAICues = async () => {
    if (!aiConcept.trim()) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const prompt = `You are a master cinematic sound designer. Create 4 timeline audio cues for the theme: "${aiConcept}".
Response must be a raw JSON array of objects (no markdown blocks):
[
  {
    "time": 0,
    "trackType": "Ambience",
    "label": "Low synth rumble",
    "volume": 50,
    "fade": "Fade In",
    "notes": "Establishes a thick suspenseful air..."
  },
  {
    "time": 5,
    "trackType": "SFX",
    "label": "Ticking clock effect",
    "volume": 80,
    "fade": "None",
    "notes": "Builds urgency in scene..."
  }
]`;
      const response = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt);
      const cleaned = response.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
      const data = JSON.parse(cleaned);
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        const mapped = data.map((c, i) => ({
          ...c,
          id: `ai-cue-${Date.now()}-${i}`
        }));
        setCues(mapped);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert("Failed to parse AI Cue list. Try an easier scene theme like 'rainy diner'!");
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const exportCueSheet = () => {
    let csv = 'Time (s),Track Type,Cue Label,Volume (%),Fade style,Notes\n';
    cues.forEach(c => {
      csv += `"${c.time}","${c.trackType}","${c.label.replace(/"/g, '""')}","${c.volume}","${c.fade}","${c.notes.replace(/"/g, '""')}"\n`;
    });
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `sound_cue_sheet.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`p-6 min-h-screen ${st.bg} text-slate-100 flex flex-col gap-6 animate-fade-in`}>
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-4 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Volume2 className="text-amber-400 w-5 h-5 animate-bounce" />
            A/V Sound & Cue Sheet Planner
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Choreograph background tracks, triggers, sound levels, and audio panning markers along a master cinematic timeline.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button 
            onClick={exportCueSheet}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold border ${st.border} ${st.btnInactive} flex items-center gap-1.5`}
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Export Cue CSV
          </button>
          {onBack && (
            <button onClick={onBack} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold border ${st.border} ${st.btnInactive}`}>
              Back
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main timeline interactive preview */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-6">
        
        {/* Playback bar & Time controls */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 rounded text-xs font-extrabold uppercase flex items-center gap-1 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/10"
            >
              {isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              {isPlaying ? 'Pause Tracker' : 'Live Timeline Playback'}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setIsPlaying(false); setCurrentTime(0); }}
              className="p-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded"
              title="Stop"
            >
              <Square className="w-4 h-4 fill-slate-300" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono font-bold">
              Current Play Marker: <span className="text-amber-400 text-sm font-extrabold">{currentTime.toFixed(1)}s</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-700">/</span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase">End Time:</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min="10"
                max="120"
                value={totalDuration}
                onChange={(e) => setTotalDuration(Math.max(10, parseInt(e.target.value) || 30))}
                className="w-16 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-center font-mono font-bold text-slate-200"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Master visual multi-track grid */}
        <div className="relative border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-4 bg-slate-950/60 overflow-hidden space-y-2">
          
          {/* Progress marker bar overlay */}
          <div 
            className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-amber-500 z-10 transition-all pointer-events-none"
            style={{ left: `calc(130px + (${currentTime} / ${totalDuration}) * (100% - 146px))` }}
          />

          {['Ambience', 'Music', 'SFX', 'Voiceover'].map((trackType) => {
            const trackCues = cues.filter(c => c.trackType === trackType);
            return (
              <div key={trackType} className="flex items-center gap-4 h-11 relative">
                <span className="w-28 text-[11px] font-extrabold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">{trackType}</span>
                <div className="flex-1 bg-slate-900/60 h-8 rounded relative border border-slate-850/60">
                  {trackCues.map((cue) => {
                    const pctLeft = (cue.time / totalDuration) * 100;
                    if (pctLeft > 100) return null;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={cue.id}
                        onClick={() => setActiveCueId(cue.id)}
                        className={`absolute top-1 bottom-1 px-2 rounded text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-200 shadow-md transform -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center gap-1 overflow-hidden transition-all ${activeCueId === cue.id ? 'bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 scale-105 z-20 ring-1 ring-amber-300' : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700'}`}
                        style={{ left: `${pctLeft}%`, width: '120px' }}
                      >
                        <Volume2 className="w-3 h-3 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">{cue.label}</span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
        
        {/* Left Side: Cues Table List */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Cues Catalog</span>
            <button
              onClick={handleAddCue}
              className="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 hover:bg-amber-500/30 rounded text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Add Cue at playhead
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl max-h-[45vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-950 border-b border-slate-800 text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                  <th className="p-3">Time</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Track Type</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Cue Description</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Volume</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800">
                {cues.map((c) => (
                  <tr 
                    key={c.id} 
                    onClick={() => setActiveCueId(c.id)}
                    className={`cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-slate-800/30 ${activeCueId === c.id ? 'bg-amber-500/5' : ''}`}
                  >
                    <td className="p-3 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-400">{c.time}s</td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      <span className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] text-slate-300 font-semibold">{c.trackType}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-xs text-slate-200 font-medium truncate max-w-xs">{c.label}</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">{c.volume}%</td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <button 
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteCue(c.id)}
                        className="p-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-400"
                        title="Delete"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* AI Cue planner */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
            <label className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">
              AI Cue Choreographer
            </label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={aiConcept}
                onChange={(e) => setAiConcept(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. moody detective diner conversation, neon hum, rain sound"
                className="flex-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-200 placeholder-slate-600 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleAICues}
                disabled={isGenerating || !aiConcept.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-yellow-600 hover:from-amber-500 hover:to-yellow-500 text-slate-950 font-bold rounded-lg text-xs flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {isGenerating ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                Plan Soundscape
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Side: Active Cue Metadata Info Card */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-4 shadow-xl">
          <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">Cue Parameters</span>
          
          {activeCueId ? (
            (() => {
              const activeCue = cues.find(c => c.id === activeCueId);
              if (!activeCue) return <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Selected cue not found.</p>;
              return (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Time Marker (s)</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        max={totalDuration}
                        value={activeCue.time}
                        onChange={(e) => handleCueField(activeCue.id, 'time', Math.max(0, parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0))}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200 font-mono"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Track Type</label>
                      <select
                        value={activeCue.trackType}
                        onChange={(e) => handleCueField(activeCue.id, 'trackType', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200"
                      >
                        {['Music', 'SFX', 'Voiceover', 'Ambience'].map(t => (
                          <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Cue Trigger Description</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={activeCue.label}
                      onChange={(e) => handleCueField(activeCue.id, 'label', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Volume ({activeCue.volume}%)</label>
                      <input
                        type="range"
                        min="0"
                        max="100"
                        value={activeCue.volume}
                        onChange={(e) => handleCueField(activeCue.id, 'volume', parseInt(e.target.value))}
                        className="w-full accent-amber-500 mt-1"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Fade Curve</label>
                      <select
                        value={activeCue.fade}
                        onChange={(e) => handleCueField(activeCue.id, 'fade', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200"
                      >
                        {['None', 'Fade In', 'Fade Out', 'Crossfade'].map(f => (
                          <option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Trigger Execution Notes</label>
                    <textarea
                      value={activeCue.notes}
                      onChange={(e) => handleCueField(activeCue.id, 'notes', e.target.value)}
                      rows={3}
                      placeholder="e.g. pan slightly to left ear, or trigger bass reverb..."
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-slate-600 space-y-1">
              <VolumeX className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-750" />
              <p className="text-xs">No cue selected</p>
              <p className="text-[10px]">Select a cue in catalog or visual timeline to configure details.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
};
