### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/EbookGenerator.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { BookOpen, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, Sparkles, AlertCircle, Play, ChevronRight, List, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface EbookGeneratorProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface ChapterOutline {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  focus: string;
  hasGenerated: boolean;
  content?: string;
}

interface EbookResult {
  title: string;
  introduction: string;
  chapters: ChapterOutline[];
}

export const EbookGenerator: React.FC<EbookGeneratorProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [bookTitle, setBookTitle] = useState('The Next Tech Horizon');
  const [targetAudience, setTargetAudience] = useState('Business executives and technology enthusiasts');
  const [tone, setTone] = useState('Insightful & Narrative-driven');
  const [additionalDirectives, setAdditionalDirectives] = useState('');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessingOutline, setIsProcessingOutline] = useState(false);
  const [isProcessingChapter, setIsProcessingChapter] = useState(false);
  const [ebookData, setEbookData] = useState<EbookResult | null>(null);
  const [activeChapterIdx, setActiveChapterIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Generate Table of Contents & Outline
  const handleGenerateOutline = async () => {
    setIsProcessingOutline(true);
    setError(null);
    setEbookData(null);
    setActiveChapterIdx(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an expert E-Book Publisher, Strategist, and Author.
Evaluate the provided ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'} and structure a comprehensive 3-5 chapter E-Book outline.

E-BOOK SPECIFICATIONS:
- Proposed Title: ${bookTitle}
- Target Audience: ${targetAudience}
- Tone & Narrative Style: ${tone}
- Additional Directives: ${additionalDirectives || 'Organize the content logically based on trends and depth.'}

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the E-Book draft outline as a structured JSON object wrapped inside a codeblock.
The object must follow this strict TypeScript structure:
{
  "title": "A highly catchy, professionally refined title for the E-Book",
  "introduction": "An engaging, narrative introduction (1-2 paragraphs) setting the scene for the reader based on the sources.",
  "chapters": [
    {
      "number": 1,
      "title": "Chapter 1 Title (punchy & informative)",
      "focus": "Brief 1-sentence description of what this chapter covers and what insights from sources will be parsed here.",
      "hasGenerated": false
    },
    {
      "number": 2,
      "title": "Chapter 2 Title",
      "focus": "Description...",
      "hasGenerated": false
    }
  ]
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (parsedData && parsedData.title && parsedData.chapters) {
        setEbookData(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed outline did not match requested JSON schema.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to draft E-Book outline structure. Please clarify your requirements and try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessingOutline(false);
    }
  };

  // Generate content for a specific chapter
  const handleWriteChapter = async (chapterIdx: number) => {
    if (!ebookData) return;

    setIsProcessingChapter(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const targetChapter = ebookData.chapters[chapterIdx];

      const prompt = `Act as a senior writer. Write a comprehensive, highly detailed chapter for our E-Book.
This chapter will be read as part of a published book, so it should have deep insights, rich paragraphs, structured subheadings, and engaging examples based on our ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'}.

E-BOOK CONTEXT:
- E-Book Title: ${ebookData.title}
- Target Audience: ${targetAudience}
- Tone & Narrative Style: ${tone}

SPECIFIC CHAPTER OBJECTIVES:
- Chapter Number: ${targetChapter.number}
- Chapter Title: ${targetChapter.title}
- Chapter Focus / Context: ${targetChapter.focus}

OUTPUT REQUIREMENT:
Write the complete chapter in beautiful Markdown format (using subheadings, lists, bold accents, blockquotes, etc.). Make it comprehensive (at least 3-4 structured sections). Do not output JSON. Just output pure, beautiful Markdown starting directly with the chapter number and title.`;

      const chapterContent = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Update chapters array
      const updatedChapters = [...ebookData.chapters];
      updatedChapters[chapterIdx] = {
        ...targetChapter,
        hasGenerated: true,
        content: chapterContent
      };

      setEbookData({
        ...ebookData,
        chapters: updatedChapters
      });
      setActiveChapterIdx(chapterIdx);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to compile Chapter content. Please try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessingChapter(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyCompleteMarkdown = () => {
    if (!ebookData) return;

    let text = `# ${ebookData.title}\n\n`;
    text += `### A Comprehensive Guide for ${targetAudience}\n`;
    text += `**Narrative Tone**: ${tone}\n\n`;
    text += `=========================================\n\n`;
    text += `## Introduction\n\n${ebookData.introduction}\n\n`;
    text += `=========================================\n\n`;

    ebookData.chapters.forEach(ch => {
      text += `## Chapter ${ch.number}: ${ch.title}\n\n`;
      if (ch.hasGenerated && ch.content) {
        text += `${ch.content}\n\n`;
      } else {
        text += `*Chapter not yet compiled. Outline focus: ${ch.focus}*\n\n`;
      }
      text += `=========================================\n\n`;
    });

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!ebookData) return;

    let text = `# ${ebookData.title}\n\n`;
    text += `* Target Audience: ${targetAudience}\n`;
    text += `* Tone Style: ${tone}\n\n`;
    text += `## Introduction\n\n${ebookData.introduction}\n\n`;

    ebookData.chapters.forEach(ch => {
      text += `## Chapter ${ch.number}: ${ch.title}\n\n`;
      if (ch.hasGenerated && ch.content) {
        text += `${ch.content}\n\n`;
      } else {
        text += `*Focus Outline: ${ch.focus}*\n\n`;
      }
    });

    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/markdown' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${ebookData.title.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-${Date.now()}.md`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!ebookData || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>${ebookData.title}</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 3rem 2rem; }
        .ebook-container { max-width: 50rem; margin: 0 auto; background: #111827; border: 1px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 16px; padding: 3rem; }
        h1 { font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.2; color: #a5b4fc; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; text-align: center; }
        .introduction { font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #d1d5db; border-left: 4px solid #6366f1; padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-top: 2rem; margin-bottom: 3rem; }
        .chapter-title { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 800; color: #818cf8; margin-top: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2937; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; }
        .chapter-content { line-height: 1.8; color: #e5e7eb; font-size: 1rem; }
        .chapter-content p { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="ebook-container shadow-2xl">
        <h1>📔 ${ebookData.title}</h1>
        <p class="text-center text-sm text-indigo-400 tracking-wider uppercase font-semibold">A Master Compilation</p>
        
        <div class="introduction">${ebookData.introduction}</div>

        <div class="space-y-12">
            ${ebookData.chapters.map(ch => `
            <div>
                <h2 class="chapter-title">Chapter ${ch.number}: ${ch.title}</h2>
                <div class="chapter-content whitespace-pre-wrap">${ch.hasGenerated && ch.content ? ch.content : `<em>Chapter focus: ${ch.focus} (Content pending compilation)</em>`}</div>
            </div>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `E-Book: ${ebookData.title.slice(0, 20)}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-400">
            <BookOpen className="w-6 h-6" /> Ebook Generator
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Build comprehensive, chapter-based narrative eBooks and analytical strategic summaries backed directly by your sources.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {ebookData && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopyCompleteMarkdown}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {copied ? 'Copied Complete Book' : 'Copy Complete Book'}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download MD
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save EBook'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">

        {/* Configuration Setup */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" /> Blueprint Creator
            </h3>

            {/* Knowledge base status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected. Creative flow will rely on general synthesis.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Title proposed */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Proposed EBook Title</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={bookTitle}
                onChange={(e) => setBookTitle(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                placeholder="The Next Tech Horizon"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Target Audience */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Target Reader Profile</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={targetAudience}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetAudience(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
                placeholder="Product managers, executives..."
              />
            </div>

            {/* Narrative Tone style */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Writing Narrative Tone</label>
              <select
                value={tone}
                onChange={(e) => setTone(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              >
                <option value="Insightful & Narrative-driven">📖 Insightful, engaging & narrative-driven</option>
                <option value="Highly Analytical & Academic">🎓 Structured, academic & analytical</option>
                <option value="Casual, Punchy & Case-study centric">⚡ Casual, case-study centric & punchy</option>
                <option value="Direct Technical documentation style">📟 Direct technical developer specification</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Custom Directives */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Custom Content Focus (Optional)</label>
              <textarea
                value={additionalDirectives}
                onChange={(e) => setAdditionalDirectives(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Specify standard concepts or chapter bounds to enforce..."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Execute Outline Generator */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerateOutline}
              disabled={isProcessingOutline}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:bg-indigo-850/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
            >
              {isProcessingOutline ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Generating Book Outline...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate Book Outline
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Chapter Sandbox */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessingOutline && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-500/20 border-t-indigo-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Formulating Structural Outline...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Evaluating source files and establishing logical narrative flow and strategic introductions.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && !isProcessingOutline && !isProcessingChapter && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Operation Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerateOutline}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessingOutline && !error && !ebookData && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <BookOpen className="w-12 h-12 text-indigo-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Multi-Chapter EBook Workspace</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Configure your proposed eBook concept and click Generate Outline to establish an interactive, chapter-by-chapter workbench.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessingOutline && ebookData && (
            <div className="flex-1 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-full">
              
              {/* Left Outline Rail */}
              <div className="md:col-span-5 space-y-3">
                <div className="p-3 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-lg text-xs">
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-indigo-400 text-sm mb-1">{ebookData.title}</h4>
                  <p className="text-app-dim leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">{ebookData.introduction}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim">Table of Chapters</span>
                  {ebookData.chapters.map((ch, idx) => (
                    <button
                      key={idx}
                      onClick={() => setActiveChapterIdx(idx)}
                      className={`w-full p-3 border rounded-xl text-left transition-all text-xs flex items-center justify-between group ${
                        activeChapterIdx === idx
                          ? 'bg-indigo-600/10 border-indigo-500 text-app-text'
                          : 'bg-app-card border-app-border hover:border-indigo-500/40 text-app-dim'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                        <span className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          ch.hasGenerated 
                            ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' 
                            : 'bg-app-bg border border-app-border text-app-dim'
                        }`}>
                          {ch.number}
                        </span>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <h5 className="font-bold truncate text-app-text">{ch.title}</h5>
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-app-dim truncate">{ch.focus}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Right Active Chapter Workbench */}
              <div className="md:col-span-7 flex flex-col h-full bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden min-h-[350px]">
                {activeChapterIdx === null ? (
                  <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center text-app-dim">
                    <List className="w-10 h-10 text-indigo-500/20 mb-2" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-app-text">Select Chapter</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] max-w-xs mt-0.5">Click any chapter in the outline to configure, generate, or view its contents.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full justify-between">
                    {/* Chapter Header */}
                    <div className="p-4 bg-app-bg border-b border-app-border flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-indigo-400">Chapter {ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].number}</span>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-app-text truncate">{ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].title}</h4>
                      </div>

                      {!ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].hasGenerated && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleWriteChapter(activeChapterIdx)}
                          disabled={isProcessingChapter}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:bg-indigo-850/40 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {isProcessingChapter ? (
                            <>
                              <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                              Writing...
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Play className="w-3 h-3" />
                              Compile Chapter
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Chapter Body / Content */}
                    <div className="flex-1 p-5 overflow-y-auto max-h-[40vh] text-xs leading-relaxed text-app-text">
                      {isProcessingChapter ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full space-y-3">
                          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-500/20 border-t-indigo-500 animate-spin"></div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-app-dim">Expanding narrative outline into full structural prose...</p>
                        </div>
                      ) : ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].hasGenerated && ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].content ? (
                        <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap font-sans">
                          {ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].content}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center text-app-dim space-y-2">
                          <FileText className="w-10 h-10 text-app-border" />
                          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-app-text">Chapter Pending compilation</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
                            Focus: "{ebookData.chapters[activeChapterIdx].focus}"
                          </p>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleWriteChapter(activeChapterIdx)}
                            className="mt-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-900/30 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded text-[11px] font-bold hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Compile Now
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/EmailDrafter.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Mail, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, Send, Sparkles, AlertCircle, Eye, User, FileText } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface EmailDrafterProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface EmailResult {
  subject: string;
  body: string;
  alternatives: string[];
}

export const EmailDrafter: React.FC<EmailDrafterProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [recipient, setRecipient] = useState('Executive / Executive Team');
  const [senderPersona, setSenderPersona] = useState('Professional & Concise');
  const [tone, setTone] = useState('Persuasive & Professional');
  const [objective, setObjective] = useState('');
  const [includeCta, setIncludeCta] = useState(true);
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<EmailResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copiedText, setCopiedText] = useState<'subject' | 'body' | 'full' | null>(null);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an expert Communications Director and Professional Copywriter.
Draft a highly polished email pitch, briefing, or message based on the provided ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'}.

EMAIL SPECIFICATIONS:
- Recipient Profile: ${recipient}
- Sender Persona Style: ${senderPersona}
- Conversational Tone: ${tone}
- Email Objective/Context: ${objective || 'Synthesize core insights from sources into a clear overview.'}
- Include Call-to-Action (CTA): ${includeCta ? 'Yes, formulate a single high-impact call to action' : 'No'}

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the email data as a structured JSON object wrapped inside a codeblock.
The object must follow this strict TypeScript structure:
{
  "subject": "Clear, high-conversion subject line with active verb",
  "body": "The email draft. Use professional spacing, bulleted structure if relevant, greeting, and sign-off. Use brackets like [Your Name] or [Insert Date] for custom input placeholders.",
  "alternatives": [
    "Alternative Subject Line 1 (Curiosity-driven)",
    "Alternative Subject Line 2 (Direct & Short)",
    "Alternative Subject Line 3 (Benefit-driven)"
  ]
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (parsedData && parsedData.subject && parsedData.body) {
        setResult(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed data was not structured correctly.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to compile email drafts in a structured format. Please write more details in the objective or try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, type: 'subject' | 'body' | 'full') => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedText(type);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedText(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!result) return;
    
    let text = `SUBJECT: ${result.subject}\n\n`;
    text += `BODY:\n${result.body}\n\n`;
    text += `=========================================\n`;
    text += `ALTERNATIVE SUBJECTS:\n`;
    result.alternatives.forEach((alt, idx) => {
      text += `- ${alt}\n`;
    });

    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `email-draft-${Date.now()}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!result || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Email Draft</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 2rem; }
        .email-composer { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; }
        .composer-header { background: #1f2937; padding: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #374151; }
        .composer-body { padding: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6; }
        h1 { font-size: 1.75rem; color: #06b6d4; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <h1>📨 Email Drafter Output</h1>
        
        <div class="email-composer shadow-2xl">
            <div class="composer-header space-y-2 text-sm text-gray-300">
                <div><span class="text-gray-500 font-semibold">Recipient:</span> ${recipient}</div>
                <div><span class="text-gray-500 font-semibold">Tone:</span> ${tone}</div>
                <div class="border-t border-gray-700/55 pt-2"><span class="text-gray-400 font-bold">Subject:</span> ${result.subject}</div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="composer-body text-gray-200 whitespace-pre-wrap">${result.body}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="mt-6 p-4 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-lg">
            <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-400 mb-2">Subject Alternatives</h3>
            <ul class="list-disc pl-5 text-xs text-gray-300 space-y-1.5">
                ${result.alternatives.map(alt => `<li>${alt}</li>`).join('')}
            </ul>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));
    
    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Email: ${result.subject.slice(0, 25)}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-cyan-400">
            <Mail className="w-6 h-6" /> Email Drafter
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Formulate high-impact professional, friendly, or sales emails backed directly by your source context.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {result && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download TXT
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-cyan-600/20 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 hover:bg-cyan-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved to Session!' : 'Save Email Draft'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">
        
        {/* Left Input Configuration */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" /> Dispatch Blueprint
            </h3>

            {/* Source items count */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No source materials selected. Drafting general placeholder email.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Recipient Profile */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Target Recipient</label>
              <select
                value={recipient}
                onChange={(e) => setRecipient(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
              >
                <option value="Executive / Board of Directors">Executive / Board of Directors (Formal, ROI-focused)</option>
                <option value="Cold Sales Prospect">Cold Outreach Lead (Short, Hook-driven, Value-first)</option>
                <option value="Internal Engineering/Product Team">Internal Product/Engineering Team (Technical, Practical)</option>
                <option value="Casual Subscriber / Community member">Casual Community / Newsletter Member (Warm, Accessible)</option>
                <option value="Aggressive Venture capitalist / VC">SaaS Venture Capitalist / VC Pitch (Aggressive, Huge TAM)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Sender Style */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Sender Style / Persona</label>
              <select
                value={senderPersona}
                onChange={(e) => setSenderPersona(e.target.value)}

              >
                <option value="Professional & Concise">Professional & Highly Concise</option>
                <option value="Thought Leader & Visionary">Thought Leader / Expert Educator</option>

              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Email Tone */}
            <div>

                onChange={(e) => setTone(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
              >
                <option value="Persuasive & Professional">Persuasive, authoritative & value-first</option>
                <option value="Direct, Urgent & Bulleted">Urgent, action-oriented & direct</option>
                <option value="Friendly, Warm & Conversational">Friendly, personal & conversational</option>
                <option value="Diplomatic & Accountable">Diplomatic, structural & troubleshooting</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Email Objective */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Email Goal / Call-To-Action context</label>
              <textarea
                value={objective}
                onChange={(e) => setObjective(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="e.g. Schedule a 10-minute demo, or explain why we are changing our API rate limits based on sources..."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* CTA Option */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border">

                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIncludeCta(!includeCta)}
                className={`relative inline-flex h-5 w-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-full border-2 border-transparent transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out focus:outline-none ${
                  includeCta ? 'bg-cyan-500' : 'bg-zinc-800'
                }`}
              >
                <span
                  className={`pointer-events-none inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white shadow ring-0 transition duration-200 ease-in-out ${
                    includeCta ? 'translate-x-5' : 'translate-x-0'
                  }`}
                />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Run Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 disabled:bg-cyan-850/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Formulating Draft...
                </>
              ) : (

                  <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate Email Drafts

              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !error && !result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">

              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Email Interactive Composer</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Customize the recipe on the left and click Generate to spawn your subject line alternative matrices and email mock-ups.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && result && (
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-6">
              {/* Email Mockup */}
              <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
                {/* Header Mockup */}
                <div className="bg-app-bg p-4 border-b border-app-border space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

                    <span className="font-semibold bg-app-input px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-app-border text-app-text">
                      {recipient.split('(')[0]}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-app-border/40 pt-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-1">
                      <span className="text-app-dim w-12 font-bold text-cyan-400">Subject:</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-app-text text-sm truncate">{result.subject}</span>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(result.subject, 'subject')}
                      className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 ml-4 font-semibold"
                    >
                      {copiedText === 'subject' ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                      Copy Subject
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Email Body */}
                <div className="p-6 text-sm text-app-text whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto font-sans">
                  {result.body}

                {/* Copy Bar */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-app-bg border-t border-app-border flex justify-end gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(result.body, 'body')}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    {copiedText === 'body' ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    Copy Body Text
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(`Subject: ${result.subject}\n\n${result.body}`, 'full')}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-cyan-600/20 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 rounded text-xs font-bold hover:bg-cyan-600 hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    {copiedText === 'full' ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    Copy Entire Email
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Subject Alternative list */}
              {result.alternatives && result.alternatives.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" /> Alternative Subject Line Angles
                  </h4>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {result.alternatives.map((alt, index) => (
                      <div key={index} className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 bg-app-bg rounded border border-app-border hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all text-xs">
                        <span className="text-app-text italic">{alt}</span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => {
                            setResult({ ...result, subject: alt });
                          }}
                          className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-0.5 ml-2"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" /> Use this
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';

import { MediaItem } from '../../types';
import Markdown from 'react-markdown';

interface ExecutiveBriefingProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface RiskItem {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  level: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
  description: string;
}

export const ExecutiveBriefing: React.FC<ExecutiveBriefingProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [focusArea, setFocusArea] = useState('Strategic Opportunities');
  const [memoStyle, setMemoStyle] = useState('Bento Block Overview');
  const [tone, setTone] = useState('Analytical');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  // Interactive local parameters for customization
  const [risks, setRisks] = useState<RiskItem[]>([
    { id: '1', category: 'Operational', level: 'Medium', description: 'Information overload and stale aggregate source feeds.' },
    { id: '2', category: 'Strategic', level: 'High', description: 'CORS connectivity blocks on Custom OpenAI base URLs.' },
    { id: '3', category: 'Financial', level: 'Low', description: 'Token pricing quotas during repetitive background summarizations.' }
  ]);
  const [newRiskCategory, setNewRiskCategory] = useState('Technical');
  const [newRiskLevel, setNewRiskLevel] = useState<'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low'>('Medium');
  const [newRiskDesc, setNewRiskDesc] = useState('');

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [briefing, setBriefing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  const addRisk = () => {
    if (!newRiskDesc.trim()) return;
    setRisks([
      ...risks,
      {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        category: newRiskCategory,
        level: newRiskLevel,
        description: newRiskDesc.trim()
      }
    ]);
    setNewRiskDesc('');
  };

  const removeRisk = (id: string) => {
    setRisks(risks.filter(r => r.id !== id));
  };

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setBriefing(null);
    setCopied(false);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      // Format custom risks for LLM context
      const customRisksContext = risks.map((r, i) => 
        `- [${r.level} Risk] ${r.category}: ${r.description}`
      ).join('\n');

      const prompt = `You are a Chief of Staff and Principal Consultant. 
Synthesize a professional, comprehensive Executive Briefing based on the ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'provided source documents' : 'specifications'}.

USER SPECIFICATIONS:
- Key Focus Area: ${focusArea}
- Memo Layout Style: ${memoStyle}
- Tone: ${tone}

USER-SPECIFIED RISKS (Integrate these explicitly in your risks section):
${customRisksContext}

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
Generate a deeply synthesized, one-page report in beautiful Markdown. Organize the output into these specific headings with highly polished corporate wording:

# Executive Briefing: (Strategic Brief Title)

## 1. High-Impact Executive Summary
(Draft a powerful, maximum 3-sentence elevator pitch outlining the core purpose and immediate takeaways)

## 2. Core Strategic Drivers & Insights
(Provide 3-5 high-level bullet points detailing strategic indicators, technology advantages, or market variables discovered in the sources)

## 3. Risk Assessment & Mitigation Framework
(Synthesize a high-quality matrix containing the user-specified risks, and write clear, realistic operational mitigations for each)

## 4. Recommended Next Steps & Milestones
(Provide a structured, chronological set of immediate action items, specifying key milestones, objectives, and targeted timelines)

Ensure the output is written for executives - direct, zero-filler, analytical, and extremely concise.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);
      setBriefing(responseText);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setBriefing("Failed to compile executive briefing. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (briefing) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(briefing);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (briefing) {
      const blob = new Blob([briefing], { type: 'text/markdown' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `executive-briefing-${Date.now()}.md`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!briefing || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    // Convert briefing Markdown to a beautifully wrapped HTML template
    const htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Executive Briefing Document</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #f8fafc; color: #1e293b; padding: 3rem; }
        .document-container { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; background: #ffffff; padding: 3rem; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }

        p { margin-bottom: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #334155; }
        ul, ol { margin-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; list-style-type: decimal; }
        li { margin-bottom: 0.5rem; line-height: 1.6; }
        .risk-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="document-container">
        <h1>📁 Executive Briefing Document</h1>
        <div style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #64748b; margin-top: -1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2.5rem; font-family: monospace;">
            STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL // GENERATED VIA INTEL AGGREGATOR ENGINE // DATE: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}
        </div>
        
        <div class="prose prose-slate max-w-none">
            ${briefing.split('\n').map(line => {
              const trimmed = line.trim();
              if (trimmed.startsWith('# ')) {
                return `<h1>${trimmed.substring(2)}</h1>`;
              } else if (trimmed.startsWith('## ')) {
                return `<h2>${trimmed.substring(3)}</h2>`;
              } else if (trimmed.startsWith('- ') || trimmed.startsWith('* ')) {
                return `<li>${trimmed.substring(2)}</li>`;
              } else if (trimmed) {
                return `<p>${trimmed}</p>`;
              }
              return '';
            }).join('\n')}
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Briefing Memo: ${focusArea}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Top Action Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-400">
            <FileText className="w-6 h-6" /> Executive Briefing Desk
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Formulate professional, highly structured one-pagers and memos for strategic leaders.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {briefing && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Text'}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/30 hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save Briefing'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">
        
        {/* Left Hand: Controller & Dynamic Risk Board */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto max-h-[80vh] pr-1">
          {/* Main settings box */}
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Settings className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" /> Document Settings
            </h3>

            {/* Context reference status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Referencing' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected media node(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No media nodes selected in session chat yet. Grounding will use general context.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Focus area */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Strategic Focus Area</label>
              <select
                value={focusArea}
                onChange={(e) => setFocusArea(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              >
                <option value="Strategic Opportunities">🚀 Strategic Opportunities & Scaling</option>
                <option value="Risk & Mitigation Focus">🛡️ Risk Mitigation & Structural Roadblocks</option>
                <option value="Operational Roadmaps">⚙️ Operational Readiness & Milestones</option>
                <option value="Financial & Resource Targets">💰 Financial Projections & Capital Budgets</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Layout layout style */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Briefing Layout Style</label>
              <select
                value={memoStyle}
                onChange={(e) => setMemoStyle(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              >
                <option value="Classic Corporate Memo">Classic Corporate Memo (To/From/Date format)</option>
                <option value="Bento Block Overview">Bento Block Summary (Direct & Structured)</option>
                <option value="High-Level Strategic Letter">High-Level Executive Strategy Letter</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Tone */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Professional Tone</label>
              <select
                value={tone}
                onChange={(e) => setTone(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500"
              >
                <option value="Analytical">📊 Analytical & Metrics-driven</option>
                <option value="Direct & Concise">⚡ Direct, Concise & High-impact</option>
                <option value="Narrative & Visionary">🌟 Visionary & Strategic-narrative</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Risk Board */}
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" /> Interactive Risk Board
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-app-dim">
              Add or remove risks dynamically. The AI will build targeted mitigation roadmaps for each.
            </p>

            {/* Risk input creator */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 border border-app-border rounded space-y-2.5">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] text-app-dim mb-1">Category</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newRiskCategory}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewRiskCategory(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none"
                    placeholder="e.g. Legal, Security"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] text-app-dim mb-1">Risk Level</label>
                  <select
                    value={newRiskLevel}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewRiskLevel(e.target.value as any)}
                    className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="Low">🟢 Low</option>
                    <option value="Medium">🟡 Medium</option>
                    <option value="High">🔴 High</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] text-app-dim mb-1">Risk Description</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newRiskDesc}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewRiskDesc(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none"
                  placeholder="Describe the threat..."
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={addRisk}
                className="w-full py-1 rounded bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 hover:text-white border border-zinc-700 text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <ListPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Add Risk to Memo
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Selected risks listing */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {risks.map(r => (
                <div key={r.id} className="flex justify-between items-start gap-2 p-2 bg-app-bg rounded border border-app-border text-xs">
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1 flex-wrap">
                      <span className="font-bold text-app-text">{r.category}</span>
                      <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold ${
                        r.level === 'High' 
                          ? 'bg-red-950/40 text-red-400 border border-red-900/30' 
                          : r.level === 'Medium' 
                            ? 'bg-yellow-950/40 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-900/30'
                            : 'bg-green-950/40 text-green-400 border border-green-900/30'
                      }`}>
                        {r.level}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-app-dim truncate" title={r.description}>{r.description}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => removeRisk(r.id)}
                    className="p-1 rounded text-app-dim hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-950/20"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Run button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:bg-indigo-850/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-indigo-900/10"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Formulating Executive Memo...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Compile Briefing
                </>
              )}
            </button>

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Hand: Output & Visualization Slate */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-500/20 border-t-indigo-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Compiling Strategy Report...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Evaluating structural inputs, drafting critical drivers, and formulating specific mitigations for {risks.length} dynamic threat vectors.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !briefing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <BarChart className="w-12 h-12 text-indigo-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Strategy Slate Preview</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Configure focus coordinates, memo layout style, and threat indexes on the left, then click "Compile Briefing".
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && briefing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
              {/* Document Header Indicator */}
              <div className="bg-app-bg/50 border-b border-app-border px-4 py-2.5 flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-app-dim font-mono">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 animate-pulse"></span>
                  STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-app-dim font-mono uppercase">
                  {focusArea} // {tone} Style
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Slate Area */}
              <div className="p-6 md:p-8 flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-app-bg/15 max-h-[650px]">
                <div className="prose prose-invert prose-xs max-w-none prose-headings:text-app-text prose-headings:font-bold prose-p:text-app-dim prose-li:text-app-dim prose-strong:text-app-text">
                  <Markdown>{briefing}</Markdown>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
