### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/ImageCarverTool.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import ReactCrop, { Crop } from "react-image-crop";
import "react-image-crop/dist/ReactCrop.css";
import { Upload, Crop as CropIcon, Grid, Download, Settings, Check, Image as ImageIcon, Archive, GripHorizontal, GripVertical, Move } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "../../utils";
import { getCroppedImg, sliceImage } from "../../imageUtils";
import JSZip from "jszip";
import { saveAs } from "file-saver";

type Mode = "crop" | "carve";

export function ImageCarverTool() {
  const [imageSrc, setImageSrc] = useState<string>("");
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("crop");

  // Crop State
  const [crop, setCrop] = useState<Crop>();
  const [completedPercentCrop, setCompletedPercentCrop] = useState<Crop | null>(null);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);

  // Carve State
  const [croppedImageSrc, setCroppedImageSrc] = useState<string>("");
  const [isAdjusting, setIsAdjusting] = useState(true);
  const [numRows, setNumRows] = useState(2);
  const [numCols, setNumCols] = useState(2);
  const [rowCuts, setRowCuts] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [colCuts, setColCuts] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [carveImageSize, setCarveImageSize] = useState({ width: 0, height: 0 });
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<"image/png" | "image/jpeg">("image/png");

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  // Drag State for grid handles
  const carveImgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState<{ type: "row" | "col"; index: number } | null>(null);

  const updateCutFromPointer = useCallback(
    (clientX: number, clientY: number, drag: { type: "row" | "col"; index: number }) => {
      const img = carveImgRef.current;
      if (!img || carveImageSize.width === 0 || carveImageSize.height === 0) return;
      const rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();

      if (drag.type === "row") {
        const relY = (clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
        const px = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, relY)) * carveImageSize.height);
        setRowCuts((prev) => {
          const next = [...prev];
          next[drag.index] = px;
          return next;
        });
      } else {
        const relX = (clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
        const px = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, relX)) * carveImageSize.width);
        setColCuts((prev) => {
          const next = [...prev];
          next[drag.index] = px;
          return next;
        });
      }
    },
    [carveImageSize]
  );

  // Global pointer listeners while dragging
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      updateCutFromPointer(e.clientX, e.clientY, dragging);
    };
    const onUp = () => setDragging(null);
    window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      window.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
    };
  }, [dragging, updateCutFromPointer]);

  // Handle File Upload
  const onSelectFile = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
      setCrop(undefined); // Makes crop preview update between images.
      setCompletedPercentCrop(null);
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.addEventListener("load", () => setImageSrc(reader.result?.toString() || ""));
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      setMode("crop");
      setCroppedImageSrc("");
    }
  };

  // Generate cropped image when switching to carve mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === "carve" && imageSrc) {
      if (completedPercentCrop && completedPercentCrop.width > 0 && completedPercentCrop.height > 0) {
        getCroppedImg(imageSrc, completedPercentCrop).then((url) => {
          setCroppedImageSrc(url);
        });
      } else {
        // If no crop was made, use the whole image
        setCroppedImageSrc(imageSrc);
      }
      setIsAdjusting(true);
    }
  }, [mode, imageSrc, completedPercentCrop]);

  // Initialize cuts when numRows/numCols or image size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (carveImageSize.width > 0 && carveImageSize.height > 0) {
      setRowCuts((prev) => {
        const newCuts = Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, numRows - 1) }, (_, i) => {
          return prev[i] !== undefined ? prev[i] : Math.round(((i + 1) * carveImageSize.height) / numRows);
        });
        return newCuts;
      });
      setColCuts((prev) => {
        const newCuts = Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, numCols - 1) }, (_, i) => {
          return prev[i] !== undefined ? prev[i] : Math.round(((i + 1) * carveImageSize.width) / numCols);
        });
        return newCuts;
      });
    }
  }, [numRows, numCols, carveImageSize]);

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!croppedImageSrc) return;
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const slices = await sliceImage(croppedImageSrc, rowCuts, colCuts, format);
      
      if (slices.length === 0) return;

      if (slices.length === 1) {
        // Single file download
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = slices[0].url;
        a.download = slices[0].name;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
      } else {
        // Multiple files: Bundle into a ZIP to prevent browser blocking
        const zip = new JSZip();
        slices.forEach((slice) => {
          // slice.url is a data URL: data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...
          const base64Data = slice.url.split(",")[1];
          zip.file(slice.name, base64Data, { base64: true });
        });
        const content = await zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob" });
        saveAs(content, "carved-slices.zip");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex-1 bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 font-sans selection:bg-sky-500/30 selection:text-sky-200 p-4">
      
      {/* Main Content */}
      {imageSrc ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
          
          {/* Controls Panel - Left/Top */}
          <aside className="lg:col-span-3 space-y-4">
            
            {/* Mode Switcher */}
            <div className="bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-md border border-slate-700 flex shadow-sm">
              <button
                onClick={() => setMode("crop")}
                className={cn(
                  "flex-1 py-1.5 px-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-all border",
                  mode === "crop"
                    ? "bg-slate-700 text-sky-400 shadow-sm border-slate-600"
                    : "text-slate-400 border-transparent hover:bg-slate-700/50 hover:text-slate-300"
                )}
              >
                <CropIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Crop Area
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setMode("carve")}
                className={cn(
                  "flex-1 py-1.5 px-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded text-xs font-medium transition-all border",
                  mode === "carve"
                    ? "bg-slate-700 text-sky-400 shadow-sm border-slate-600"
                    : "text-slate-400 border-transparent hover:bg-slate-700/50 hover:text-slate-300"
                )}
              >
                <Grid className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Grid Splitting
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Crop Controls */}
            {mode === "crop" && (
              <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 shadow-sm space-y-3 animate-in slide-in-from-left-2 duration-300">
                <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <CropIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                  Crop Image
                </h2>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                  Select the specific region to be carved. Drag the edges to fine-tune selection.
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setMode("carve")}
                  className="w-full bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white py-1.5 rounded font-medium transition-colors border border-sky-500 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs shadow-sm mt-2"
                >
                  Confirm Crop & Next
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Carve Controls */}
            {mode === "carve" && (
              <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 shadow-sm space-y-4 animate-in slide-in-from-right-2 duration-300">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-700">
                  <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                    Grid Configuration
                  </h2>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsAdjusting(!isAdjusting)}
                    className={cn(
                      "text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded transition-colors border",
                      isAdjusting 
                        ? "bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400 border-sky-500/30 hover:bg-sky-500/20" 
                        : "bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 border-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-600"
                    )}
                  >
                    {isAdjusting ? "Lock Grid" : "Edit Details"}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {isAdjusting ? (
                  <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-1 duration-200">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <label className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400 uppercase">Rows</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          min={1}
                          max={20}
                          value={numRows}
                          onChange={(e) => setNumRows(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
                          className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-sky-500 transition-shadow"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <label className="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400 uppercase">Columns</label>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          min={1}
                          max={20}
                          value={numCols}
                          onChange={(e) => setNumCols(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
                          className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-sky-500 transition-shadow"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-sky-500/5 border border-sky-500/20 rounded px-2 py-1.5 flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <Move className="w-3 h-3 text-sky-400 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 leading-snug">
                        Drag the <span className="text-sky-400 font-semibold">grid handles</span> on the image, or type exact pixel values below.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
                    <div className="bg-slate-900/60 rounded-md p-2.5 border border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between shadow-inner">
                      <div className="flex gap-3">
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <span className="block text-lg font-bold text-slate-200 leading-none">{numRows}</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-bold">Rows</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-px bg-slate-700"></div>
                        <div className="text-center">
                          <span className="block text-lg font-bold text-slate-200 leading-none">{numCols}</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-bold">Cols</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="block text-base font-bold text-sky-400 leading-none">{numRows * numCols}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-bold">Slices</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div className="space-y-2 pt-1">
                      <label className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Format</label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setFormat("image/png")}
                          className={cn(
                            "py-1.5 px-2 rounded border text-xs font-medium transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5",
                            format === "image/png"
                              ? "bg-sky-500/10 border-sky-500 text-sky-400"
                              : "bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-500"
                          )}
                        >
                          PNG
                          {format === "image/png" && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setFormat("image/jpeg")}
                          className={cn(
                            "py-1.5 px-2 rounded border text-xs font-medium transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5",
                            format === "image/jpeg"
                              ? "bg-sky-500/10 border-sky-500 text-sky-400"
                              : "bg-slate-900 border-slate-700 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-500"
                          )}
                        >
                          JPEG
                          {format === "image/jpeg" && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={handleDownload}
                      disabled={isProcessing}
                      className="w-full bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 disabled:bg-slate-700 disabled:text-slate-500 disabled:border-slate-600 text-white py-2 rounded font-bold transition-colors border border-sky-500 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm text-xs mt-2"
                    >
                      {isProcessing ? (
                        <span className="animate-pulse">Packaging ZIP...</span>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          {numRows * numCols > 1 ? <Archive className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Download className="w-4 h-4" />}
                          Download {numRows * numCols > 1 ? "ZIP" : "Slice"}
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </aside>

          {/* Workspace Area - Right/Bottom */}
          <section className="lg:col-span-9 h-full">
            <div className="bg-slate-800 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-[70vh] min-h-[500px]">
              {/* Workspace Header */}
              <div className="bg-slate-900/80 px-3 py-2 border-b border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Workspace preview
                </span>
                {mode === "carve" && carveImageSize.width > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400/80 font-medium bg-sky-400/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {carveImageSize.width} × {carveImageSize.height} px
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Workspace Content */}
              <div className="p-4 flex-1 flex items-center justify-center bg-[url('data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4bWxucz0iaHR0cDovL3d3dy53My5vcmcvMjAwMC9zdmciIHdpZHRoPSI4IiBoZWlnaHQ9IjgiPgo8cmVjdCB3aWR0aD0iNCIgaGVpZ2h0PSI0IiBmaWxsPSIjMWUxZTI4IiAvPgo8cmVjdCB4PSI0IiB5PSI0IiB3aWR0aD0iNCIgaGVpZ2h0PSI0IiBmaWxsPSIjMWUxZTI4IiAvPgo8L3N2Zz4=')] overflow-hidden">
                
                {mode === "crop" && (
                  <div className="max-w-full max-h-full flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden border border-slate-700 shadow-xl bg-slate-900">
                    <ReactCrop
                      crop={crop}
                      onChange={(_, percentCrop) => setCrop(percentCrop)}
                      onComplete={(_, pc) => setCompletedPercentCrop(pc)}
                      className="max-h-[calc(70vh-80px)]"
                    >
                      <img
                        ref={imgRef}
                        alt="Upload"
                        src={imageSrc}
                        className="max-w-full max-h-[calc(70vh-80px)] object-contain"
                      />
                    </ReactCrop>
                  </div>
                )}

                {mode === "carve" && croppedImageSrc && (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "relative max-w-full flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl bg-slate-900 inline-block overflow-hidden select-none",
                      dragging && "cursor-grabbing"
                    )}
                  >
                    <img
                      ref={carveImgRef}
                      src={croppedImageSrc}
                      alt="Cropped"
                      className="max-w-full max-h-[calc(70vh-80px)] block pointer-events-none"
                      draggable={false}
                      onLoad={(e) => {
                        setCarveImageSize({
                          width: e.currentTarget.naturalWidth,
                          height: e.currentTarget.naturalHeight,
                        });
                      }}
                    />
                    
                    {/* Render Grid Lines */}
                    {carveImageSize.width > 0 && carveImageSize.height > 0 && (
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
                        <div className="relative w-full h-full">
                          {/* Row Cuts */}
                          {rowCuts.map((cutY, idx) => {
                            const isActive = dragging?.type === "row" && dragging.index === idx;
                            return (
                              <div
                                key={`line-r-${idx}`}
                                className={cn(
                                  "absolute left-0 right-0 z-10 group",
                                  isAdjusting && "pointer-events-auto cursor-row-resize"
                                )}
                                style={{ top: `${(cutY / carveImageSize.height) * 100}%` }}
                                onPointerDown={
                                  isAdjusting
                                    ? (e) => {
                                        e.preventDefault();
                                        setDragging({ type: "row", index: idx });
                                      }
                                    : undefined
                                }
                              >
                                {/* Visible line */}
                                <div
                                  className={cn(
                                    "absolute left-0 right-0 border-t-[6px] border-slate-950 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] -mt-[3px]",
                                    isActive && "border-slate-900"
                                  )}
                                >
                                  <div
                                    className={cn(
                                      "absolute inset-0 border-t-2 -mt-1",
                                      isActive ? "border-sky-300" : "border-sky-400/80",
                                      isAdjusting && "group-hover:border-sky-300"
                                    )}
                                  ></div>
                                </div>
                                {/* Drag handle */}
                                {isAdjusting && (
                                  <div
                                    className={cn(
                                      "absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-5 rounded-full border-2 shadow-lg transition-colors",
                                      isActive
                                        ? "bg-sky-400 border-sky-200 scale-110"
                                        : "bg-slate-950 border-sky-400 group-hover:bg-sky-500 group-hover:border-sky-300"
                                    )}
                                  >
                                    <GripHorizontal className={cn("w-3.5 h-3.5", isActive ? "text-slate-950" : "text-sky-400 group-hover:text-slate-950")} />
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            );
                          })}

                          {/* Col Cuts */}
                          {colCuts.map((cutX, idx) => {
                            const isActive = dragging?.type === "col" && dragging.index === idx;
                            return (
                              <div
                                key={`line-c-${idx}`}
                                className={cn(
                                  "absolute top-0 bottom-0 z-10 group",
                                  isAdjusting && "pointer-events-auto cursor-col-resize"
                                )}
                                style={{ left: `${(cutX / carveImageSize.width) * 100}%` }}
                                onPointerDown={
                                  isAdjusting
                                    ? (e) => {
                                        e.preventDefault();
                                        setDragging({ type: "col", index: idx });
                                      }
                                    : undefined
                                }
                              >
                                {/* Visible line */}
                                <div
                                  className={cn(
                                    "absolute top-0 bottom-0 border-l-[6px] border-slate-950 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] -ml-[3px]",
                                    isActive && "border-slate-900"
                                  )}
                                >
                                  <div
                                    className={cn(
                                      "absolute inset-0 border-l-2 -ml-1",
                                      isActive ? "border-sky-300" : "border-sky-400/80",
                                      isAdjusting && "group-hover:border-sky-300"
                                    )}
                                  ></div>
                                </div>
                                {/* Drag handle */}
                                {isAdjusting && (
                                  <div
                                    className={cn(
                                      "absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center justify-center w-5 h-9 rounded-full border-2 shadow-lg transition-colors",
                                      isActive
                                        ? "bg-sky-400 border-sky-200 scale-110"
                                        : "bg-slate-950 border-sky-400 group-hover:bg-sky-500 group-hover:border-sky-300"
                                    )}
                                  >
                                    <GripVertical className={cn("w-3.5 h-3.5", isActive ? "text-slate-950" : "text-sky-400 group-hover:text-slate-950")} />
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* Empty State */
        <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center">
            <label className="cursor-pointer bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all border border-sky-500 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg hover:shadow-sky-500/20 group text-sm">
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform" />
              Select Image to Begin
              <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={onSelectFile} className="hidden" />
            </label>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/ImageDescriber.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Eye, 
  Sparkles, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  Trash2, 
  Copy, 
  Download, 
  ChevronRight, 
  FileText, 
  X, 
  Check, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Info,
  Layers,
  Activity,
  Maximize2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useLanguage } from '../../contexts/LanguageContext';
import Markdown from 'react-markdown';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';

interface ImageDescriberProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface ImageFile {
  file: File;
  preview: string;
  base64: string;
}

const ANALYSIS_STYLES = [
  { id: 'detailed', name: '🔍 Ultra Detailed', description: 'Deconstructs every object, layout, color palette, lighting source, and texture in high-fidelity.' },
  { id: 'aesthetic', name: '✨ Aesthetic & Artistic', description: 'Critiques the creative composition, mood, historical style, color harmony, and artistic impact.' },
  { id: 'alt_text', name: '♿ Accessibility Alt-Text', description: 'Creates clear, concise, and professional alt-text/captions for screen readers and web use.' },
  { id: 'detective', name: '🕵️ Forensic Detection', description: 'Extracts text/OCR, identifies materials, estimates setting/location, and isolates subtle clues.' },
  { id: 'literal_explain', name: '📊 Straight Retell (Data & Context)', description: 'Conveys exactly what the image purveys. Perfect for charts, graphs, and diagrams. Explains embedded data and core messages directly without artistic details.' },
  { id: 'story', name: '📖 Narrative/Story Starter', description: 'Translates the visual setting and characters into rich, novelistic, descriptive prose.' }
];

export const ImageDescriber: React.FC<ImageDescriberProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  
  // States
  const [images, setImages] = useState<ImageFile[]>([]);
  const [analysisStyle, setAnalysisStyle] = useState('detailed');
  const [customFocus, setCustomFocus] = useState('');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);
  const [analysisStatus, setAnalysisStatus] = useState('');
  const [analysisOutput, setAnalysisOutput] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'preview' | 'raw'>('preview');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [savedToWorkspace, setSavedToWorkspace] = useState(false);
  
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // File uploading
  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;

    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
      
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {
        const preview = reader.result as string;
        const base64 = preview.split(',')[1];
        setImages(prev => [...prev, { file, preview, base64 }]);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });

    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
    setImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const buildPrompt = () => {
    let prompt = `You are a world-class visual analyst, art critic, and accessibility specialist.\n\n`;
    prompt += `Please analyze the provided image(s) very carefully and generate a highly professional description based on the requested style.\n\n`;

    const selectedItems = useSessionData 
      ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
          session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
        ) || [])
      : [];

    if (selectedItems.length > 0) {
      prompt += `### BACKGROUND SESSION CONTEXT:\nUse the following reference knowledge from the current user session to help identify specific objects, terminology, product names, logos, or formulas depicted in the image:\n`;
      selectedItems.forEach((item: MediaItem) => {
        prompt += `- Reference: ${item.name} (${item.type})\n`;
      });
      prompt += `\n`;
    }

    prompt += `### DESIRED ANALYSIS STYLE: `;
    if (analysisStyle === 'detailed') {
      prompt += `Ultra Detailed & Forensic\n`;
      prompt += `- Break down the image into sections (Foreground, Midground, Background).\n`;
      prompt += `- Identify all recognizable objects, human elements, expressions, or clothing.\n`;
      prompt += `- Detail the specific color palette (using hex references or descriptive color terms), ambient lighting direction, textures, and depth.\n`;
    } else if (analysisStyle === 'aesthetic') {
      prompt += `Artistic, Aesthetic & Composition Critique\n`;
      prompt += `- Analyze composition rules (e.g. rule of thirds, leading lines, framing, symmetry).\n`;
      prompt += `- Critique the creative style (e.g. impressionist, high-contrast cyberpunk, brutalist minimalist, editorial photography).\n`;
      prompt += `- Discuss the emotional resonance, atmospheric mood, and overall visual storytelling impact.\n`;
    } else if (analysisStyle === 'alt_text') {
      prompt += `Web Accessibility & Alt-Text\n`;
      prompt += `- Write a single concise 2-3 sentence description perfect for HTML 'alt' attributes (under 150 characters if possible, or up to 250 characters for complex visual graphics).\n`;
      prompt += `- Write a secondary "Extended Description" providing clear, objective screen-reader details without subjective artistic interpretation.\n`;
    } else if (analysisStyle === 'detective') {
      prompt += `Forensic Extraction & OCR Detection\n`;
      prompt += `- Transcribe any readable text, logos, signage, or typography present in the image.\n`;
      prompt += `- Isolate details: materials (e.g. wet concrete, brushed steel), time of day indicators, weather, technology clues, and architecture.\n`;
    } else if (analysisStyle === 'literal_explain') {
      prompt += `Straight Retell, Context & Data Extraction\n`;
      prompt += `- Explain the exact meaning, message, purpose, or data that the image is trying to purvey.\n`;
      prompt += `- If the image contains a chart, graph, diagram, map, slide, or UI screen, thoroughly identify the key data points, trends, legends, axes, table data, and relationships.\n`;
      prompt += `- Transcribe any embedded text or numbers, and summarize what is going on with the help of this data.\n`;
      prompt += `- STRICT RULE: Avoid describing any subjective design choices, aesthetic styles, moods, colors (unless functional like colored lines on a graph), lighting, or atmospheric qualities. Keep it purely functional, informative, and literal.\n`;
    } else {
      prompt += `Rich Narrative Prose\n`;
      prompt += `- Ignore cold, clinical labels. Turn the image into a vivid, atmospheric narrative story prompt.\n`;
      prompt += `- Focus on sensory descriptions: what the air feels like, the sounds that might echo, the hidden thoughts of characters.\n`;
    }

    if (customFocus.trim()) {
      prompt += `\n### CRITICAL FOCUS DIRECTIVE (User Requested):\n"${customFocus.trim()}"\n\n`;
    }

    prompt += `\n### OUTPUT RULES:\n`;
    prompt += `1. Structure your analysis elegantly using markdown with clear headings, bullets, and tables where applicable.\n`;
    prompt += `2. Do not use generic filler sentences. Start with the description immediately.\n`;
    prompt += `3. Return clean, polished Markdown. Do not include meta-notes or greetings.`;

    return prompt;
  };

  const startAnalysis = async () => {
    if (images.length === 0) return;
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    setSavedToWorkspace(false);

    const statuses = [
      'Scanning image pixels and dimensions...',
      'Deconstructing visual layers & outlines...',
      'Analyzing color composition and histograms...',
      'Isolating objects and architectural boundaries...',
      'Recognizing texts, materials, and expressions...',
      'Drafting your high-fidelity detailed description...'
    ];

    let statusIdx = 0;
    setAnalysisStatus(statuses[0]);
    const statusInterval = setInterval(() => {
      statusIdx = (statusIdx + 1) % statuses.length;
      setAnalysisStatus(statuses[statusIdx]);
    }, 2500);

    try {
      const promptText = buildPrompt();

      const localImageMediaItems: MediaItem[] = images.map((img, idx) => ({
        id: `local_desc_img_${idx}`,
        name: img.file.name,
        mimeType: img.file.type,
        type: 'image',
        data: img.base64
      }));

      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const allMediaItems = [...localImageMediaItems, ...selectedItems];

      const descriptionText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(promptText, allMediaItems);

      setAnalysisOutput(descriptionText || "No detailed description could be compiled. Please check your image format.");
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      alert(`Error analyzing images: ${err.message || err}`);
    } finally {
      clearInterval(statusInterval);
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
    }
  };

  const copyToClipboard = () => {
    if (!analysisOutput) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(analysisOutput);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const downloadAnalysisFile = () => {
    if (!analysisOutput) return;
    const element = document.createElement("a");
    const file = new Blob([analysisOutput], {type: 'text/plain'});
    element.href = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    element.download = `image_description_${Date.now()}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(element);
    element.click();
    document.body.removeChild(element);
  };

  const handleSaveToWorkspace = () => {
    if (!analysisOutput || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    const base64Data = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(analysisOutput)));
    const selectedStyle = ANALYSIS_STYLES.find(s => s.id === analysisStyle)?.name || 'Description';

    const item: MediaItem = {
      id: `img_desc_${Date.now()}`,
      name: `Image Description (${selectedStyle}).txt`,
      type: 'text',
      mimeType: 'text/plain',
      data: base64Data,
      tags: ['description', analysisStyle, 'image-analysis']
    };

    onSaveArtifact(item);
    setSavedToWorkspace(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 text-zinc-100">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-800 pb-6 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-400 to-sky-500 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-400 border border-teal-500/20">
              <Eye className="w-7 h-7" />
            </span>
            Multimodal Image Describer & Analyst
          </h2>
          <p className="text-zinc-400 text-sm mt-1">
            Submit storyboard frames, photography, UI mockups, or complex layouts to receive ultra-detailed, structured analyses, accessibility tags, or aesthetic critiques.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setImages([]);
            setCustomFocus('');
            setAnalysisOutput(null);
            setSavedToWorkspace(false);
          }}
          className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all"
        >
          Clear Panel
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Grid Layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
        
        {/* Left Side: Upload & Custom Parameters (5 Cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          
          {/* File Upload Box */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>1. Submit Images for Analysis</span>
              </label>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-medium">({images.length} added)</span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div 
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/InputArea.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Paperclip, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { AudioInput } from '../AudioInput';

interface InputAreaProps {
  onGenerate: (prompt: string, file?: File) => void;
  isGenerating: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export const InputArea: React.FC<InputAreaProps> = ({ onGenerate, isGenerating, disabled }) => {
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const selectedFile = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (selectedFile) {
      setFile(selectedFile);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {
        setPreview(reader.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(selectedFile);
    }
  };

  const clearFile = () => {
    setFile(null);
    setPreview(null);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!prompt.trim() && !file) return;
    onGenerate(prompt, file || undefined);
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {preview && (
          <div className="relative w-24 h-24 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 group">
            <img src={preview} alt="Preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
            <button 
              type="button" 
              onClick={clearFile}
              className="absolute top-1 right-1 p-1 bg-black/50 rounded-full text-white opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
            >
              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button 
            type="button"
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            disabled={isGenerating || disabled}
            className="p-2 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <Paperclip className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          
          <AudioInput 
            onTranscript={(text) => setPrompt(prev => prev ? `${prev} ${text}` : text)}
            placeholder="Speak your prompt..."
          />
          
          <input 
            type="text" 
            value={prompt}
            onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
            disabled={isGenerating || disabled}
            placeholder="A futuristic dashboard... / An interactive card game..."
            className="flex-1 bg-transparent border-none text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:ring-0 text-lg outline-none"
          />
          
          <button 
            type="submit"
            disabled={(isGenerating || disabled) || (!prompt.trim() && !file)}
            className={`
              flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all
              ${(prompt.trim() || file) && !isGenerating
                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/20 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95' 
                : 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 cursor-not-allowed'}
            `}
          >
            {isGenerating ? (
              <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/20 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <>
                <span>Generate</span>
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <input 
        type="file" 
        ref={fileInputRef}
        onChange={handleFileChange}
        accept="image/*"
        className="hidden" 
      />
    </form>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/LivePreview.tsx --- ###
import React from 'react';
import { X, RefreshCw, Download } from 'lucide-react';

export interface Creation {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  html: string;
  originalImage?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface LivePreviewProps {
  creation: Creation | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isFocused: boolean;
  onReset: () => void;
}

export const LivePreview: React.FC<LivePreviewProps> = ({ creation, isLoading, isFocused, onReset }) => {
  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!creation) return;
    const blob = new Blob([creation.html], { type: 'text/html' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${creation.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, "")}.html`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  if (!isFocused && !isLoading) return null;

  return (
    <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-zinc-950 flex flex-col transition-all duration-700 ${isFocused ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 pointer-events-none'}`}>
      {/* Top Bar */}
      <div className="flex-shrink-0 h-16 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between px-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button onClick={onReset} className="p-2 hover:bg-zinc-900 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-200">{creation?.name || 'Creating...'}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-600 tracking-widest leading-none">Gemini Studio</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {creation && (
            <>
              <button 
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-900 rounded-lg transition-all"
              >
                <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Export Code</span>
              </button>
              <div className="w-px h-4 bg-zinc-800 mx-2" />
            </>
          )}
          <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-500/80 uppercase tracking-tighter">Live Session</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Preview */}
      <div className="flex-1 relative bg-[#050505] overflow-hidden flex justify-center items-center">
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#050505] z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-6">
            <div className="relative">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 border-t-2 border-blue-500 rounded-full animate-spin" />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500/40 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1 text-center">
              <p className="text-lg font-medium text-zinc-200 animate-pulse">Bringing your idea to life...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Gemini is architecting your interface</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {creation && (
          <iframe 
            srcDoc={creation.html}
            title="Preview"
            className={`w-full h-full border-none shadow-2xl bg-white ${isLoading ? 'hidden' : 'block'}`}
            sandbox="allow-scripts allow-modals allow-forms"
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/MarketingCopywriter.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Layout, Eye, MessageSquare, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface MarketingCopywriterProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface CopyResult {
  headlines: string[];
  adBody: string;
  hooks: string[];
  callToAction: string;
  keywords: string[];
}

export const MarketingCopywriter: React.FC<MarketingCopywriterProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [framework, setFramework] = useState('AIDA');
  const [channel, setChannel] = useState('google');
  const [customBrief, setCustomBrief] = useState('');
  const [targetAudience, setTargetAudience] = useState('General tech consumers / SaaS professionals');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<CopyResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSection, setCopiedSection] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an elite Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Copywriter and Performance Marketer.
Analyze the provided ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'} and generate high-converting ad copy, headlines, and descriptions.

MARKETING SPECIFICATIONS:
- Copywriting Framework: ${framework === 'AIDA' ? 'AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action)' : framework === 'PAS' ? 'PAS (Problem, Agitate, Solve)' : 'Feature-Benefit (Feature matching emotional outcomes)'}
- Channel Format: ${channel === 'google' ? 'Google Search Text Ad (Headline max 30 chars, description max 90 chars)' : channel === 'facebook' ? 'Facebook Sponsored Post (Hook, Agitate, Image Copy, Link description)' : 'SaaS Landing Page Hero Block (Headline, Sub-headline, Key bullets, Call to action)'}
- Target Audience Persona: ${targetAudience}
- Product Focus/Brief: ${customBrief || 'Emphasize the core value propositions and strategic insights discovered in the sources.'}

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the copy elements as a structured JSON object wrapped inside a codeblock.
The object must follow this strict TypeScript structure:
{
  "headlines": [
    "Headline option 1 (Max 30-40 characters)",
    "Headline option 2",
    "Headline option 3"
  ],
  "adBody": "The primary high-converting body text. Use spacing, hooks, and bullets where relevant.",
  "hooks": [
    "Compelling hook 1 (Curiosity-based)",
    "Compelling hook 2 (Problem-based)",
    "Compelling hook 3 (Data-based)"
  ],
  "callToAction": "High-conversion CTA button text",
  "keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2", "keyword3", "keyword4"]
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (parsedData && parsedData.headlines && parsedData.adBody) {
        setResult(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed data was not structured correctly.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to compile copy drafts. Check your configuration or product brief and try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, sectionId: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedSection(sectionId);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedSection(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!result) return;

    let text = `=========================================\n`;
    text += `MARKETING COPY SUITE: ${framework} // Channel: ${channel}\n`;
    text += `=========================================\n\n`;

    text += `### HEADLINES:\n`;
    result.headlines.forEach((hl, i) => {
      text += `${i + 1}. ${hl}\n`;
    });
    text += `\n`;

    text += `### HOOKS / VALUE PROPS:\n`;
    result.hooks.forEach((hook, i) => {
      text += `- ${hook}\n`;
    });
    text += `\n`;

    text += `### PRIMARY COPY BODY:\n`;
    text += `${result.adBody}\n\n`;

    text += `### CALL TO ACTION:\n`;
    text += `[ ${result.callToAction} ]\n\n`;

    text += `### RECOMMENDED KEYWORDS:\n`;
    text += `${result.keywords.join(', ')}\n`;

    const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `marketing-copy-${framework}-${Date.now()}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!result || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Marketing Copy suite</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 2rem; }
        .block-card { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <h1 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-rose-500 mb-2">📢 High-Conversion Marketing copy</h1>
        <p class="text-gray-400 mb-6">Generated using the ${framework} copywriting framework optimized for ${channel}.</p>
        
        <div class="block-card">
            <h2 class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Copy Highlights</h2>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                    <h3 class="text-rose-400 font-bold mb-2">Headlines</h3>
                    <ul class="space-y-1.5 text-sm list-disc pl-5 text-gray-300">
                        ${result.headlines.map(hl => `<li>${hl}</li>`).join('')}
                    </ul>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h3 class="text-rose-400 font-bold mb-2">Core Hooks</h3>
                    <ul class="space-y-1.5 text-sm list-disc pl-5 text-gray-300">
                        ${result.hooks.map(hook => `<li>${hook}</li>`).join('')}
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="block-card">
            <h2 class="text-sm font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Primary Copy Body</h2>
            <p class="text-gray-200 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">${result.adBody}</p>
            <div class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-500">CTA: <strong>${result.callToAction}</strong></span>
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-500">Keywords: ${result.keywords.join(', ')}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Copy: ${framework} - ${channel}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-400">
            <Layout className="w-6 h-6" /> Marketing Copywriter
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Produce ad creatives, landing page pitches, and Google or social sponsors driven by structural CRO frameworks.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {result && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download TXT
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-rose-600/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save Mockups'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">

        {/* Left Side: Setup */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" /> Creative Parameters
            </h3>

            {/* Knowledge base status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-rose-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected. Using general industry templates.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Copywriting Framework */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Copywriting Framework</label>
              <select
                value={framework}
                onChange={(e) => setFramework(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
              >
                <option value="AIDA">AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action)</option>
                <option value="PAS">PAS (Problem, Agitate, Solve)</option>
                <option value="Feature-Benefit">Feature-Benefit (Translates stats to emotion)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Target Channel */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Ad Format / Target Channel</label>
              <select
                value={channel}
                onChange={(e) => setChannel(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
              >
                <option value="google">🖥️ Google Search Ads (Responsive text ad)</option>
                <option value="facebook">📱 Facebook Sponsored Post (Graphic captions + Link title)</option>
                <option value="landing">🏠 Landing Page Hero Copy (High-conversion Header & Call to Action)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Target Audience */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Target Audience Persona</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={targetAudience}
                onChange={(e) => setTargetAudience(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
                placeholder="e.g. Enterprise HR directors, SaaS founders, etc."
              />
            </div>

            {/* Custom Brief */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Product Specific Brief / Instructions</label>
              <textarea
                value={customBrief}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomBrief(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Specify key product features, unique points, or value claims..."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Generation CTA */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 disabled:bg-rose-850/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Weaving High-CRO Copy...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate Copy Suite
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Side: Interactive Mockup Board */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-rose-500/20 border-t-rose-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Writing Conversion Copy...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Parsing source facts and deploying marketing formulas to optimize cognitive engagement and click-through rates.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && !isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Copywriting Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !error && !result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <Layout className="w-12 h-12 text-rose-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">CRO Sandbox & Ad Mockups</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Configure your copywriting recipe on the left to see live-updating visual mockups for Google Ads, Facebook Sponsors, or Landing Pages.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && result && (
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-6">
              
              {/* Dynamic Mockup Presentation */}
              <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-6 shadow-xl">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400 mb-4 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Eye className="w-4 h-4" /> Live Platform Preview Mockup
                </h4>

                {/* Google Search Ad Mockup */}
                {channel === 'google' && (
                  <div className="bg-zinc-950 p-4 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 text-left space-y-1.5 font-sans">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                      <span>Ad</span>
                      <span>·</span>
                      <span className="text-zinc-500">https://www.yourdomain.com</span>
                    </div>
                    <a href="#" className="text-blue-400 hover:underline font-medium text-base block truncate">
                      {result.headlines[0]} | {result.headlines[1] || 'Transform Your Workflow'}
                    </a>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed max-w-xl">
                      {result.adBody.slice(0, 160)}...
                    </p>
                    <div className="pt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                      <span>Sitelinks:</span>
                      <span className="text-blue-500 hover:underline cursor-pointer">{result.callToAction}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Facebook Mockup */}
                {channel === 'facebook' && (
                  <div className="bg-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 font-sans max-w-md mx-auto">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                      <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center justify-center">
                        <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <h5 className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200">Sponsored Solutions</h5>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">Sponsored · Paid</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Caption */}
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-200 whitespace-pre-wrap mb-4 leading-relaxed">
                      {result.adBody}
                    </p>

                    {/* Image Placeholder */}
                    <div className="aspect-video bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 p-4 mb-3 text-center">
                      <Sparkles className="w-8 h-8 text-rose-500/30 animate-pulse" />
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">{result.headlines[0]}</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-600 max-w-xs">{result.hooks[0]}</span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Bottom Link Preview */}
                    <div className="bg-zinc-950 p-3 border-t border-zinc-800 flex justify-between items-center rounded-b">
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pr-2">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 uppercase truncate">YOURDOMAIN.COM</p>
                        <h6 className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 truncate">{result.headlines[1] || result.headlines[0]}</h6>
                      </div>
                      <button className="bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-[11px] font-semibold shrink-0">
                        {result.callToAction}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Landing Page Hero Mockup */}
                {channel === 'landing' && (
                  <div className="bg-zinc-950 p-6 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 text-center font-sans space-y-4 max-w-xl mx-auto py-10">
                    <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-400 border border-rose-900/40 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                      {framework} Framework Release
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight leading-tight px-4">
                      {result.headlines[0]}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                      {result.adBody.slice(0, 180)}...
                    </p>
                    
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 justify-center pt-2">
                      <button className="px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow">
                        {result.callToAction}
                      </button>
                      <button className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 rounded text-xs font-semibold">
                        Learn More
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Grid of headlines & parameters */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {/* Headlines List */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400 mb-3">Copy Alternatives</h4>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {result.headlines.map((hl, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 bg-app-bg rounded border border-app-border hover:border-rose-500/20 text-xs transition-all">
                        <span className="text-app-text font-semibold truncate flex-1 mr-2">{hl}</span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(hl, `hl-${i}`)}
                          className="text-[10px] text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 font-bold shrink-0 flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          {copiedSection === `hl-${i}` ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                          Copy
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Hooks List */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400 mb-3">Conversion Hooks</h4>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {result.hooks.map((hook, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="flex justify-between items-center p-2.5 bg-app-bg rounded border border-app-border hover:border-rose-500/20 text-xs transition-all">
                        <span className="text-app-dim truncate flex-1 mr-2">{hook}</span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(hook, `hook-${i}`)}
                          className="text-[10px] text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 font-bold shrink-0 flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          {copiedSection === `hook-${i}` ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                          Copy
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Full Text Copy Area */}
              <div className="p-4 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400">Primary Ad Body / Content Draft</h4>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(result.adBody, 'body')}
                    className="text-xs text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
                  >
                    {copiedSection === 'body' ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    Copy Complete Body
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs text-app-text whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed max-h-[150px] overflow-y-auto">
                  {result.adBody}
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
