### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/ProductResearchTool.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Search, TrendingUp, Target, Zap, RefreshCw, Copy, CheckCircle, Download, Save, Lightbulb, BarChart2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateResponse } from '../../services/gemini';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import Markdown from 'react-markdown';

interface ProductResearchToolProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

export const ProductResearchTool: React.FC<ProductResearchToolProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [activeMode, setActiveMode] = useState<'research' | 'validator'>('research');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  // Research Mode State
  const [topic, setTopic] = useState('');
  const [niche, setNiche] = useState('');
  const [agentType, setAgentType] = useState('Trend Analyst');
  
  // Validator Mode State
  const [productIdea, setProductIdea] = useState('');
  const [targetAudience, setTargetAudience] = useState('');
  const [keyFeature, setKeyFeature] = useState('');

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  const handleRun = async () => {
    if (activeMode === 'research' && !topic.trim()) return;
    if (activeMode === 'validator' && !productIdea.trim()) return;
    
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setResult(null);
    setCopied(false);
    setSaved(false);
    
    try {
      let prompt = '';
      
      if (activeMode === 'research') {
        prompt = `You are a world-class ${agentType}. 
Conduct deep product research and market gap analysis on the following topic: "${topic}".
Niche Focus: ${niche || 'General/Broad'}.

Please provide a comprehensive report including:
1. **Trend Analysis:** Current market trajectory, search interest, and emerging sub-trends.
2. **Demand Scoring:** A quantifiable score (1-100) of market demand with reasoning.
3. **Market Gap Finder:** Specific underserved areas, unmet customer needs, or missing features in current solutions.
4. **Competitor Analysis:** What existing competitors are doing wrong or right.
5. **Profitable Niches:** Actionable digital product ideas (SaaS, courses, ebooks, tools) that can capitalize on this research.

Format your response in clean markdown. Ensure the tone is analytical, professional, and highly actionable.`;
      } else {
        prompt = `You are an expert Product Validator and Market Strategist.
Please validate the following digital product idea before the user builds it.

**Product Idea:** ${productIdea}
**Target Audience:** ${targetAudience || 'General/Broad'}
**Core Key Feature:** ${keyFeature || 'Not specified'}

Provide a strict, realistic validation report including:
1. **Demand Score (0-100):** How much do people actually want this? Include a breakdown of why.
2. **Competitor Analysis:** Who is already doing this, what are they missing, and how hard is it to compete?
3. **Pricing Benchmarks:** Suggested pricing models (e.g., subscription vs one-time) and realistic price points based on market standards.
4. **Technical Feasibility:** Potential roadblocks in building this product.
5. **Go/No-Go Recommendation:** A final verdict on whether this idea is worth pursuing or needs to pivot.

Format your response in clean markdown. Ensure the tone is objective, critical, and highly informative.`;
      }

      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      if (selectedItems.length > 0) {
        prompt += `\n\n### ADDITIONAL SESSION CONTEXT:\nUse the following reference files from the active session to inform, ground, and target your research/validation report:\n`;
        selectedItems.forEach((item: MediaItem) => {
          prompt += `- [${item.type.toUpperCase()}] ${item.name}\n`;
        });
      }

      const reportText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);
      setResult(reportText);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setResult('Error during generation. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    if (result) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(result);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (result) {
      const blob = new Blob([result], { type: 'text/markdown' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      const fileName = activeMode === 'research' 
        ? `product-research-${topic.replace(/\\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase()}.md`
        : `idea-validation-${productIdea.replace(/\\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase()}.md`;
      a.download = fileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (result && onSaveArtifact) {
      const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(result);
      const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));
      
      const artifactName = activeMode === 'research' ? `Research: ${topic}` : `Validation: ${productIdea}`;
      
      const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
        id: Date.now().toString(),
        name: artifactName,
        mimeType: 'text/markdown',
        type: 'text',
        data: base64Data
      };
      onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
      setSaved(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6 px-2">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-400">
          <Search className="w-6 h-6" /> Product Strategy Hub
        </h2>
        
        <div className="flex bg-app-card p-1 rounded-lg border border-app-border">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveMode('research')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeMode === 'research' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md' : 'text-app-dim hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Search className="w-4 h-4" /> Market Research
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveMode('validator')}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 ${
              activeMode === 'validator' ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-md' : 'text-app-dim hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Lightbulb className="w-4 h-4" /> Idea Validator
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="md:col-span-1 space-y-4">
          {activeMode === 'research' ? (
            <>
              <div className="bg-app-card p-4 rounded-xl border border-indigo-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.1)] transition-all">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold mb-2 text-indigo-300">Topic or Seed Idea</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={topic}
                  onChange={(e) => setTopic(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. AI-powered meditation"
                  className="w-full bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-2 text-sm focus:border-indigo-500 outline-none transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="bg-app-card p-4 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.1)] transition-all">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold mb-2 text-purple-300">Target Niche (Optional)</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={niche}
                  onChange={(e) => setNiche(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Remote workers, Developers"
                  className="w-full bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-2 text-sm focus:border-purple-500 outline-none transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="bg-app-card p-4 rounded-xl border border-cyan-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.1)] transition-all">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold mb-2 text-cyan-300">Research Agent</label>
                <select 
                  value={agentType}
                  onChange={(e) => setAgentType(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-2 text-sm focus:border-cyan-500 outline-none transition-colors"
                >
                  <option value="Trend Analyst">Trend Analyst</option>
                  <option value="Market Gap Finder">Market Gap Finder</option>
                  <option value="Product Strategist">Product Strategist</option>
                  <option value="Competitor Researcher">Competitor Researcher</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="bg-app-card p-4 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.1)] transition-all">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold mb-2 text-purple-300">Product Idea</label>
                <textarea 
                  value={productIdea}
                  onChange={(e) => setProductIdea(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. A micro-SaaS that auto-generates podcast shownotes from audio..."
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-2 text-sm focus:border-purple-500 outline-none transition-colors custom-scrollbar resize-none"
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="bg-app-card p-4 rounded-xl border border-pink-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(236,72,153,0.1)] transition-all">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold mb-2 text-pink-300">Target Audience (Optional)</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={targetAudience}
                  onChange={(e) => setTargetAudience(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Indie hackers, Content creators"
                  className="w-full bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-2 text-sm focus:border-pink-500 outline-none transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="bg-app-card p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.1)] transition-all">
                <label className="block text-sm font-bold mb-2 text-amber-300">Key Feature (Optional)</label>
                <input 
                  type="text" 
                  value={keyFeature}
                  onChange={(e) => setKeyFeature(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. 1-click publishing to WordPress"
                  className="w-full bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-2 text-sm focus:border-amber-500 outline-none transition-colors"
                />
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {/* SESSION CONTEXT CONNECTOR */}
          {session && (
            <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-4 rounded-xl space-y-3 shadow-xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />
                  <span>Use Session Context</span>
                </label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold uppercase">Enable</span>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={useSessionData}
                    onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500 bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-800 rounded focus:ring-rose-500 focus:ring-2 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {useSessionData ? (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 bg-rose-950/10 border border-rose-950/40 p-2.5 rounded-lg">
                  Using <strong className="text-rose-400">{(session?.selectedMediaIds?.length || 0)} selected reference(s)</strong> from active session (<strong className="text-rose-400">{session?.name}</strong>) to ground product analysis reports.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 italic bg-zinc-900/20 p-2.5 rounded-lg">
                  Session data integration is disabled. Enable to inject active workspace knowledge.
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          
          <button 
            onClick={handleRun}
            disabled={activeMode === 'research' ? !topic.trim() : !productIdea.trim() || isProcessing}
            className={`w-full text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-xl disabled:opacity-50 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg ${
              activeMode === 'research' 
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-cyan-600 hover:from-indigo-500 hover:to-cyan-500 shadow-indigo-500/20' 
                : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-pink-600 hover:from-purple-500 hover:to-pink-500 shadow-purple-500/20'
            }`}
          >
            {isProcessing ? (
              <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
            ) : activeMode === 'research' ? (
              <Search className="w-5 h-5" />
            ) : (
              <BarChart2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            )}
            {isProcessing ? 'Processing...' : activeMode === 'research' ? 'Start Research' : 'Validate Idea'}
          </button>
        </div>
        
        {/* Results */}
        <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-app-card rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.1)] flex flex-col min-h-[500px] overflow-hidden">
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-app-border flex justify-between items-center bg-app-panel">
            <h3 className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400">
              {activeMode === 'research' ? <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5" /> : <BarChart2 className="w-5 h-5" />}
              {activeMode === 'research' ? 'Research Intelligence' : 'Validation Report'}
            </h3>
            
            {result && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={handleCopy}
                  className="p-1.5 hover:bg-app-bg rounded-lg text-app-dim hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  title="Copy to Clipboard"
                >
                  {copied ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleDownload}
                  className="p-1.5 hover:bg-app-bg rounded-lg text-app-dim hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  title="Download as Markdown"
                >
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
                {onSaveArtifact && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                    className="p-1.5 hover:bg-app-bg rounded-lg text-app-dim hover:text-white transition-colors"
                    title="Save to Session"
                  >
                    {saved ? <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Save className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          
          <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
            {isProcessing ? (
              <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-app-dim">
                <RefreshCw className="w-10 h-10 animate-spin mb-4 text-emerald-500" />
                <p>
                  {activeMode === 'research' 
                    ? `Deploying ${agentType} to scan markets...` 
                    : 'Analyzing market viability and crunching demand scores...'}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : result ? (
              <div className="prose prose-invert max-w-none text-sm markdown-body">
                <Markdown>{result}</Markdown>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-app-dim">
                {activeMode === 'research' ? (
                  <Target className="w-12 h-12 mb-4 opacity-50 text-emerald-500/50" />
                ) : (
                  <Lightbulb className="w-12 h-12 mb-4 opacity-50 text-emerald-500/50" />
                )}
                <p>
                  {activeMode === 'research' 
                    ? 'Enter a topic to generate actionable market insights.' 
                    : 'Describe your product idea to get an instant validation report.'}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- END FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/ProductResearchTool.tsx --- ###


### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/QuizAssessmentCreator.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { BookOpen, Check, HelpCircle, RefreshCw, Award, Copy, Download, Save, Play, ChevronRight, MessageSquare, Layers, AlertCircle, Eye } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface QuizAssessmentCreatorProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface QuizQuestion {
  id: number;
  question: string;
  options: string[];
  correctAnswerIndex: number;
  explanation: string;
}

interface Flashcard {
  id: number;
  front: string;
  back: string;
}

export const QuizAssessmentCreator: React.FC<QuizAssessmentCreatorProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [assessmentType, setAssessmentType] = useState<'quiz' | 'flashcards'>('quiz');
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState('Intermediate');
  const [questionCount, setQuestionCount] = useState(5);
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<QuizQuestion[]>([]);
  const [flashcards, setFlashcards] = useState<Flashcard[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Quiz Gameplay State
  const [quizStarted, setQuizStarted] = useState(false);
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [answered, setAnswered] = useState(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [quizFinished, setQuizFinished] = useState(false);

  // Flashcards gameplay state
  const [flippedCards, setFlippedCards] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setQuestions([]);
    setFlashcards([]);
    setQuizStarted(false);
    setQuizFinished(false);
    setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
    setScore(0);
    setAnswered(false);
    setSelectedOption(null);
    setFlippedCards({});

    try {
      // Gather selected media
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      let prompt = '';
      if (assessmentType === 'quiz') {
        prompt = `Act as an expert Instructional Designer. 
Based on the ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'provided source materials' : 'specifications'}, create a highly accurate, structured Multiple-Choice Quiz.

USER SPECIFICATIONS:
- Difficulty Level: ${difficulty}
- Number of Questions: ${questionCount}

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the quiz as a JSON array inside a clear codeblock wrapper. Each element in the array must be an object matching this strict typescript structure:
interface QuizQuestion {
  id: number;
  question: string;
  options: string[]; // Exactly 4 choices
  correctAnswerIndex: number; // 0-indexed index of the correct option
  explanation: string; // Explaining why the answer is correct
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;
      } else {
        prompt = `Act as an expert Instructional Designer.
Based on the ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'provided source materials' : 'specifications'}, create a set of highly informative Study Flashcards.

USER SPECIFICATIONS:
- Difficulty Level: ${difficulty}
- Number of Cards: ${questionCount}

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the cards as a JSON array inside a clear codeblock wrapper. Each element in the array must be an object matching this strict typescript structure:
interface Flashcard {
  id: number;
  front: string; // Term or Question
  back: string; // Explanation, context, or answer
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;
      }

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON from response
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\[([\s\S]*?)\]/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (assessmentType === 'quiz') {
        if (Array.isArray(parsedData)) {
          setQuestions(parsedData);
        } else {
          throw new Error("Parsed data was not a valid array.");
        }
      } else {
        if (Array.isArray(parsedData)) {
          setFlashcards(parsedData);
        } else {
          throw new Error("Parsed data was not a valid array.");
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to parse response into a structured interactive format. This can happen occasionally. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (idx: number) => {
    if (answered) return;
    setSelectedOption(idx);
  };

  const handleCheckAnswer = () => {
    if (selectedOption === null || answered) return;
    setAnswered(true);
    const correct = selectedOption === questions[currentQuestionIndex].correctAnswerIndex;
    if (correct) {
      setScore(prev => prev + 1);
    }
  };

  const handleNextQuestion = () => {
    setAnswered(false);
    setSelectedOption(null);
    if (currentQuestionIndex < questions.length - 1) {
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(prev => prev + 1);
    } else {
      setQuizFinished(true);
    }
  };

  const toggleFlashcard = (id: number) => {
    setFlippedCards(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [id]: !prev[id]
    }));
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Interactive Study Guide & Assessment</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 2rem; }
        .quiz-card { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
        h1 { font-size: 1.75rem; color: #f59e0b; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 2px solid #eab308; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <h1>🎓 Study Assessment Suite: ${difficulty}</h1>
        
        ${assessmentType === 'quiz' ? `
        <div class="space-y-6">
            ${questions.map((q, i) => `
            <div class="quiz-card">
                <p class="font-bold mb-3">${i + 1}. ${q.question}</p>
                <div class="space-y-2 mb-3">
                    ${q.options.map((opt, oIdx) => `
                    <div class="p-2 rounded text-sm ${oIdx === q.correctAnswerIndex ? 'bg-green-900/40 text-green-400 border border-green-800' : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400'}">
                        ${opt} ${oIdx === q.correctAnswerIndex ? '✓' : ''}
                    </div>
                    `).join('')}
                </div>
                <div class="text-xs text-amber-400 italic">Explanation: ${q.explanation}</div>
            </div>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
        ` : `
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            ${flashcards.map(c => `
            <div class="p-4 bg-[#111827] border border-gray-700 rounded-lg">
                <div class="text-amber-400 font-bold text-xs mb-1">FRONT:</div>
                <div class="font-semibold mb-3">${c.front}</div>
                <div class="text-zinc-500 font-bold text-xs mb-1 border-t border-zinc-800 pt-2">BACK:</div>
                <div class="text-sm text-zinc-300">${c.back}</div>
            </div>
            `).join('')}
        </div>
        `}
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const name = assessmentType === 'quiz' ? `Quiz Assessment (${difficulty})` : `Study Flashcards (${difficulty})`;
    
    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    alert("Saved interactive study resource to your session artifacts!");
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-yellow-400">
            <BookOpen className="w-6 h-6" /> Quiz & Assessment Suite
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Build and play interactive custom challenges based on the core knowledge in your session sources.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {((assessmentType === 'quiz' && questions.length > 0) || (assessmentType === 'flashcards' && flashcards.length > 0)) && (
            <button
              onClick={handleSaveToSession}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-yellow-600/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/30 hover:bg-yellow-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Save Study Guide
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">
        
        {/* Left Side: Setup Column */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2">
              Setup Parameters
            </h3>

            {/* Context status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim">
              <strong>Source material context:</strong>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `Active session: grounded with ${selectedItemsCount} selected media reference(s).`
                  : '⚠️ No media selected. Go back to your session to pick reference files for the quiz.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Mode Select */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold mb-1.5">Assessment Type</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 bg-app-bg p-1 rounded border border-app-border">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAssessmentType('quiz')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    assessmentType === 'quiz'
                      ? 'bg-yellow-600 text-white shadow'
                      : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  Interactive Quiz
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAssessmentType('flashcards')}
                  className={`py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    assessmentType === 'flashcards'
                      ? 'bg-yellow-600 text-white shadow'
                      : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  Flashcards Set
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Knowledge base status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong className="text-app-text">Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-yellow-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-yellow-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected. Assessment will run on general templates.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Difficulty */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold mb-1.5">Cognitive Difficulty</label>
              <select
                value={difficulty}
                onChange={(e) => setDifficulty(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-yellow-500"
              >
                <option value="Beginner">🌱 Beginner (Basic Recall & Terms)</option>
                <option value="Intermediate">🧠 Intermediate (Understanding & Context)</option>
                <option value="Advanced">🔥 Advanced (Critical Analysis & Edge Cases)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Question Count */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold mb-1.5">Number of Items</label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {[3, 5, 8, 10].map(count => (
                  <button
                    key={count}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setQuestionCount(count)}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold border ${
                      questionCount === count
                        ? 'bg-yellow-600/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500/50'
                        : 'bg-app-input text-app-dim border-app-border hover:text-app-text'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {count}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Run Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-500 disabled:bg-yellow-850/40 text-black font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-yellow-900/10"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Generating Study Guide...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Compile Assessment
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Side: Execution & Interactive Playing Area */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          
          {/* Processing Screen */}
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-yellow-500/20 border-t-yellow-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Formulating Quiz Questions & Explanations...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Parsing source terms, cross-referencing insights, and mapping distactor answers for an accurate learning challenge.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Error display */}
          {error && !isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Generation Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry Compile
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Idle screen */}
          {!isProcessing && !error && questions.length === 0 && flashcards.length === 0 && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <Layers className="w-12 h-12 text-yellow-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Assessment Sandbox</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Generate custom multi-choice questions or vocabulary decks to test your recollection of the source documents.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* PLAYABLE QUIZ SCREEN */}
          {!isProcessing && questions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6 justify-between">
              
              {!quizStarted ? (
                /* Quiz Intro Splash */
                <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-4 max-w-md mx-auto">
                  <Award className="w-12 h-12 text-yellow-500 animate-bounce" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-app-text">Quiz is Ready!</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-app-dim mt-1">
                      You have a {questions.length}-question challenge compiled at <strong>{difficulty}</strong> cognitive difficulty. Let's see how much you remembered.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setQuizStarted(true)}
                    className="px-6 py-2 bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold text-xs rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                  >
                    Start Challenge <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : quizFinished ? (
                /* Quiz Complete Score Splash */
                <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-4 max-w-md mx-auto">
                  <Award className="w-16 h-16 text-yellow-500 animate-pulse" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-2xl font-black text-app-text">Challenge Complete!</h4>
                    <p className="text-lg font-bold text-yellow-400 mt-1">Your Score: {score} / {questions.length}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-app-dim mt-2">
                      {score === questions.length 
                        ? "🏆 Outstanding! Flawless recollection of the aggregate data."
                        : score >= questions.length / 2 
                          ? "👍 Great job! You captured the main core mechanics."
                          : "📚 Time to review. Your sources still hold secrets."}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setQuizStarted(false);
                        setQuizFinished(false);
                        setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
                        setScore(0);
                        setAnswered(false);
                        setSelectedOption(null);
                      }}
                      className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text transition-colors"
                    >
                      Reset Quiz
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={handleGenerate}
                      className="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-600 text-black font-bold text-xs rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-500 transition-colors"
                    >
                      Generate New
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                /* Active Question Wizard */
                <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
                  {/* Progress Header */}
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-app-border pb-3">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-yellow-400 tracking-wider uppercase">
                      Question {currentQuestionIndex + 1} of {questions.length}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono text-app-dim">Score: {score}</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Question Title */}
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <h4 className="text-base md:text-lg font-bold text-app-text leading-snug">
                      {questions[currentQuestionIndex].question}
                    </h4>

                    {/* Options Grid */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      {questions[currentQuestionIndex].options.map((opt, idx) => {
                        const isSelected = selectedOption === idx;
                        const showCorrect = answered && idx === questions[currentQuestionIndex].correctAnswerIndex;
                        const showIncorrect = answered && isSelected && idx !== questions[currentQuestionIndex].correctAnswerIndex;

                        return (
                          <button
                            key={idx}
                            onClick={() => handleSelectOption(idx)}
                            disabled={answered}
                            className={`p-3 text-left text-xs rounded-lg border transition-all flex items-center justify-between ${
                              showCorrect
                                ? 'bg-green-600/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/50 shadow shadow-green-950/25'
                                : showIncorrect
                                  ? 'bg-red-600/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/50 shadow shadow-red-950/25'
                                  : isSelected
                                    ? 'bg-yellow-600/20 text-yellow-400 border-yellow-500'
                                    : 'bg-app-bg text-app-text border-app-border hover:border-yellow-500/50 hover:bg-app-input'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span>{opt}</span>
                            {showCorrect && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-green-400 flex-shrink-0" />}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Feedback explanation box */}
                  <div className="h-20 flex flex-col justify-center">
                    {answered && (
                      <div className="bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg p-3 text-xs flex gap-2 animate-fade-in">
                        <HelpCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-app-text mr-1">
                            {selectedOption === questions[currentQuestionIndex].correctAnswerIndex ? 'Correct!' : 'Incorrect.'}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-app-dim">{questions[currentQuestionIndex].explanation}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Wizard Buttons */}
                  <div className="border-t border-app-border pt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
                    {!answered ? (
                      <button
                        onClick={handleCheckAnswer}
                        disabled={selectedOption === null}
                        className="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-500 disabled:bg-yellow-800/45 text-black font-bold text-xs rounded"
                      >
                        Submit Answer
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        onClick={handleNextQuestion}
                        className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-app-text font-bold text-xs rounded flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        {currentQuestionIndex === questions.length - 1 ? 'Finish Results' : 'Next Question'} <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                </div>
              )}

            </div>
          )}

          {/* FLASHCARDS SCREEN */}
          {!isProcessing && flashcards.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6 justify-between space-y-4">
              
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-app-border pb-3">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-yellow-400 tracking-wider uppercase">
                  Vocab & Terms Flashcard Deck
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-app-dim">{flashcards.length} cards generated</span>
              </div>

              {/* Flashcards Grid with 3D Flip style */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto max-h-[380px] p-1">
                {flashcards.map(card => {
                  const isFlipped = flippedCards[card.id] || false;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={card.id}
                      onClick={() => toggleFlashcard(card.id)}
                      className="cursor-pointer h-40 group [perspective:1000px]"
                    >
                      <div className={`relative w-full h-full text-center transition-transform duration-500 [transform-style:preserve-3d] ${
                        isFlipped ? '[transform:rotateY(180deg)]' : ''
                      }`}>
                        
                        {/* CARD FRONT */}
                        <div className="absolute w-full h-full rounded-xl bg-app-bg border border-app-border hover:border-yellow-500/50 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between [backface-visibility:hidden]">
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-yellow-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-left">TERM / CONCEPT</div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-app-text leading-snug px-2 flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
                            {card.front}
                          </p>
                          <div className="text-[9px] text-app-dim text-right font-mono">Click card to reveal definition</div>
                        </div>

                        {/* CARD BACK */}
                        <div className="absolute w-full h-full rounded-xl bg-yellow-600/10 border border-yellow-500/30 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between [backface-visibility:hidden] [transform:rotateY(180deg)]">
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-yellow-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-left">DEFINITION / CONTEXT</div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-app-text leading-relaxed px-1 flex-1 flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto">
                            {card.back}
                          </p>
                          <div className="text-[9px] text-yellow-400/60 text-right font-mono">Click card to flip back</div>
                        </div>

                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Reset/New buttons */}
              <div className="border-t border-app-border pt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setFlippedCards({})}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-bg border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold text-app-text"
                >
                  Flip All Front
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleGenerate}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold text-xs"
                >
                  Generate New Deck
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

];

export const ScriptWriter: React.FC<ScriptWriterProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact, onRunTool }) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  
  // State variables
  const [plot, setPlot] = useState('');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);
  const [images, setImages] = useState<ImageUpload[]>([]);
  const [selectedIdeas, setSelectedIdeas] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [genre, setGenre] = useState('Sci-Fi');
  const [tone, setTone] = useState('Cinematic');
  const [format, setFormat] = useState('Screenplay');
  const [pacing, setPacing] = useState('Balanced');
  const [characters, setCharacters] = useState<Character[]>([
    { name: 'Protagonist', role: 'Main seeker' }
  ]);
  const [newCharName, setNewCharName] = useState('');
  const [newCharRole, setNewCharRole] = useState('');
  
  const [isCompiling, setIsCompiling] = useState(false);
  const [compileStatus, setCompileStatus] = useState('');
  const [generatedScript, setGeneratedScript] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'preview' | 'raw'>('preview');
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [savedToWorkspace, setSavedToWorkspace] = useState(false);
  const [scriptTheme, setScriptTheme] = useState<'default' | 'courier' | 'cyberpunk' | 'emerald'>('emerald');

  const cycleScriptTheme = () => {
    setScriptTheme(prev => {
      if (prev === 'emerald') return 'default';
      if (prev === 'default') return 'courier';
      if (prev === 'courier') return 'cyberpunk';
      return 'emerald';
    });
  };

  const getThemeLabel = () => {
    switch (scriptTheme) {
      case 'default': return 'Slate';
      case 'courier': return 'Courier Draft';
      case 'cyberpunk': return 'Cyber Neon';
      case 'emerald': return 'Emerald Studio';
    }
  };

  const getScriptThemeClasses = () => {
    switch (scriptTheme) {
      case 'courier':
        return `!bg-stone-50 !text-stone-900 font-mono p-8 rounded-xl border border-stone-200 transition-all shadow-md
                [&_h1]:!text-amber-900 [&_h1]:!font-black [&_h1]:!text-lg [&_h1]:!mb-4
                [&_h2]:!text-amber-900 [&_h2]:!font-black [&_h2]:!text-base [&_h2]:!mb-3
                [&_h3]:!text-amber-900 [&_h3]:!font-black [&_h3]:!text-sm [&_h3]:!mb-2 [&_h3]:!bg-amber-100/70 [&_h3]:!px-2 [&_h3]:!py-1 [&_h3]:!rounded
                [&_h4]:!text-amber-900 [&_h4]:!font-black [&_h4]:!text-xs
                [&_th]:!bg-stone-200 [&_th]:!text-stone-950 [&_th]:!font-bold [&_th]:!border-stone-300
                [&_td]:!border-stone-200 [&_td]:!text-stone-800
                [&_strong]:!text-rose-700 [&_strong]:!font-black [&_strong]:!bg-rose-50/80 [&_strong]:!px-1.5 [&_strong]:!py-0.5 [&_strong]:!rounded [&_strong]:!border [&_strong]:!border-rose-200/50`;
      case 'cyberpunk':
        return `!bg-black !text-zinc-300 font-mono p-8 rounded-xl border border-fuchsia-950 transition-all shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(217,70,239,0.06)]
                [&_h1]:!text-cyan-400 [&_h1]:!font-black [&_h1]:!tracking-widest [&_h1]:!uppercase [&_h1]:!mb-4
                [&_h2]:!text-cyan-400 [&_h2]:!font-black [&_h2]:!tracking-widest [&_h2]:!uppercase [&_h2]:!mb-3
                [&_h3]:!text-cyan-400 [&_h3]:!font-black [&_h3]:!tracking-widest [&_h3]:!uppercase [&_h3]:!mb-2 [&_h3]:!border-b [&_h3]:!border-cyan-500/30 [&_h3]:!pb-1
                [&_h4]:!text-cyan-400 [&_h4]:!font-black [&_h4]:!tracking-wider
                [&_th]:!bg-cyan-950/60 [&_th]:!text-cyan-300 [&_th]:!font-bold [&_th]:!border-cyan-900/60
                [&_td]:!border-zinc-900 [&_td]:!text-zinc-300
                [&_strong]:!text-fuchsia-400 [&_strong]:!bg-fuchsia-950/40 [&_strong]:!px-1.5 [&_strong]:!py-0.5 [&_strong]:!rounded [&_strong]:!border [&_strong]:!border-fuchsia-500/20 [&_strong]:!shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(217,70,239,0.2)]`;
      case 'emerald':
        return `!bg-emerald-950/80 !text-emerald-100 font-mono p-8 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 transition-all shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(16,185,129,0.06)]
                [&_h1]:!text-emerald-400 [&_h1]:!font-black [&_h1]:!tracking-wide [&_h1]:!uppercase [&_h1]:!mb-4 [&_h1]:!border-l-4 [&_h1]:!border-emerald-400 [&_h1]:!bg-emerald-950/90 [&_h1]:!px-3 [&_h1]:!py-2 [&_h1]:!rounded-r [&_h1]:!shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(52,211,153,0.1)]
                [&_h2]:!text-emerald-400 [&_h2]:!font-black [&_h2]:!tracking-wide [&_h2]:!mb-3 [&_h2]:!border-l-4 [&_h2]:!border-emerald-400 [&_h2]:!bg-emerald-950/90 [&_h2]:!px-3 [&_h2]:!py-1.5 [&_h2]:!rounded-r
                [&_h3]:!text-emerald-400 [&_h3]:!font-black [&_h3]:!mb-2 [&_h3]:!border-l-4 [&_h3]:!border-emerald-400 [&_h3]:!bg-emerald-950/70 [&_h3]:!px-2 [&_h3]:!py-1 [&_h3]:!rounded-r
                [&_h4]:!text-emerald-400 [&_h4]:!font-bold [&_h4]:!mb-2 [&_h4]:!border-l-2 [&_h4]:!border-emerald-400 [&_h4]:!pl-2
                [&_th]:!bg-emerald-950/90 [&_th]:!text-emerald-200 [&_th]:!font-bold [&_th]:!border-emerald-800
                [&_td]:!border-emerald-900/40 [&_td]:!text-emerald-100/90
                [&_strong]:!text-amber-500 [&_strong]:!font-black [&_strong]:!bg-amber-950/80 [&_strong]:!px-2 [&_strong]:!py-0.5 [&_strong]:!rounded [&_strong]:!border [&_strong]:!border-amber-500/30 [&_strong]:!shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)]`;
      default:
        return ``;
    }
  };

  const getRawThemeClasses = () => {
    switch (scriptTheme) {
      case 'emerald':
        return 'bg-emerald-950/90 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800/60 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.08)]';
      case 'cyberpunk':
        return 'bg-black text-fuchsia-400 border-fuchsia-950 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(217,70,239,0.05)]';
      case 'courier':
        return 'bg-stone-50 text-stone-900 border-stone-200';
      default:
        return 'bg-black/30 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-900';
    }
  };
  
  // AI Refine Script State
  const [refinePrompt, setRefinePrompt] = useState('');
  const [isRefining, setIsRefining] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Handlers for Images
  const handleImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;

    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
      
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {
        const preview = reader.result as string;
        const base64 = preview.split(',')[1];
        setImages(prev => [...prev, { file, preview, base64 }]);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
    
    // Clear the file input so the same files can be re-uploaded
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  };

  const removeImage = (index: number) => {
    setImages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  // Toggle Suggestive Idea
  const toggleIdea = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedIdeas(prev => 
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(item => item !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  // Character Management
  const addCharacter = () => {
    if (!newCharName.trim()) return;
    setCharacters(prev => [...prev, { name: newCharName.trim(), role: newCharRole.trim() || 'Supporting Character' }]);
    setNewCharName('');
    setNewCharRole('');
  };

  const removeCharacter = (index: number) => {
    setCharacters(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  // Helper function to build custom compile prompts
  const buildPrompt = (isRefiningScript: boolean, refineDirective: string = '') => {
    let promptText = '';
    
    if (isRefiningScript) {
      promptText = `Here is the current script:\n\n${generatedScript}\n\nPlease refine and modify this script based on the following instruction: "${refineDirective}".\n\n`;
      promptText += `Maintain the overall screenwriting format, tone, and pacing. Return ONLY the fully updated and rewritten script. Do not include introductory text.`;
      return promptText;
    }

    // New Script Build
    promptText = `You are an award-winning screenplay and script writer. Draft an engaging, highly-polished script based on the following instructions.\n\n`;
    
    promptText += `### STORY FOCUS / CORE IDEA:\n${plot || 'Write an immersive story scene based on the characters and style choices below.'}\n\n`;
    
    promptText += `### CREATIVE PARAMETERS:\n`;
    promptText += `- **Genre**: ${genre}\n`;
    promptText += `- **Tone**: ${tone}\n`;
    promptText += `- **Format/Layout**: ${format} (Ensure standard, beautiful industry layout formatting for this choice)\n`;
    promptText += `- **Pacing**: ${pacing}\n\n`;

    if (characters.length > 0) {
      promptText += `### CHARACTERS INVOLVED:\n`;
      characters.forEach(char => {
        promptText += `- **${char.name}**: ${char.role}\n`;
      });
      promptText += `\n`;
    }

    const appliedIdeas = SUGGESTIVE_IDEAS.filter(idea => selectedIdeas.includes(idea.id));
    if (appliedIdeas.length > 0) {
      promptText += `### SUGGESTIVE DIRECTIVES & IDEAS TO INTEGRATE:\n`;
      appliedIdeas.forEach(idea => {
        promptText += `- ${idea.prompt}\n`;
      });
      promptText += `\n`;
    }

    if (images.length > 0) {
      promptText += `### VISUAL REFERENCES:\nAnalyze the provided image references carefully. Interpret their contents, environments, color palette, lighting, moods, or characters, and translate them directly into visual scene descriptions, action lines, setting headers, or costuming inside the script.\n\n`;
    }

    promptText += `### FORMATTING & OUTPUT RULES:\n`;
    if (format === 'Screenplay') {
      promptText += `1. Follow standard Hollywood Screenplay Format. Use bold headers like "SCENE 1: INT. SPACE STATION - NIGHT".\n`;
      promptText += `2. Put character names in bold caps, centered on a line, followed by their dialogue directly below it (indented slightly for readability).\n`;
      promptText += `3. Include parentheticals for delivery mood (e.g. *(whispering)*) where appropriate.\n`;
      promptText += `4. Keep action descriptions visual, cinematic, and written in the present tense.\n`;
    } else if (format === 'A/V Dual-Column') {
      promptText += `1. Format as an elegant 2-column list or Markdown table with headers: | VISUAL (Scene & Directions) | AUDIO (Dialogue & Sound Effects) |.\n`;
      promptText += `2. Ensure clear coordination between left and right column visual/audio cues.\n`;
    } else if (format === 'TikTok / YouTube Shorts') {
      promptText += `1. Build for rapid engagement. Write a clear "[HOOK]" within the first 3 seconds.\n`;
      promptText += `2. Use snappy on-screen-text cues like "[TEXT ON SCREEN: ...]" and visual indicators.\n`;
      promptText += `3. Maximize punchy dialogue and fast pacing.\n`;
    } else if (format === 'Podcast / Conversation') {
      promptText += `1. Format as a natural, conversational, unscripted-feeling transcript.\n`;
      promptText += `2. Use host names like "Host: " and "Expert: ", adding back-and-forth interruptions, agreements, laughs, or thought pauses.\n`;
    } else {
      promptText += `1. Generate a robust audio drama/radio narrative script. Utilize parentheticals like "[SFX: rain pattering on a window]" and "[MUSIC: low synth drone rises]".\n`;
    }
    
    promptText += `Return the complete, finished script in elegant, clean Markdown. Do not include meta-discussions or concluding notes, just start writing the script immediately.`;
    return promptText;
  };

  // Compile Trigger
  const compileScript = async () => {
    setIsCompiling(true);
    setSavedToWorkspace(false);
    
    const statuses = [
      'Analyzing plot instructions and parameters...',
      'Decoding multimodal image references...',
      'Synthesizing suggestive creative directives...',
      'Drafting character motivations & dialogue...',
      'Applying professional script layout formatting...',
      'Reviewing and polishing dramatic pacing...'
    ];

    // Cycle through status messages for a professional visual feel
    let statusIdx = 0;
    setCompileStatus(statuses[0]);
    const statusInterval = setInterval(() => {
      statusIdx = (statusIdx + 1) % statuses.length;
      setCompileStatus(statuses[statusIdx]);
    }, 2500);

    try {
      const promptText = buildPrompt(false);
      
      // Build local image media items array
      const localImageMediaItems: MediaItem[] = images.map((img, idx) => ({
        id: `local_img_${idx}`,
        name: img.file.name,
        mimeType: img.file.type,
        type: 'image',
        data: img.base64
      }));

      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const allMediaItems = [...localImageMediaItems, ...selectedItems];

      const scriptText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(promptText, allMediaItems);

      setGeneratedScript(scriptText || "No script could be compiled. Please check your inputs.");
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      alert(`Error compiling script: ${err.message || err}`);
    } finally {
      clearInterval(statusInterval);
      setIsCompiling(false);
    }
  };

  // Polish / Refine Trigger
  const refineScript = async () => {
    if (!refinePrompt.trim() || !generatedScript) return;
    setIsRefining(true);
    
    try {
      const promptText = buildPrompt(true, refinePrompt.trim());
      const scriptText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(promptText, []);
      setGeneratedScript(scriptText || generatedScript);
      setRefinePrompt('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err);
      alert(`Error refining script: ${err.message || err}`);
    } finally {
      setIsRefining(false);
    }
  };

  // Clipboard Copy Helper
  const copyToClipboard = () => {
    if (!generatedScript) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatedScript);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  // Download File Helper
  const downloadScriptFile = () => {
    if (!generatedScript) return;
    const element = document.createElement("a");
    const file = new Blob([generatedScript], {type: 'text/plain'});
    element.href = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    element.download = `${plot ? plot.substring(0, 15).replace(/\s+/g, '_') : 'script'}_writer.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(element);
    element.click();
    document.body.removeChild(element);
  };

  // Save to Session / Workspace helper
  const handleSaveToWorkspace = () => {
    if (!generatedScript || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    const base64Data = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(generatedScript)));
    const cleanTitle = plot ? plot.substring(0, 30) : `AI Script (${genre})`;

    const item: MediaItem = {
      id: `script_${Date.now()}`,
      name: `${cleanTitle}.txt`,
      type: 'text',
      mimeType: 'text/plain',
      data: base64Data,
      tags: ['script', genre.toLowerCase(), tone.toLowerCase()]
    };

    onSaveArtifact(item);
    setSavedToWorkspace(true);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-6 text-zinc-100">
      
      {/* Intro Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-800 pb-6 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-red-400 to-amber-500 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20">
              <Film className="w-7 h-7" />
            </span>
            AI Script Writer & Screenplay Studio
          </h2>
          <p className="text-zinc-400 text-sm mt-1">
            Compose and compile industry-standard screenplay scripts with text prompts, storyboard images, and suggestive concepts.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        {/* Quick Reset */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setPlot('');
            setImages([]);
            setSelectedIdeas([]);
            setCharacters([{ name: 'Protagonist', role: 'Main seeker' }]);
            setGeneratedScript(null);
            setSavedToWorkspace(false);
          }}
          className="px-4 py-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all"
        >
          Reset Workspace
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Studio Split */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-start">
        
        {/* Left Input & Configuration (5 cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          
          {/* Plot Text Prompt Area */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-red-400 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>1. Plot Synopsis & Directives</span>
              </label>
              <AudioInput
                onTranscript={(text) => setPlot(prev => prev ? `${prev} ${text}` : text)}
                placeholder="Dictate your scene plot..."
              />
            </div>
            
            <textarea
              value={plot}
              onChange={(e) => setPlot(e.target.value)}
              rows={4}
              placeholder="Describe what happens in your scene. E.g. 'Two rival hackers meet in a neon-lit ramen shop to trade a decrypted data drive, but they soon realize they are being set up...'"
              className="w-full bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 focus:border-red-500/50 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-600 focus:ring-0 outline-none transition-all resize-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Multimodal Image References */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>2. Storyboard & Visual References</span>
              </label>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-medium">({images.length} added)</span>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div 
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                className="border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-800 hover:border-amber-500/40 bg-zinc-900/20 hover:bg-zinc-900/40 rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-all text-center"
              >
                <ImageIcon className="w-8 h-8 text-zinc-600 mb-2" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300">Upload Reference Images</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-1">Drag and drop images or click to select storyboard reference files</span>
              </div>
              
              <input 
                type="file"
                ref={fileInputRef}
                onChange={handleImageUpload}
                accept="image/*"
                multiple
                className="hidden"
              />

              {/* Upload Previews */}
              {images.length > 0 && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 pt-1">
                  {images.map((img, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="relative group aspect-square rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden bg-zinc-900">
                      <img src={img.preview} alt="Reference Preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                      <button 
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeImage(idx)}
                        className="absolute inset-0 bg-red-600/95 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity text-white"
                        title="Remove Image"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Directives & Suggestive Ideas */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-400">
              3. Creative Ideas & Suggestive Concepts
            </label>
            
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
              Tap any suggestive directive card to force the AI writer to weave that specific narrative device or pacing into your screenplay.
            </p>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {SUGGESTIVE_IDEAS.map(idea => {
                const isActive = selectedIdeas.includes(idea.id);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={idea.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleIdea(idea.id)}
                    className={`p-2.5 text-left rounded-xl border text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                      isActive 
                        ? 'bg-purple-500/10 border-purple-500 text-purple-400 shadow-md shadow-purple-500/5' 
                        : 'bg-zinc-900/40 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 hover:border-zinc-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {idea.label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Session Context Reference status */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">
                Knowledge base context
              </label>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={useSessionData}
                onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500 bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 rounded focus:ring-red-500 focus:ring-2"
              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
              {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session to ground script writing.`
                : '⚠️ No reference files selected in session chat yet. Script will use general creative inputs.'}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Scene Parameters & Format */}
          <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 p-5 rounded-2xl space-y-5 shadow-xl">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
              4. Format & Genre Setup
            </label>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {/* Format Select */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-500">Script Format</span>
                <select 
                  value={format} 
                  onChange={(e) => setFormat(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="Screenplay">Movie Screenplay</option>
                  <option value="A/V Dual-Column">A/V Dual Column</option>
                  <option value="TikTok / YouTube Shorts">Social Short Video</option>
                  <option value="Podcast / Conversation">Podcast Dialogue</option>
                  <option value="Audio Drama">Audio/SFX Drama</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Genre Select */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-500">Genre</span>
                <select 
                  value={genre} 
                  onChange={(e) => setGenre(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="Sci-Fi">Science Fiction</option>
                  <option value="Drama">Drama</option>
                  <option value="Comedy">Comedy</option>
                  <option value="Horror">Horror/Thriller</option>
                  <option value="Noir / Detective">Crime Noir</option>
                  <option value="Action">Action/Adventure</option>
                  <option value="Educational / Ad">Corporate Ad</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Tone Select */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-500">Tone</span>
                <select 
                  value={tone} 
                  onChange={(e) => setTone(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="Cinematic">Cinematic</option>
                  <option value="Suspenseful">Suspenseful</option>
                  <option value="Atmospheric">Atmospheric</option>
                  <option value="Whimsical">Whimsical</option>
                  <option value="Sarcastic">Sarcastic</option>
                  <option value="Epic">Epic</option>
                  <option value="Intimate">Intimate</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Pacing Select */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-500">Pacing</span>
                <select 
                  value={pacing} 
                  onChange={(e) => setPacing(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="Balanced">Balanced</option>
                  <option value="Fast / High-Octane">Fast-Paced</option>
                  <option value="Slow / Atmospheric">Slow / Moody</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Character Setup */}
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-900">
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-zinc-400 block">Dramatis Personae (Characters)</span>
              
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto">
                {characters.map((char, idx) => (
                  <span 
                    key={idx} 
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg text-xs"
                  >
                    <User className="w-3 h-3 text-red-400" />
                    <span className="font-bold">{char.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">({char.role})</span>
                    <button 
                      type="button" 
                      onClick={() => removeCharacter(idx)}
                      className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-400 ml-1"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Character Input fields */}
              <div className="flex gap-2 items-center">
                <input 
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Name (e.g. Leo)"
                  value={newCharName}
                  onChange={e => setNewCharName(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 w-1/2 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                />
                <input 
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Role (e.g. Detective)"
                  value={newCharRole}
                  onChange={e => setNewCharRole(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200 w-1/2 focus:border-emerald-500 outline-none"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={addCharacter}
                  className="p-1.5 bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-300 rounded border border-zinc-700 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Core Build Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={compileScript}
            disabled={isCompiling}
            className="w-full py-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-amber-600 to-amber-500 hover:from-red-500 hover:via-amber-500 hover:to-amber-400 disabled:opacity-40 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-xl hover:shadow-red-500/10 transition-all transform hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.99] flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
          >
            {isCompiling ? (
              <>
                <svg className="animate-spin h-5 w-5 text-white" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <circle className="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="4" />
                  <path className="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z" />
                </svg>
                <span>{compileStatus}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Wand2 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                <span>Compile & Write Screenplay</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>

        </div>

        {/* Right Output Screen (7 cols) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col min-h-[600px] h-full">
          
          {generatedScript ? (
            <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-900 rounded-2xl flex-1 flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
              
              {/* Output Toolbar */}
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-zinc-900 p-4 bg-zinc-900/30">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 p-0.5 bg-zinc-900 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('preview')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition-all ${activeTab === 'preview' ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'}`}
                  >
                    Script Preview
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('raw')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition-all ${activeTab === 'raw' ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200'}`}
                  >
                    Raw Text
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto justify-end">
