                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Camera Angle</label>
                      <select
                        value={activeShot.angle}
                        onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(activeShot.id, 'angle', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200"
                      >
                        {PRESET_ANGLES.map(a => (
                          <option key={a} value={a}>{a}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Focal Length</label>
                      <select
                        value={activeShot.focalLength}
                        onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(activeShot.id, 'focalLength', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200"
                      >
                        {PRESET_LENSES.map(l => (
                          <option key={l} value={l}>{l}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Camera Movement</label>
                    <select
                      value={activeShot.movement}
                      onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(activeShot.id, 'movement', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200"
                    >
                      {PRESET_MOVEMENTS.map(m => (
                        <option key={m} value={m}>{m}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Subject action description</label>
                    <textarea
                      value={activeShot.subject}
                      onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(activeShot.id, 'subject', e.target.value)}
                      rows={3}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200 focus:outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold block mb-1">Lighting Structure</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={activeShot.lighting}
                      onChange={(e) => handleFieldChange(activeShot.id, 'lighting', e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Three-point lighting with blue rim light..."
                      className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-200 focus:outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-8 text-slate-600">
              <Info className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-750 mb-1" />
              <p className="text-xs">Select any shot card on the left to edit camera settings.</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>

    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/SocialMediaSuite.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Share2, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, Send, Sparkles, Layout, Eye, MessageSquare, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

const LinkedinIcon = (props: React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>) => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" {...props}>
    <path d="M16 8a6 6 0 0 1 6 6v7h-4v-7a2 2 0 0 0-2-2 2 2 0 0 0-2 2v7h-4v-7a6 6 0 0 1 6-6z" />
    <rect x="2" y="9" width="4" height="12" />
    <circle cx="4" cy="4" r="2" />
  </svg>
);

const TwitterIcon = (props: React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>) => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" {...props}>
    <path d="M22 4s-.7 2.1-2 3.4c1.6 10-9.4 17.3-18 11.6 2.2.1 4.4-.6 6-2C3 15.5.5 9.6 3 5c2.2 2.6 5.6 4.1 9 4-.9-4.2 4-6.6 7-3.8 1.1 0 3-1.2 3-1.2z" />
  </svg>
);

const InstagramIcon = (props: React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>) => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" {...props}>
    <rect x="2" y="2" width="20" height="20" rx="5" ry="5" />
    <path d="M16 11.37A4 4 0 1 1 12.63 8 4 4 0 0 1 16 11.37z" />
    <line x1="17.5" y1="6.5" x2="17.51" y2="6.5" />
  </svg>
);

interface SocialMediaSuiteProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

export const SocialMediaSuite: React.FC<SocialMediaSuiteProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [tone, setTone] = useState('Professional & Engaging');
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState('');
  const [selectedPlatforms, setSelectedPlatforms] = useState<string[]>(['linkedin', 'twitter', 'instagram']);
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);
  
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{
    linkedin?: string;
    twitter?: string[];
    instagram?: string;
  } | null>(null);
  
  const [activePreviewTab, setActivePreviewTab] = useState<'linkedin' | 'twitter' | 'instagram'>('linkedin');
  const [copiedField, setCopiedField] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

  const togglePlatform = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedPlatforms.includes(id)) {
      if (selectedPlatforms.length > 1) {
        setSelectedPlatforms(selectedPlatforms.filter(p => p !== id));
      }
    } else {
      setSelectedPlatforms([...selectedPlatforms, id]);
    }
  };

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setResult(null);
    setCopiedField(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      // Collect selected media items from the current active session
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as a world-class Social Media Strategist and Viral Growth Expert. 
Based on the ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'provided source material' : 'specifications'} and the following user specifications, generate highly engaging social media posts.

USER SPECIFICATIONS:
- Tone: ${tone}
- Focus/Custom Instructions: ${focus || 'Summarize the core takeaways and make it engaging.'}
- Platforms to generate: ${selectedPlatforms.join(', ')}

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS (IMPORTANT - Follow this exact structure):
We need the output structured so we can parse each platform. Please format your reply exactly as follows, with the specific delimiters:

[LINKEDIN_START]
(Write a professional, thought-provoking LinkedIn post. Use 2-3 paragraph spacing, bold hook, and 3-5 relevant hashtags. Maintain an expert, thought-leadership style)
[LINKEDIN_END]

[TWITTER_START]
(Write a Twitter thread of 3-5 tweets. Separate each tweet with --- on its own line. Make sure each tweet fits within character limits, is punchy, and uses numbering or transitions)
[TWITTER_END]

[INSTAGRAM_START]
(Write a highly visual, aesthetic Instagram caption. Start with a hook, include emojis, bulleted takeaways, call to action, and a block of hashtags separated by dots)
[INSTAGRAM_END]

Return ONLY the text in this format.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Parse the output
      const linkedinMatch = responseText.match(/\[LINKEDIN_START\]([\s\S]*?)\[LINKEDIN_END\]/);
      const twitterMatch = responseText.match(/\[TWITTER_START\]([\s\S]*?)\[TWITTER_END\]/);
      const instagramMatch = responseText.match(/\[INSTAGRAM_START\]([\s\S]*?)\[INSTAGRAM_END\]/);

      const parsedResult: any = {};
      if (linkedinMatch) {
        parsedResult.linkedin = linkedinMatch[1].trim();
      } else {
        // Fallback simple parsing if delimiters missed
        parsedResult.linkedin = responseText.substring(0, 1000);
      }

      if (twitterMatch) {
        parsedResult.twitter = twitterMatch[1].trim().split(/\n---\n|---/).map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      } else {
        parsedResult.twitter = ["Check out these latest insights from our aggregator!", "We have processed multiple media channels into structured knowledge.", "Join the discussion today!"];
      }

      if (instagramMatch) {
        parsedResult.instagram = instagramMatch[1].trim();
      } else {
        parsedResult.instagram = "Latest insights parsed and consolidated. 🚀\n\nLink in bio to read full briefings.\n\n#media #tech #aggregation #learning";
      }

      setResult(parsedResult);
      // Set active preview tab based on what was generated
      if (parsedResult.linkedin) setActivePreviewTab('linkedin');
      else if (parsedResult.twitter) setActivePreviewTab('twitter');
      else if (parsedResult.instagram) setActivePreviewTab('instagram');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setResult({
        linkedin: "Failed to generate social media suite. Please try again."
      });
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyText = (text: string, field: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedField(field);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedField(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownloadSuite = () => {
    if (!result) return;
    
    let mdText = `# Social Media Suite\n\nGenerated with AI on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}\n\n`;
    if (result.linkedin) {
      mdText += `## LinkedIn Post\n\n${result.linkedin}\n\n---\n\n`;
    }
    if (result.twitter) {
      mdText += `## X/Twitter Thread\n\n`;
      result.twitter.forEach((tweet, idx) => {
        mdText += `### Tweet ${idx + 1}\n\n${tweet}\n\n`;
      });
      mdText += `\n---\n\n`;
    }
    if (result.instagram) {
      mdText += `## Instagram Caption\n\n${result.instagram}\n\n`;
    }

    const blob = new Blob([mdText], { type: 'text/markdown' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `social-media-suite-${Date.now()}.md`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!result || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Social Media Suite</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 2rem; }
        .suite-card { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
        h1 { font-size: 1.75rem; color: #f472b6; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 2px solid #ec4899; padding-bottom: 0.5rem; }
        h2 { font-size: 1.25rem; color: #9ca3af; margin-bottom: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2937; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; }
        .platform-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <h1>📲 Generated Social Media Suite</h1>
        
        ${result.linkedin ? `
        <div class="suite-card">
            <span class="platform-tag bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-400 border border-blue-800">LINKEDIN</span>
            <div style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.6;">${result.linkedin}</div>
        </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${result.twitter ? `
        <div class="suite-card">
            <span class="platform-tag bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-700">X (TWITTER) THREAD</span>
            <div class="space-y-4">
                ${result.twitter.map((tweet, i) => `
                <div style="padding: 12px; background: #1f2937; border-radius: 8px;">
                    <strong>Tweet ${i + 1}/${result.twitter?.length}:</strong>
                    <p style="white-space: pre-wrap; margin-top: 4px;">${tweet}</p>
                </div>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        </div>
        ` : ''}

        ${result.instagram ? `
        <div class="suite-card">
            <span class="platform-tag bg-pink-900/40 text-pink-400 border border-pink-800">INSTAGRAM</span>
            <div style="white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.6;">${result.instagram}</div>
        </div>
        ` : ''}
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));
    
    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Social Suite: ${tone}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-pink-400">
            <Share2 className="w-6 h-6" /> Social Media Suite
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Turn your consolidated source files and links into viral social posts and threads.
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {result && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownloadSuite}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                title="Download Markdown File"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-pink-600/20 text-pink-400 border border-pink-500/30 hover:bg-pink-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                title="Save as HTML Artifact to Session"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save to Session'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">
        
        {/* Left Control Panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-pink-400" /> Suite Customizer
            </h3>

            {/* Source Reference Summary */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong className="text-app-text">Source context:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-pink-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-pink-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-app-dim">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected source file(s) / web links from active session.` 
                  : '⚠️ No source media selected. Please go back and select media items in your chat session to ground the generation.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Tone selector */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Tone of Voice</label>
              <select
                value={tone}
                onChange={(e) => setTone(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-pink-500"
              >
                <option value="Professional & Engaging">👔 Professional & Thought Leadership (LinkedIn standard)</option>
                <option value="Viral & Hook-heavy">⚡ Viral, Bold & Punchy (Great for X/Twitter growth)</option>
                <option value="Casual & Relatable">🍕 Casual, Personal & Conversational</option>
                <option value="Highly Technical / Deep-dive">🔬 Analytical & Technical Deep-dive</option>
                <option value="Educational & Step-by-step">📚 Educational with actionable steps</option>
                <option value="Sarcastic & Witty">🎭 Sarcastic, Witty & Humorous</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Custom Focus Prompt */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Custom Angle / Focus (Optional)</label>
              <textarea
                value={focus}
                onChange={(e) => setFocus(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="e.g. Focus on the environmental impact, or add a CTA for our upcoming webinar on Friday..."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-pink-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Platforms selectors */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-2">Target Platforms</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => togglePlatform('linkedin')}
                  className={`py-2 rounded text-xs font-bold border flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                    selectedPlatforms.includes('linkedin')
                      ? 'bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/50'
                      : 'bg-app-input text-app-dim border-app-border hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  <LinkedinIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> LinkedIn
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => togglePlatform('twitter')}
                  className={`py-2 rounded text-xs font-bold border flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                    selectedPlatforms.includes('twitter')
                      ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 border-zinc-700'
                      : 'bg-app-input text-app-dim border-app-border hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  <TwitterIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> X / Twitter
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => togglePlatform('instagram')}
                  className={`py-2 rounded text-xs font-bold border flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                    selectedPlatforms.includes('instagram')
                      ? 'bg-pink-600/20 text-pink-400 border-pink-500/50'
                      : 'bg-app-input text-app-dim border-app-border hover:text-app-text'
                  }`}
                >
                  <InstagramIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Instagram
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Run Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-pink-600 hover:bg-pink-500 disabled:bg-pink-800/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-pink-900/10"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Analyzing Sources & Crafting Posts...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate Suite
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Output/Preview Panels */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-pink-500/20 border-t-pink-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <Share2 className="w-5 h-5 text-pink-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Generating Social Media Suite...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Evaluating selected file structures, links, and documents to assemble cohesive, platform-specific copywriting sets.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <Layout className="w-12 h-12 text-pink-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Preview Social Media Feed</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Customize your settings on the left panel and click "Generate Suite" to create and preview professional feed posts.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
              {/* Tab Selector */}
              <div className="bg-app-bg/50 border-b border-app-border p-2 flex gap-1.5">
                {result.linkedin && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActivePreviewTab('linkedin')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      activePreviewTab === 'linkedin'
                        ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow'
                        : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text hover:bg-app-input'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <LinkedinIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> LinkedIn Post
                  </button>
                )}
                {result.twitter && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActivePreviewTab('twitter')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      activePreviewTab === 'twitter'
                        ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-100 shadow border border-zinc-700'
                        : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text hover:bg-app-input'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <TwitterIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> X (Twitter) Thread
                  </button>
                )}
                {result.instagram && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActivePreviewTab('instagram')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      activePreviewTab === 'instagram'
                        ? 'bg-pink-600 text-white shadow'
                        : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text hover:bg-app-input'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <InstagramIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Instagram Grid
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Preview Content Container */}
              <div className="p-4 md:p-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-app-bg/10">
                
                {/* LinkedIn Feed Mockup */}
                {activePreviewTab === 'linkedin' && result.linkedin && (
                  <div className="space-y-4 max-w-lg mx-auto">
                    <div className="bg-[#1d2226] border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-4 font-sans text-white text-[14px]">
                      {/* LinkedIn Header */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm text-white">ME</div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-bold text-[14px] hover:underline hover:text-blue-400 cursor-pointer">Aggregator Executive</div>
                          <div className="text-[12px] text-zinc-400">Chief of Staff & Publisher • 1st</div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1">Just now • <span className="text-[10px]">🌐</span></div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* Post body */}
                      <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed text-zinc-200">{result.linkedin}</p>

                      {/* Mock Interactive Bar */}
                      <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-800 flex justify-between text-zinc-400 text-xs font-bold px-2">
                        <button className="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-blue-400"><Heart className="w-4 h-4" /> Like</button>
                        <button className="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-blue-400"><MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" /> Comment</button>
                        <button className="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-blue-400"><Share2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Share</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopyText(result.linkedin || '', 'linkedin')}
                      className="w-full py-2 border border-app-border bg-app-card hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-bold rounded flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {copiedField === 'linkedin' ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Copied!
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy LinkedIn Post
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* X/Twitter Feed Mockup */}
                {activePreviewTab === 'twitter' && result.twitter && (
                  <div className="space-y-4 max-w-lg mx-auto">
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      {result.twitter.map((tweet, idx) => (
                        <div key={idx} className="bg-black border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-4 font-sans text-white text-[15px] relative">
                          {/* Thread line linking tweets */}
                          {idx < (result.twitter?.length || 0) - 1 && (
                            <div className="absolute left-9 top-14 bottom-0 w-[2px] bg-zinc-800 z-0"></div>
                          )}
                          
                          <div className="flex gap-3 relative z-10">
                            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm text-zinc-400">X</div>
                            <div className="flex-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span className="font-bold hover:underline cursor-pointer">@aggregator_ai</span>
                                <span className="text-zinc-500 text-sm">@{session?.name?.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '') || 'workspace'} • Just now</span>
                              </div>
                              <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed text-zinc-100">{tweet}</p>
                              
                              {/* Bottom counters */}
                              <div className="flex justify-between max-w-xs text-zinc-500 text-xs mt-3 pt-1">
                                <span>💬 12</span>
                                <span>🔁 48</span>
                                <span>❤️ 156</span>
                                <span>📊 1.2K</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopyText(result.twitter?.join('\n\n---\n\n') || '', 'twitter')}
                      className="w-full py-2 border border-app-border bg-app-card hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-bold rounded flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {copiedField === 'twitter' ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Copied Thread!
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy Entire Thread
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Instagram Mockup */}
                {activePreviewTab === 'instagram' && result.instagram && (
                  <div className="space-y-4 max-w-md mx-auto">
                    <div className="bg-[#121212] border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden font-sans text-white text-[14px]">
                      {/* Inst Header */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 border-b border-zinc-900">
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-yellow-500 via-red-500 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs p-[1.5px]">
                          <div className="bg-black w-full h-full rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px]">AI</div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs hover:underline cursor-pointer">workspace_briefings</span>
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* Image Placeholders */}
                      <div className="aspect-square bg-zinc-900 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-6 border-b border-zinc-900 relative">
                        <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-black/60 text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">1/1</div>
                        <Eye className="w-10 h-10 text-pink-500/40 mb-2" />
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-pink-400">Aggregated Insights Graphic</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-1 max-w-xs">
                          {session?.name ? `Context: ${session.name}` : 'Source collection dataset report visual reference'}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Caption details */}
                      <div className="p-3 space-y-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-lg mb-1">
                          <button className="hover:text-red-500">❤️</button>
                          <button className="hover:text-blue-400">💬</button>
                          <button className="hover:text-yellow-400">📤</button>
                        </div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-xs">1,248 likes</div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-xs mr-1.5">workspace_briefings</span>
                          <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed text-zinc-200 text-xs">{result.instagram}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopyText(result.instagram || '', 'instagram')}
                      className="w-full py-2 border border-app-border bg-app-card hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-bold rounded flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {copiedField === 'instagram' ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> Copied Caption!
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy Instagram Caption
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

    setSlidesRedoStack([]); // reset redo stack on new action
  };

  const undoSlides = () => {
    if (slidesUndoStack.length === 0) return;
    const previous = slidesUndoStack[slidesUndoStack.length - 1];
    setSlidesUndoStack(prev => prev.slice(0, -1));
    setSlidesRedoStack(prev => [...prev, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(slides))]);

  };

  const redoSlides = () => {
    if (slidesRedoStack.length === 0) return;
    const next = slidesRedoStack[slidesRedoStack.length - 1];
    setSlidesRedoStack(prev => prev.slice(0, -1));
    setSlidesUndoStack(prev => [...prev, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(slides))]);
    setSlides(next);
    triggerAudioBeep(450, 'sine', 0.05);
  };

  const redrawActiveTextWithStyle = (newText?: string, newColor?: string, newWidth?: number, newFontSize?: number) => {
    if (!activeText || !canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas?.getContext('2d');
    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;

    const currentText = newText !== undefined ? newText : activeText.text;
    const currentColor = newColor !== undefined ? newColor : drawColor;
    const currentFontSize = newFontSize !== undefined ? newFontSize : (activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14));

    // Restore clean snapshot
    ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);

    // Draw updated text
    ctx.font = `bold ${currentFontSize}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.fillStyle = currentColor;
    ctx.fillText(currentText, activeText.x, activeText.y);

    // Draw outline
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    const textWidth = ctx.measureText(currentText).width;
    const textHeight = currentFontSize;
    ctx.strokeRect(activeText.x - 5, activeText.y - textHeight - 5, textWidth + 10, textHeight + 10);
    ctx.setLineDash([]); // reset

    // Draw handle at bottom-right corner
    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.fillRect(activeText.x + textWidth, activeText.y, 8, 8);

    // Update activeText state to stay in sync!
    setActiveText({
      text: currentText,
      x: activeText.x,
      y: activeText.y,
      fontSize: currentFontSize
    });
  };

  // --- NEW USER-REQUESTED STATES ---
  const [isSpecExpanded, setIsSpecExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSlideIds, setSelectedSlideIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'editor' | 'script'>('editor');
  const [textToInsert, setTextToInsert] = useState('Camera Direction');
  const [scriptText, setScriptText] = useState('');
  const [isXLControlsOpen, setIsXLControlsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [rightPanelTab, setRightPanelTab] = useState<'desc' | 'spec'>('desc');
  const [sourceFolderName, setSourceFolderName] = useState<string>('storyboard_slices');
  const [isZipModalOpen, setIsZipModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [zipFileName, setZipFileName] = useState('');

  interface CuePoint {
    id: string;
    timeCode: string;
    text: string;
    assignedSlideId?: string;
  }

  const [cuePoints, setCuePoints] = useState<CuePoint[]>([
    { id: 'cue-1', timeCode: '00:00', text: 'Opening Sequence with ambient tone', assignedSlideId: 'slide-1' },
    { id: 'cue-2', timeCode: '00:04', text: 'Voiceover narrative starts, rain background', assignedSlideId: 'slide-2' }
  ]);

  const ASPECT_RATIOS: Record<string, AspectRatioConfig> = {
    '16:9': { label: '16:9 Widescreen', className: 'aspect-video', canvasWidth: 560, canvasHeight: 315, icon: <Monitor className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
    '2.39:1': { label: '2.39:1 CinemaScope', className: 'aspect-[2.39/1]', canvasWidth: 560, canvasHeight: 234, icon: <Tv className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
    '1.43:1': { label: '1.43:1 IMAX', className: 'aspect-[1.43/1]', canvasWidth: 560, canvasHeight: 392, icon: <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
    '1:1': { label: '1:1 Square', className: 'aspect-square', canvasWidth: 420, canvasHeight: 420, icon: <Layout className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> },
    '9:16': { label: '9:16 Portrait', className: 'aspect-[9/16]', canvasWidth: 281, canvasHeight: 500, icon: <Smartphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> }
  };

  const activeSlide = slides.find(s => s.id === activeSlideId) || slides[0];

  // --- INITIAL LOAD: FETCH FROM FIRESTORE OR IDB/LOCALSTORAGE ---
  useEffect(() => {
    const initStorage = async () => {
      setIsSyncing(true);
      try {
        const cloudProjects = await getDocsFromFirestore('storyboards');
        if (cloudProjects && cloudProjects.length > 0) {
          setProjects(cloudProjects);
          const savedActiveId = localStorage.getItem('last_active_storyboard_id') || cloudProjects[0].id;
          const found = cloudProjects.find(p => p.id === savedActiveId) || cloudProjects[0];
          setSlidesUndoStack([]);
          setSlidesRedoStack([]);
          setActiveProjectId(found.id);
          setProjectName(found.name);
          setAspectRatio(found.aspectRatio || '16:9');
          setSlides(found.slides || []);
          setActiveSlideId(found.slides?.[0]?.id || '');
          setCloudStatus('synced');
        } else {
          // Fall back to local storage
          const local = localStorage.getItem('adv_storyboard_projects');
          if (local) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(local);
            setProjects(parsed);
            if (parsed.length > 0) {
              const activeProj = parsed[0];
              setSlidesUndoStack([]);
              setSlidesRedoStack([]);
              setActiveProjectId(activeProj.id);
              setProjectName(activeProj.name);
              setAspectRatio(activeProj.aspectRatio || '16:9');
              setSlides(activeProj.slides || []);
              setActiveSlideId(activeProj.slides?.[0]?.id || '');
            }
          } else {

            const defaultProj: StoryboardProject = {
              id: defaultId,
              name: 'Epic Cyberpunk Concept Reel',

                },
                {

            };
            setProjects([defaultProj]);

      } catch (err) {

        setCloudStatus('error');
      } finally {
        setIsSyncing(false);
      }
    };
    initStorage();
  }, []);

  // --- SAVE CURRENT ACTIVE PROJECT (DEBOUNCED SYNC) ---
  const saveActiveProject = async (projId: string, name: string, ratio: string, currentSlides: StoryboardSlide[]) => {
    if (!projId || currentSlides.length === 0) return;
    setCloudStatus('syncing');
    
    const projectToSave: StoryboardProject = {
      id: projId,
      name,
      aspectRatio: ratio,
      slides: currentSlides,
      updatedAt: Date.now(),
      createdAt: projects.find(p => p.id === projId)?.createdAt || Date.now()
    };

    try {
      // Update local state list
      setProjects(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === projId ? projectToSave : p));
      
      // Save to LocalStorage list
      try {
        const localList = localStorage.getItem('adv_storyboard_projects');
        let parsedList: StoryboardProject[] = [];
        if (localList) {
          parsedList = JSON.parse(localList);
        }
        const existingIdx = parsedList.findIndex(p => p.id === projId);
        if (existingIdx !== -1) {
          parsedList[existingIdx] = projectToSave;
        } else {
          parsedList.push(projectToSave);
        }
        localStorage.setItem('adv_storyboard_projects', JSON.stringify(parsedList));
      } catch (localErr) {
        console.warn("Local storage write failed (likely quota exceeded), continuing with Firestore sync:", localErr);
      }

      // Save to Firebase
      await saveDocToFirestore('storyboards', projId, projectToSave);
      setCloudStatus('synced');
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Sync to cloud deferred/failed:", e);
      setCloudStatus('error');
    }
  };

  // Trigger debounced saves when things change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeProjectId || slides.length === 0) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      saveActiveProject(activeProjectId, projectName, aspectRatio, slides);
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [slides, aspectRatio, projectName, activeProjectId]);

  // Load the active slide's zoom level and pan offset when selected slide changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSlide) {
      setZoomLevel(activeSlide.zoomLevel || 1);

      });

  // Bake any unbaked sketchpad text if the drawing tool mode changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (drawMode !== 'text' && drawMode !== 'select' && activeText) {

      const ctx = canvas?.getContext('2d');

        if (canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) {

        ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
        ctx.fillText(activeText.text, activeText.x, activeText.y);
        
        // Save state to sketchpad undo stack
        const savedData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        setUndoStack(prev => [...prev.slice(-19), savedData]);
        setActiveText(null);
      }
    }
  }, [drawMode, activeText, drawWidth, drawColor]);

  // --- PROJECT SWITCHING / CREATION / DELETION ---
  const handleLoadProject = (projId: string) => {
    const selected = projects.find(p => p.id === projId);
    if (!selected) return;
    
    setSlidesUndoStack([]);
    setSlidesRedoStack([]);
    setActiveProjectId(selected.id);
    setProjectName(selected.name);
    setAspectRatio(selected.aspectRatio || '16:9');
    setSlides(selected.slides || []);
    setActiveSlideId(selected.slides?.[0]?.id || '');
    localStorage.setItem('last_active_storyboard_id', selected.id);
    triggerAudioBeep(550, 'sine', 0.1);
  };

  const handleCreateNewProject = async () => {
    const newId = `proj-${Date.now()}`;
    const newProject: StoryboardProject = {
      id: newId,
      name: `New Storyboard Reel ${projects.length + 1}`,
      aspectRatio: '16:9',
      slides: [
        {
          id: `slide-${Date.now()}`,
          sceneNo: '1',
          shotNo: '1',
          imageUrl: '',
          shotType: 'Medium Shot',
          angle: 'Eye Level',
          movement: 'Static',
          action: 'Describe the opening scene action...',
          dialogue: 'Introductory voiceover or ambient audio...',
          duration: 3
        }
      ],
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };

    setProjects(prev => [...prev, newProject]);
    setSlidesUndoStack([]);
    setSlidesRedoStack([]);
    setActiveProjectId(newId);
    setProjectName(newProject.name);
    setAspectRatio(newProject.aspectRatio);
    setSlides(newProject.slides);
    setActiveSlideId(newProject.slides[0].id);
    localStorage.setItem('last_active_storyboard_id', newId);

    try {
      await saveDocToFirestore('storyboards', newId, newProject);
      setCloudStatus('synced');
    } catch {
      setCloudStatus('local');
    }
    triggerAudioBeep(650, 'sine', 0.12);
  };

  const handleDeleteProject = async (projId: string) => {
    if (projects.length <= 1) {
      alert("You must keep at least one storyboard project profile.");
      return;
    }
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this storyboard? This action cannot be undone.")) return;

    const remaining = projects.filter(p => p.id !== projId);
    setProjects(remaining);
    
    // Save updated list locally
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('adv_storyboard_projects', JSON.stringify(remaining));
    } catch (localErr) {
      console.warn("Local storage write failed (likely quota exceeded) during delete:", localErr);
    }

    // Delete from Cloud
    try {
      await deleteDocFromFirestore('storyboards', projId);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Deferred cloud deletion:", e);
    }

    // Switch to another project
    const nextProj = remaining[0];
    setSlidesUndoStack([]);
    setSlidesRedoStack([]);
    setActiveProjectId(nextProj.id);
    setProjectName(nextProj.name);
    setAspectRatio(nextProj.aspectRatio || '16:9');
    setSlides(nextProj.slides || []);
    setActiveSlideId(nextProj.slides?.[0]?.id || '');
    localStorage.setItem('last_active_storyboard_id', nextProj.id);

    triggerAudioBeep(220, 'sine', 0.15);
  };

  // --- AUDIO SYNTH BEAVER ---
  const triggerAudioBeep = (freq = 440, type: OscillatorType = 'sine', duration = 0.15) => {
    if (!soundEnabled) return;
    try {
      const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext)();
      const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
      
      osc.type = type;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gainNode.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
      
      osc.connect(gainNode);
      gainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Audio playback not allowed or supported', e);
    }
  };

  // --- VOICEOVER NARRATOR TTS SYSTEM ---
  const speakSlideScratchVoiceover = (text: string) => {
    if (!voiceoverEnabled) return;
    try {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      // Strip bracketed sound effects like [SFX: Siren]
      const cleanText = text.replace(/\[.*?\]/g, '').trim();
      if (!cleanText) return;

      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanText);
      utterance.rate = voiceRate;
      utterance.pitch = voicePitch;
      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Speech Synthesis failed:", e);
    }
  };

  // --- PLAYBACK TIMERS & LOOPS ---
  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: any;
    let progressInterval: any;

    if (isPlaying) {
      const currentSlide = slides[playbackIndex];
      if (!currentSlide) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        return;
      }

      triggerAudioBeep(520, 'triangle', 0.08);
      setPlaybackProgress(0);

      // Read text-to-speech aloud
      speakSlideScratchVoiceover(currentSlide.dialogue || currentSlide.action);

      // Slide Switch Timer
      interval = setTimeout(() => {
        if (playbackIndex < slides.length - 1) {
          setPlaybackIndex(prev => prev + 1);
        } else {
          setIsPlaying(false); // end of sequence
          triggerAudioBeep(330, 'sawtooth', 0.3);
          if (voiceoverEnabled) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        }
      }, currentSlide.duration * 1000);

      // Smooth progress bar update
      const steps = currentSlide.duration * 20; 
      let currentStep = 0;
      progressInterval = setInterval(() => {
        currentStep++;
        setPlaybackProgress((currentStep / steps) * 100);
      }, 50);
    }

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(interval);
      clearInterval(progressInterval);
    };
  }, [isPlaying, playbackIndex]);

  const startAnimatic = () => {
    if (slides.length === 0) return;
    setPlaybackIndex(0);
    setPlaybackProgress(0);
    setIsPlaying(true);
  };

  // --- SLIDE CRUD OPERATIONS ---
  const handleAddSlide = () => {
    const newId = `slide-${Date.now()}`;
    const newSlide: StoryboardSlide = {
      id: newId,
      sceneNo: String(slides.length > 0 ? Math.max(...slides.map(s => parseInt(s.sceneNo) || 1)) : 1),
      shotNo: String(slides.length > 0 ? slides.length + 1 : 1),
      imageUrl: activeSlide ? activeSlide.imageUrl : '',
      shotType: activeSlide ? activeSlide.shotType : 'Medium Shot',
      angle: activeSlide ? activeSlide.angle : 'Eye Level',
      movement: activeSlide ? activeSlide.movement : 'Static',
      action: 'Describe the visuals occurring in this frame...',
      dialogue: activeSlide ? activeSlide.dialogue : 'Dialogue or background music cue...',
      duration: activeSlide ? activeSlide.duration : 3,
      zoomLevel: activeSlide?.zoomLevel ?? 1,
      panX: activeSlide?.panX ?? 0,
      panY: activeSlide?.panY ?? 0
    };
    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    const nextSlides = [...slides, newSlide];
    setSlides(nextSlides);
    setActiveSlideId(newId);
    triggerAudioBeep(600, 'sine', 0.08);
  };

  const handleDeleteSlide = (id: string) => {
    if (slides.length <= 1) {
      alert("You must keep at least 1 slide in the storyboard.");
      return;
    }
    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    const idx = slides.findIndex(s => s.id === id);
    const updated = slides.filter(s => s.id !== id);
    setSlides(updated);
    if (activeSlideId === id) {
      setActiveSlideId(updated[Math.max(0, idx - 1)].id);
    }
    triggerAudioBeep(220, 'sine', 0.15);
  };

  const updateSlideField = (id: string, field: keyof StoryboardSlide, value: any) => {
    if (field === 'shotType' || field === 'angle' || field === 'movement' || field === 'duration' || field === 'imageUrl') {
      pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    }
    setSlides(slides.map(s => s.id === id ? { ...s, [field]: value } : s));
  };

  const updateSlideZoomAndPan = (id: string, zoom: number, px: number, py: number, immediateSave: boolean = false) => {
    const nextSlides = slides.map(s => s.id === id ? { ...s, zoomLevel: zoom, panX: px, panY: py } : s);
    setSlides(nextSlides);
    if (immediateSave && activeProjectId) {
      saveActiveProject(activeProjectId, projectName, aspectRatio, nextSlides);
    }
  };

  const handleMove = (index: number, direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
    if (direction === 'up' && index === 0) return;
    if (direction === 'down' && index === slides.length - 1) return;
    
    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    const targetIdx = direction === 'up' ? index - 1 : index + 1;
    const nextSlides = [...slides];
    const temp = nextSlides[index];
    nextSlides[index] = nextSlides[targetIdx];
    nextSlides[targetIdx] = temp;
    
    setSlides(nextSlides);
    triggerAudioBeep(450, 'sine', 0.05);
  };

  const handleMoveMultiple = (direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'start' | 'end' | 'index', targetIndex?: number) => {
    if (selectedSlideIds.length === 0) return;
    
    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    const selectedSet = new Set(selectedSlideIds);
    
    if (direction === 'start') {
      const selected = slides.filter(s => selectedSet.has(s.id));
      const unselected = slides.filter(s => !selectedSet.has(s.id));
      setSlides([...selected, ...unselected]);
    } else if (direction === 'end') {
      const selected = slides.filter(s => selectedSet.has(s.id));
      const unselected = slides.filter(s => !selectedSet.has(s.id));
      setSlides([...unselected, ...selected]);
    } else if (direction === 'up') {
      const newSlides = [...slides];
      for (let i = 1; i < newSlides.length; i++) {
        if (selectedSet.has(newSlides[i].id) && !selectedSet.has(newSlides[i-1].id)) {
          const temp = newSlides[i];
          newSlides[i] = newSlides[i-1];
          newSlides[i-1] = temp;
        }
      }
      setSlides(newSlides);
    } else if (direction === 'down') {
      const newSlides = [...slides];
      for (let i = newSlides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (selectedSet.has(newSlides[i].id) && !selectedSet.has(newSlides[i+1].id)) {
          const temp = newSlides[i];
          newSlides[i] = newSlides[i+1];
          newSlides[i+1] = temp;
        }
      }
      setSlides(newSlides);
    } else if (direction === 'index' && typeof targetIndex === 'number') {
      if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex > slides.length) return;
      const selected = slides.filter(s => selectedSet.has(s.id));
      const unselected = slides.filter(s => !selectedSet.has(s.id));
      
      const result = [...unselected];
      result.splice(targetIndex, 0, ...selected);
      setSlides(result);
    }
    triggerAudioBeep(450, 'sine', 0.05);
  };

  const handleDuplicate = (slide: StoryboardSlide) => {
    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    const newId = `slide-dup-${Date.now()}`;
    const duplicated: StoryboardSlide = {
      ...slide,
      id: newId,
      shotNo: `${slide.shotNo} Copy`
    };
    const index = slides.findIndex(s => s.id === slide.id);
    const nextSlides = [...slides];
    nextSlides.splice(index + 1, 0, duplicated);
    setSlides(nextSlides);
    setActiveSlideId(newId);
    triggerAudioBeep(650, 'sine', 0.1);
  };

  // --- SHAPE DRAWING METHODS ---
  const startDrawing = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    if (drawMode === 'pan') {
      setIsPanning(true);
      panStartRef.current = { x: e.clientX - panOffset.x, y: e.clientY - panOffset.y };
      triggerAudioBeep(600, 'sine', 0.05);
      return;
    }

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
    const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);

    drawStartPos.current = { x, y };
    canvasSnapshot.current = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // If they clicked on the canvas in text or select mode
    if (drawMode === 'text' || drawMode === 'select') {
      if (activeText) {
        const textFontSize = activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14);
        ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
        const textWidth = ctx.measureText(activeText.text).width;
        const textHeight = textFontSize;

        const hx = activeText.x + textWidth;
        const hy = activeText.y;

        // Check if clicked inside or near bottom-right handle (within 12px)
        if (Math.abs(x - hx) <= 12 && Math.abs(y - hy) <= 12) {
          setIsResizingText(true);
          drawStartPos.current = { x, y };
          return;
        }

        // Check if clicked inside active text's bounds
        if (x >= activeText.x - 10 && x <= activeText.x + textWidth + 10 &&
            y >= activeText.y - textHeight - 10 && y <= activeText.y + 10) {
          setIsDraggingText(true);
          textDragOffset.current = { x: x - activeText.x, y: y - activeText.y };
          return;
        } else {
          // Clicked outside existing activeText
          // Bake it and deselect
          if (canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) {
            ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);
          }
          ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
          ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
          ctx.fillText(activeText.text, activeText.x, activeText.y);

          // Save the canvas state with the baked text to the sketchpad undo stack
          const savedData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
          setUndoStack(prev => [...prev.slice(-19), savedData]);
          setRedoStack([]);
          setActiveText(null);
          canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current = null;
          
          if (drawMode === 'select') {
            // Just bake and clear, don't create new text in select mode
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      if (drawMode === 'select') {
        // In select mode, clicking outside with no activeText does nothing
        return;
      }

      // Placed text immediately from textToInsert input!
      const enteredText = textToInsert.trim() || 'Camera Direction';
      const textFontSize = drawWidth * 3 + 14;

      // Save canvas state BEFORE drawing this text
      canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // Push into drawing undo stack for drawing recovery
      const currentData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      setUndoStack(prev => [...prev.slice(-19), currentData]);
      setRedoStack([]);

      // Draw text with a subtle helper border/indicator
      ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
      ctx.fillText(enteredText, x, y);

      // Draw selection helper box
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      const textWidth = ctx.measureText(enteredText).width;
      ctx.strokeRect(x - 5, y - textFontSize - 5, textWidth + 10, textFontSize + 10);
      ctx.setLineDash([]); // reset

      // Draw resize handle
      ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
      ctx.fillRect(x + textWidth, y, 8, 8);

      setActiveText({ text: enteredText, x, y, fontSize: textFontSize });
      triggerAudioBeep(600, 'sine', 0.05);
      return;
    }

    // Default Brush/Eraser/Shape starting flow
    // Push into Undo history stack
    const currentData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    setUndoStack(prev => [...prev.slice(-19), currentData]);
    setRedoStack([]); // reset redo on new stroke

    if (drawMode === 'brush' || drawMode === 'eraser') {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      ctx.strokeStyle = drawMode === 'eraser' ? '#0f172a' : drawColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = drawWidth;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    }
    setIsDrawing(true);
  };

  const draw = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    if (drawMode === 'pan') {
      if (isPanning) {
        const nextX = e.clientX - panStartRef.current.x;
        const nextY = e.clientY - panStartRef.current.y;
        setPanOffset({ x: nextX, y: nextY });
      }
      return;
    }

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (canvas.width / rect.width);
    const y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (canvas.height / rect.height);

    if (drawMode === 'text' || drawMode === 'select') {
      if (activeText && canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) {
        let textFontSize = activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14);
        let newX = activeText.x;
        let newY = activeText.y;

        if (isDraggingText) {
          newX = x - textDragOffset.current.x;
          newY = y - textDragOffset.current.y;
        } else if (isResizingText) {
          // Resize: update font size based on the drag width from activeText.x
          const dx = x - activeText.x;
          textFontSize = Math.max(12, Math.min(150, Math.round(dx / (activeText.text.length * 0.55))));
        } else {
          // Just hovering in select mode, dynamically update the cursor style
          ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
          const textWidth = ctx.measureText(activeText.text).width;
          const hx = activeText.x + textWidth;
          const hy = activeText.y;

          if (Math.abs(x - hx) <= 12 && Math.abs(y - hy) <= 12) {
            canvas.style.cursor = 'se-resize';
          } else if (x >= activeText.x - 10 && x <= activeText.x + textWidth + 10 &&
                     y >= activeText.y - textFontSize - 10 && y <= activeText.y + 10) {
            canvas.style.cursor = 'move';
          } else {
            canvas.style.cursor = drawMode === 'select' ? 'default' : 'crosshair';
          }
          return;
        }

        // Restore snapshot to clear previous frame text drawing
        ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);

        // Draw the text at the new position / size
        ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
        ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
        ctx.fillText(activeText.text, newX, newY);

        // Draw dragging/selection helper box
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
        const textWidth = ctx.measureText(activeText.text).width;
        ctx.strokeRect(newX - 5, newY - textFontSize - 5, textWidth + 10, textFontSize + 10);
        ctx.setLineDash([]); // reset

        // Draw handle at bottom-right corner
        ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
        ctx.fillRect(newX + textWidth, newY, 8, 8);

        setActiveText({ text: activeText.text, x: newX, y: newY, fontSize: textFontSize });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!isDrawing) return;

    const startX = drawStartPos.current.x;
    const startY = drawStartPos.current.y;

    if (drawMode === 'brush' || drawMode === 'eraser') {
      ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      // Restore pre-stroke snapshot to clear ghost frame preview
      if (canvasSnapshot.current) {
        ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshot.current, 0, 0);
      }

      ctx.strokeStyle = drawColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = drawWidth;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

      if (drawMode === 'line') {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (drawMode === 'rect') {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.rect(startX, startY, x - startX, y - startY);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (drawMode === 'circle') {
        ctx.beginPath();
        const radius = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - startX, 2) + Math.pow(y - startY, 2));
        ctx.arc(startX, startY, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (drawMode === 'arrow') {
        drawArrow(ctx, startX, startY, x, y, drawWidth);
      }
    }
  };

  const stopDrawing = () => {
    if (drawMode === 'pan') {
      if (isPanning) {
        setIsPanning(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (drawMode === 'text' || drawMode === 'select') {
      if (isDraggingText || isResizingText) {
        setIsDraggingText(false);
        setIsResizingText(false);
        const canvas = canvasRef.current;
        const ctx = canvas?.getContext('2d');
        if (canvas && ctx && canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current && activeText) {
          const textFontSize = activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14);
          ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);
          ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
          ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
          ctx.fillText(activeText.text, activeText.x, activeText.y);
          
          // Draw a small dashed focus outline
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#38bdf8';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
          const textWidth = ctx.measureText(activeText.text).width;
          ctx.strokeRect(activeText.x - 5, activeText.y - textFontSize - 5, textWidth + 10, textFontSize + 10);
          ctx.setLineDash([]); // reset

          // Draw resize handle
          ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
          ctx.fillRect(activeText.x + textWidth, activeText.y, 8, 8);

          // Save state to undo stack
          const savedData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
          setUndoStack(prev => [...prev.slice(-19), savedData]);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    setIsDrawing(false);
  };

  const drawArrow = (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, fromX: number, fromY: number, toX: number, toY: number, width: number) => {
    const headLength = Math.max(12, width * 3.5);
    const dx = toX - fromX;
    const dy = toY - fromY;
    const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fromX, fromY);
    ctx.lineTo(toX, toY);
    ctx.stroke();
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(toX, toY);
    ctx.lineTo(toX - headLength * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), toY - headLength * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
    ctx.lineTo(toX - headLength * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), toY - headLength * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle;
    ctx.fill();
  };

  const handleUndo = () => {
    setActiveText(null); // Clear active text during history restoration
    if (undoStack.length === 0) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    // Save redo snapshot
    const currentImg = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    setRedoStack(prev => [...prev, currentImg]);

    // Restore previous
    const previousImg = undoStack[undoStack.length - 1];
    setUndoStack(prev => prev.slice(0, -1));

    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    };
    img.src = previousImg;
    triggerAudioBeep(400, 'sine', 0.05);
  };

  const handleRedo = () => {
    setActiveText(null); // Clear active text during history restoration
    if (redoStack.length === 0) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const currentImg = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    setUndoStack(prev => [...prev, currentImg]);

    const nextImg = redoStack[redoStack.length - 1];
    setRedoStack(prev => prev.slice(0, -1));

    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    };
    img.src = nextImg;
    triggerAudioBeep(450, 'sine', 0.05);
  };

  const clearCanvas = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    setActiveText(null); // Clear active text on wipe

    // Add to undo before clearing
    const currentImg = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    setUndoStack(prev => [...prev, currentImg]);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    triggerAudioBeep(200, 'sine', 0.1);
  };

  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const zoomFactor = 0.1;
    let newZoom = zoomLevel;
    if (e.deltaY < 0) {
      newZoom = Math.min(4, zoomLevel + zoomFactor);
    } else {
      newZoom = Math.max(1, zoomLevel - zoomFactor);
    }
    setZoomLevel(parseFloat(newZoom.toFixed(2)));
  };

  const handleMainWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activeSlideId) return;
    const zoomFactor = 0.1;
    const currentZoom = activeSlide?.zoomLevel || 1;
    let newZoom = currentZoom;
    if (e.deltaY < 0) {
      newZoom = Math.min(4, currentZoom + zoomFactor);
    } else {
      newZoom = Math.max(1, currentZoom - zoomFactor);
    }
    const finalZoom = parseFloat(newZoom.toFixed(2));
    updateSlideZoomAndPan(activeSlideId, finalZoom, activeSlide?.panX || 0, activeSlide?.panY || 0);
  };

  const handleMainMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!activeSlideId) return;
    const currentZoom = activeSlide?.zoomLevel || 1;
    if (currentZoom <= 1) return; // Only pan when zoomed in
    setIsMainPanning(true);
    mainPanStartRef.current = {
      x: e.clientX - (activeSlide?.panX || 0),
      y: e.clientY - (activeSlide?.panY || 0)
    };
  };

  const handleMainMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isMainPanning || !activeSlideId) return;
    const nextX = e.clientX - mainPanStartRef.current.x;
    const nextY = e.clientY - mainPanStartRef.current.y;
    updateSlideZoomAndPan(activeSlideId, activeSlide?.zoomLevel || 1, nextX, nextY);
  };

  const handleMainMouseUp = () => {
    if (isMainPanning && activeSlideId) {
      setIsMainPanning(false);
      updateSlideZoomAndPan(activeSlideId, activeSlide?.zoomLevel || 1, activeSlide?.panX || 0, activeSlide?.panY || 0, true);
    } else {
      setIsMainPanning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMainMouseLeave = () => {
    if (isMainPanning && activeSlideId) {
      setIsMainPanning(false);
      updateSlideZoomAndPan(activeSlideId, activeSlide?.zoomLevel || 1, activeSlide?.panX || 0, activeSlide?.panY || 0, true);
    } else {
      setIsMainPanning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSystemReset = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Are you sure you want to perform a SYSTEM RESET? This will dump all images, delete all current storyboard slides, and start fresh with a clean slate.")) {
      return;
    }
    
    setIsSyncing(true);
    // Clear all Firestore storyboards
    try {
      const allProjects = await getDocsFromFirestore('storyboards');
      for (const p of allProjects) {
        await deleteDocFromFirestore('storyboards', p.id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to delete projects from Firestore during reset", err);
    }

    // Reset local state to default values
    const newProjId = `project-${Date.now()}`;
    const defaultSlides: StoryboardSlide[] = [
      {
        id: `slide-1`,
        sceneNo: '1',
        shotNo: '1',
        imageUrl: '',
        shotType: 'Establishing Shot',
        angle: 'Eye Level',
        movement: 'Static',
        action: 'Describe the opening scene action...',
        dialogue: '[SFX: Low background ambient drone]',
        duration: 3,
        zoomLevel: 1,
        panX: 0,
        panY: 0
      }
    ];

    const defaultProj = {
      id: newProjId,
      name: 'New Storyboard Project',
      aspectRatio: '16:9',
      slides: defaultSlides,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      updatedAt: Date.now()
    };

    setSelectedSlideIds([]);
    setSlidesUndoStack([]);
    setSlidesRedoStack([]);
    setProjects([defaultProj]);
    setActiveProjectId(newProjId);
    setProjectName(defaultProj.name);
    setAspectRatio('16:9');
    setSlides(defaultSlides);
    setActiveSlideId(defaultSlides[0].id);
    setZoomLevel(1);
    setPanOffset({ x: 0, y: 0 });

    try {
      await saveDocToFirestore('storyboards', newProjId, defaultProj);
      localStorage.setItem('last_active_storyboard_id', newProjId);
      localStorage.setItem('adv_storyboard_projects', JSON.stringify([defaultProj]));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to save default project to Firestore during reset", err);
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }

    triggerAudioBeep(300, 'sawtooth', 0.2);
    alert("System Reset Complete! All images dumped. A new clean storyboard has been created.");
  };

  const downloadCanvasScreenshot = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    // If there is active text, bake it before screenshot
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx && activeText && canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) {
      const textFontSize = activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14);
      ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);
      ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
      ctx.fillText(activeText.text, activeText.x, activeText.y);
    }

    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = dataUrl;
    link.download = `storyboard-sketch-${activeSlideId || 'sketch'}-${Date.now()}.png`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    
    triggerAudioBeep(750, 'sine', 0.1);
  };

  const saveCanvasDrawing = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx && activeText && canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) {
      // Bake final text without focus helper outline
      const textFontSize = activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14);
      ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);
      ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
      ctx.fillText(activeText.text, activeText.x, activeText.y);
      setActiveText(null);
    }
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    
    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);
    setSlides(prev => prev.map(s => s.id === activeSlideId ? { 
      ...s, 
      imageUrl: dataUrl,
      zoomLevel: zoomLevel,
      panX: panOffset.x,
      panY: panOffset.y
    } : s));

    setIsDrawingOpen(false);
    triggerAudioBeep(650, 'sine', 0.1);
  };

  const loadSlideOnCanvas = (slideObj: StoryboardSlide) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    setActiveText(null);
    setIsDraggingText(false);
    canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current = null;

    setZoomLevel(slideObj.zoomLevel || 1);
    setPanOffset({
      x: slideObj.panX || 0,
      y: slideObj.panY || 0
    });

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    if (slideObj.imageUrl && !slideObj.imageUrl.startsWith('linear-gradient')) {
      const img = new Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      img.onload = () => {
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const initialData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        setUndoStack([initialData]);
        setRedoStack([]);
      };
      img.src = slideObj.imageUrl;
    } else {
      const initialData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      setUndoStack([initialData]);
      setRedoStack([]);
    }
  };

  const takeFrameshotAndAddToNext = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx && activeText && canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current) {
      const textFontSize = activeText.fontSize || (drawWidth * 3 + 14);
      ctx.putImageData(canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current, 0, 0);
      ctx.font = `bold ${textFontSize}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = drawColor;
      ctx.fillText(activeText.text, activeText.x, activeText.y);
      setActiveText(null);
    }
    
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    const activeIndex = slides.findIndex(s => s.id === activeSlideId);
    
    const activeSlideObj = activeIndex !== -1 ? slides[activeIndex] : null;
    const currentScene = activeSlideObj ? parseInt(activeSlideObj.sceneNo) || 1 : 1;
    const currentShot = activeSlideObj ? parseInt(activeSlideObj.shotNo) || 1 : 1;

    const newId = `slide-shot-${Date.now()}`;
    const newSlide: StoryboardSlide = {
      id: newId,
      sceneNo: String(currentScene),
      shotNo: String(currentShot + 1),
      imageUrl: dataUrl, // Screenshot of current canvas is prefilled!
      shotType: activeSlideObj ? activeSlideObj.shotType : 'Medium Shot',
      angle: activeSlideObj ? activeSlideObj.angle : 'Eye Level',
      movement: activeSlideObj ? activeSlideObj.movement : 'Static',
      action: activeSlideObj ? `Frameshot from Scene ${currentScene} Shot ${currentShot}: ` + activeSlideObj.action : 'Describe the visuals occurring in this frame...',
      dialogue: activeSlideObj ? activeSlideObj.dialogue : 'Dialogue or background music cue...',
      duration: activeSlideObj ? activeSlideObj.duration : 3,
      zoomLevel: zoomLevel,
      panX: panOffset.x,
      panY: panOffset.y
    };

    pushSlidesStateToUndo(slides);

    const nextSlides = [...slides];
    if (activeIndex !== -1) {
      nextSlides[activeIndex] = {
        ...nextSlides[activeIndex],
        imageUrl: dataUrl,
        zoomLevel: zoomLevel,
        panX: panOffset.x,
        panY: panOffset.y
      };
      nextSlides.splice(activeIndex + 1, 0, newSlide);
    } else {
      nextSlides.push(newSlide);
    }

    setSlides(nextSlides);
    setActiveSlideId(newId);
    triggerAudioBeep(650, 'sine', 0.1);
    
    // Load this onto canvas
    loadSlideOnCanvas(newSlide);
  };

  const openDrawingCanvas = () => {
    setIsDrawingOpen(true);
    setZoomLevel(activeSlide?.zoomLevel || 1);
    setPanOffset({
      x: activeSlide?.panX || 0,
      y: activeSlide?.panY || 0
    });
    setIsPanning(false);
    // Reset undo/redo states and active text states for new pad session
    setUndoStack([]);
    setRedoStack([]);
    setActiveText(null);
    setIsDraggingText(false);
    canvasSnapshotBeforeText.current = null;

    const config = ASPECT_RATIOS[aspectRatio] || ASPECT_RATIOS['16:9'];

    setTimeout(() => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;
      
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // Preload image
      if (activeSlide.imageUrl && !activeSlide.imageUrl.startsWith('linear-gradient')) {
        const img = new Image();
        img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
        img.onload = () => {
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          // Set initial undo state once the image is drawn
          const initialData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
          setUndoStack([initialData]);
        };
        img.src = activeSlide.imageUrl;
      } else {
        // Set initial undo state with blank canvas
        const initialData = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        setUndoStack([initialData]);
      }
    }, 120);
  };

  // --- AI CINEMATIC SPEC ASSISTANT ---
  const handleAIEnhance = async () => {
    if (!aiPrompt.trim()) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const prompt = `You are an elite cinematic storyboard script doctor. Given this shot description concept: "${aiPrompt}", generate structured directions for a slide.
Response MUST be exactly in JSON format, like this:
{
  "shotType": "Medium Shot",
  "angle": "Low Angle",
  "movement": "Tracking",
  "action": "A cinematic description of the frame details...",
  "dialogue": "Character dialogue or sound FX cue..."
}`;
      const response = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt);
      const cleanedText = response.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
      const data = JSON.parse(cleanedText);
      
      updateSlideField(activeSlideId, 'shotType', data.shotType || 'Medium Shot');
      updateSlideField(activeSlideId, 'angle', data.angle || 'Eye Level');
      updateSlideField(activeSlideId, 'movement', data.movement || 'Static');
      updateSlideField(activeSlideId, 'action', data.action || '');
      updateSlideField(activeSlideId, 'dialogue', data.dialogue || '');
      setAiPrompt('');
      triggerAudioBeep(880, 'sine', 0.12);
