                      setPlaybackIndex(prev => prev + 1);
                      triggerAudioBeep(480, 'sine', 0.08);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={playbackIndex === slides.length - 1}
                  className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-sky-400 font-mono">
                Duration: {slides[playbackIndex]?.duration}s
              </span>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Cinematic Aspect Crop, Animatic Transition, Voiceover Narrator (TTS) Panel */}
      {isXLControlsOpen && (
        <div id="8" className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl relative mt-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-center">
            {/* Aspect Ratio Configurator */}
            <div className="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1">
                <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" /> Cinematic Aspect Crop
              </span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {Object.keys(ASPECT_RATIOS).map(ratioKey => (
                  <button
                    key={ratioKey}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setAspectRatio(ratioKey);
                      triggerAudioBeep(480, 'sine', 0.05);
                    }}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${aspectRatio === ratioKey ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white border-sky-500 shadow-sm shadow-sky-500/20' : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-850 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'}`}
                  >
                    {ASPECT_RATIOS[ratioKey].icon}
                    <span>{ratioKey}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Transition Styles */}
            <div className="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1">
                <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> Animatic Transition
              </span>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 bg-slate-950 p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-850">
                {(['cut', 'fade', 'wipe'] as const).map(style => (
                  <button
                    key={style}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setTransitionStyle(style);
                      triggerAudioBeep(460, 'sine', 0.05);
                    }}
                    className={`py-1.5 rounded text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase transition-all ${transitionStyle === style ? 'bg-slate-800 text-sky-400 shadow' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300'}`}
                  >
                    {style}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Voiceover Synthesizer Controls */}
            <div className="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-2 border-l border-slate-800 pl-4">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-400" /> Voiceover Narrator (TTS)
                </span>
                <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer">
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" 
                    checked={voiceoverEnabled} 
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setVoiceoverEnabled(e.target.checked);
                      triggerAudioBeep(500, 'sine', 0.08);
                    }} 
                    className="sr-only peer" 
                  />
                  <div className="w-7 h-4 bg-slate-950 rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-0.5 after:left-[2px] after:bg-slate-400 after:border-slate-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-3 after:w-3 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-indigo-600 peer-checked:after:bg-white"></div>
                </label>
              </span>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 opacity-80 peer-checked:opacity-100">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold mb-1">
                    <span>Speed: {voiceRate}x</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="0.6"
                    max="1.8"
                    step="0.1"
                    value={voiceRate}
                    disabled={!voiceoverEnabled}
                    onChange={(e) => setVoiceRate(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-indigo-500 bg-slate-950 h-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold mb-1">
                    <span>Pitch: {voicePitch}</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="0.5"
                    max="1.5"
                    step="0.1"
                    value={voicePitch}
                    disabled={!voiceoverEnabled}
                    onChange={(e) => setVoicePitch(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-indigo-500 bg-slate-950 h-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ZIP Export Modal */}
      {isZipModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-6 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div className="p-2 bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 rounded-lg">
                <Archive className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 uppercase tracking-wide">Export Slices as ZIP</h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Compresses all active storyboard frames into a single zip</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                ZIP Package Filename
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={zipFileName}
                onChange={(e) => setZipFileName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. action_sequence_storyboard"
                className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-200 placeholder-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 font-medium"
              />
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">
                Default name is set based on the first uploaded folder name: <span className="text-sky-400 font-mono font-bold">{sourceFolderName}</span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsZipModalOpen(false);
                  triggerAudioBeep(300, 'sine', 0.05);
                }}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border border-slate-850 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={exportZIP}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/10 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Export ZIP</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const formatDateToDDMMYY = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  const parts = dateStr.split('-');
  if (parts.length === 3) {
    const year = parts[0].slice(-2);
    const month = parts[1];
    const day = parts[2];
    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  }
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) {
      const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const year = String(d.getFullYear()).slice(-2);
      return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // fallback
  }
  return dateStr;
};

    description: 'Organizes unstructured text lists into highly structured tables with custom formulas.',
    author: 'sax/kooLabs',

    detailedScope: 'Dual-engine market intelligence tool. Features a "Market Research" mode to discover niches and gaps, and an "Idea Validator" mode to score demand, analyze competitors, establish pricing, and provide go/no-go recommendations for specific digital product ideas.'

];

export const StudioDatasheet: React.FC<StudioDatasheetProps> = ({ onRunTool, onClose }) => {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All tools');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'number' | 'title' | 'creationDate'>('number');
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
  const [selectedApp, setSelectedApp] = useState<AppRecord | null>(null);
  const [localTheme, setLocalTheme] = useState<'charcoal' | 'silver' | 'white'>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('creative_studio_theme');
    if (saved === 'charcoal' || saved === 'silver' || saved === 'white') {
      return saved;
    }
    return 'charcoal';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleThemeChange = () => {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('creative_studio_theme');
      if (saved === 'charcoal' || saved === 'silver' || saved === 'white') {
        setLocalTheme(saved);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('creative_studio_theme_change', handleThemeChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('creative_studio_theme_change', handleThemeChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // Dynamic state for apps list
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<AppRecord[]>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('studio_apps_database');
    if (saved) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        // If the parsed database still has old format IDs, reset it to the new APPS_DATABASE
        if (parsed.some((app: any) => app.id === 'bring_to_life')) {
          localStorage.setItem('studio_apps_database', JSON.stringify(APPS_DATABASE));
          return APPS_DATABASE;
        }
        return parsed;
      } catch (e) {
        return APPS_DATABASE;
      }
    }
    return APPS_DATABASE;
  });

  // Editing helper states
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editTitle, setEditTitle] = useState('');
  const [editDescription, setEditDescription] = useState('');
  const [editAuthor, setEditAuthor] = useState('');
  const [editCreationDate, setEditCreationDate] = useState('');
  const [editCategory, setEditCategory] = useState<AppRecord['category']>('Web');
  const [editTechStack, setEditTechStack] = useState('');
  const [editInputs, setEditInputs] = useState('');
  const [editOutputs, setEditOutputs] = useState('');
  const [editDetailedScope, setEditDetailedScope] = useState('');

  const handleStartEdit = (app: AppRecord) => {
    setEditTitle(app.title);
    setEditDescription(app.description);
    setEditAuthor(app.author);
    setEditCreationDate(app.creationDate);
    setEditCategory(app.category);
    setEditTechStack(app.techStack.join(', '));
    setEditInputs(app.inputs.join(', '));
    setEditOutputs(app.outputs.join(', '));
    setEditDetailedScope(app.detailedScope);
    setIsEditing(true);
  };

  const handleSaveEdit = () => {
    if (!selectedApp) return;
    const updatedApps = apps.map(app => {
      if (app.id === selectedApp.id) {
        return {
          ...app,
          title: editTitle,
          description: editDescription,
          author: editAuthor,
          creationDate: editCreationDate,
          category: editCategory,
          techStack: editTechStack.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
          inputs: editInputs.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
          outputs: editOutputs.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
          detailedScope: editDetailedScope
        };
      }
      return app;
    });
    
    setApps(updatedApps);
    localStorage.setItem('studio_apps_database', JSON.stringify(updatedApps));
    
    const newSelected = updatedApps.find(app => app.id === selectedApp.id) || null;
    setSelectedApp(newSelected);
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  // Filter & Search Logic
  const categories = ['All tools', 'Content', 'Media', 'Research', 'Marketing', 'Web'];

  const filteredApps = apps.filter(app => {
    const matchesSearch = 
      app.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      app.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      app.author.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      app.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      app.techStack.some(t => t.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
      
    const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'All tools' || app.category === selectedCategory;
    
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  // Sorting Logic
  const sortedApps = [...filteredApps].sort((a, b) => {
    let comparison = 0;
    if (sortBy === 'number') {
      comparison = a.number - b.number;
    } else if (sortBy === 'title') {
      comparison = a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
    } else if (sortBy === 'creationDate') {
      comparison = a.creationDate.localeCompare(b.creationDate);
    }
    return sortOrder === 'asc' ? comparison : -comparison;
  });

  const toggleSort = (field: 'number' | 'title' | 'creationDate') => {
    if (sortBy === field) {
      setSortOrder(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortBy(field);
      setSortOrder('asc');
    }
  };

  const exportToExcelCSV = () => {
    const BOM = '\uFEFF';
    const cleanField = (str: string) => {
      if (!str) return '';
      return str.replace(/\r?\n|\r/g, ' ').replace(/"/g, '""');
    };

    const headers = ['ID', 'App Name / Title', 'Functional Summary', 'Creation Date', 'Developer / Author'];
    const rows = apps.map(app => [
      app.number,
      `"${cleanField(app.title)}"`,
      `"${cleanField(app.description)}"`,
      `"${cleanField(formatDateToDDMMYY(app.creationDate))}"`,
      `"${cleanField(app.author)}"`
    ]);
    
    const csvContent = BOM + 'sep=,\n' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute("download", `app_info_datasheet_${Date.now()}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  const exportToTxt = () => {
    const titleLine = "APP INFO DATASHEET REGISTRY\n" + "===========================\n\n";
    
    const blocks = apps.map(app => {
      return `ID: ${app.number}\n` +
             `App Name / Title: ${app.title}\n` +
             `Functional Summary: ${app.description}\n` +
             `Creation Date: ${formatDateToDDMMYY(app.creationDate)}\n` +
             `Developer / Author: ${app.author}\n` +
             "--------------------------------------------------";
    }).join('\n\n');
    
    const txtContent = titleLine + blocks;
    const blob = new Blob([txtContent], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute("download", `app_info_datasheet_${Date.now()}.txt`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  // Local theme design spec mapping
  const themeStyles = {
    charcoal: {
      bg: 'bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-900',
      text: 'text-zinc-100',
      textDim: 'text-zinc-400',
      textMuted: 'text-zinc-500',
      textHighlight: 'text-white',
      border: 'border-zinc-800',
      borderSubtle: 'border-zinc-900',
      panelBg: 'bg-zinc-950',
      cardBg: 'bg-zinc-900/40',
      rowHover: 'hover:bg-zinc-900/40',
      inputBg: 'bg-zinc-900',
      badgeBg: 'bg-zinc-900 text-sky-400 border-zinc-850',
      tableHeaderBg: 'bg-zinc-900/50',
      headerGradient: 'from-teal-400 to-sky-500',
      btnActive: 'bg-teal-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-teal-900/20',
      btnInactive: 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-200 border-zinc-800',
      modalBg: 'bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-900'
    },
    silver: {
      bg: 'bg-zinc-500 border-zinc-600',
      text: 'text-blue-950',
      textDim: 'text-indigo-950',
      textMuted: 'text-blue-900',
      textHighlight: 'text-blue-950 font-extrabold',
      border: 'border-zinc-600',
      borderSubtle: 'border-zinc-400',
      panelBg: 'bg-zinc-600',
      cardBg: 'bg-zinc-300/90 border-zinc-400 shadow-md',
      rowHover: 'hover:bg-zinc-300/60',
      inputBg: 'bg-zinc-100',
      badgeBg: 'bg-blue-200 text-blue-950 border-blue-300',
      tableHeaderBg: 'bg-zinc-400/50',
      headerGradient: 'from-blue-950 via-indigo-950 to-blue-900',
      btnActive: 'bg-blue-950 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-950/25',
      btnInactive: 'bg-zinc-300 text-blue-950 hover:bg-zinc-200 hover:text-blue-950 border-zinc-400',
      modalBg: 'bg-zinc-300 border-zinc-400'
    },
    white: {
      bg: 'bg-white border-zinc-200',
      text: 'text-zinc-800',
      textDim: 'text-zinc-600',
      textMuted: 'text-zinc-400',
      textHighlight: 'text-zinc-950 font-extrabold',
      border: 'border-zinc-200',
      borderSubtle: 'border-zinc-100',
      panelBg: 'bg-zinc-50',
      cardBg: 'bg-zinc-50 border-zinc-100 shadow-sm',
      rowHover: 'hover:bg-zinc-100/60',
      inputBg: 'bg-white',
      badgeBg: 'bg-zinc-100 text-sky-600 border-zinc-200',
      tableHeaderBg: 'bg-zinc-100',
      headerGradient: 'from-teal-600 to-sky-600',
      btnActive: 'bg-teal-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-teal-500/10',
      btnInactive: 'bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-800 border-zinc-200',
      modalBg: 'bg-white border-zinc-200'
    }
  };

  const st = themeStyles[localTheme];

  return (
    <div className={`p-6 md:p-8 rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-300 shadow-2xl flex flex-col gap-6 ${st.bg} ${st.text}`}>
      
      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className={`flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between border-b pb-6 gap-4 ${st.border}`}>
        <div>
          <h2 className={`text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r ${st.headerGradient} flex items-center gap-3`}>
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-400 border border-teal-500/20">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-7 h-7" />
            </span>
            App InfoDatasheet
          </h2>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {/* Local Theme Selector (Cycle) */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              const themes: ('charcoal' | 'silver' | 'white')[] = ['charcoal', 'silver', 'white'];
              const nextIndex = (themes.indexOf(localTheme) + 1) % themes.length;
              const nextTheme = themes[nextIndex];
              setLocalTheme(nextTheme);
              localStorage.setItem('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
              window.dispatchEvent(new Event('creative_studio_theme_change'));
            }}
            className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full border-2 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
              localTheme === 'charcoal' 
                ? 'bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-600 shadow-md shadow-black/40' 
                : localTheme === 'silver' 
                ? 'bg-zinc-300 border-zinc-400 shadow-md shadow-zinc-500/20' 
                : 'bg-white border-zinc-300 shadow-md'
            }`}
            title={`Cycle theme (current: ${localTheme})`}
          />

          {/* Export Dropdown */}
          <div className="relative">
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsExportDropdownOpen(!isExportDropdownOpen)}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600/10 hover:bg-emerald-600/20 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Export Datasheet</span>
              <ChevronRight className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-transform ${isExportDropdownOpen ? 'rotate-90' : ''}`} />
            </button>
            
            {isExportDropdownOpen && (
              <>
                <div 
                  className="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-transparent" 
                  onClick={() => setIsExportDropdownOpen(false)} 
                />
                <div className={`absolute right-0 mt-2 w-56 rounded-xl border p-1.5 shadow-2xl z-50 animate-fade-in ${st.modalBg} ${st.border}`}>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      exportToExcelCSV();
                      setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 ${st.rowHover}`}
                  >
                    <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
                    <span>Export Excel CSV (.csv)</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      exportToTxt();
                      setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 ${st.rowHover}`}
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>Export Plain Text (.txt)</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          
          {/* Close Registry Button (Red X) */}
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 bg-red-600/10 hover:bg-red-600/20 border border-red-500/20 hover:border-red-500/40 text-red-500 hover:text-red-400 rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
            title="Close Registry"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>



      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className={`flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4 items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-xl border shadow-lg ${st.cardBg} ${st.borderSubtle}`}>
        
        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative w-full lg:max-w-md">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-zinc-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search by title, author, tech stack..."
            className={`w-full border rounded-lg pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500 transition-colors ${st.inputBg} ${st.border} ${st.text}`}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Categories Button Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full lg:w-auto">
          {categories.map(cat => (
            <button
              key={cat}
              onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-bold transition-all border ${
                selectedCategory === cat 
                ? st.btnActive 
                : st.btnInactive
              }`}
            >
              {cat}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>


      {/* Datasheet Interactive Spreadsheet Grid */}
      <div className={`border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl ${st.cardBg} ${st.borderSubtle}`}>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className={`border-b text-xs font-bold ${st.tableHeaderBg} ${st.borderSubtle} ${st.textDim}`}>
                <th className="p-4 w-20 cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-500/10 transition-colors" onClick={() => toggleSort('number')}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span># ID</span>
                    <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </div>
                </th>
                <th className="p-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-500/10 transition-colors" onClick={() => toggleSort('title')}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>App Name / Title</span>
                    <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </div>
                </th>
                <th className="p-4">Category</th>
                <th className="p-4">Primary Purpose & Description</th>
                <th className="p-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-zinc-500/10 transition-colors" onClick={() => toggleSort('creationDate')}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>Created Date</span>
                    <ArrowUpDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </div>
                </th>
                <th className="p-4">Author / Lab</th>
                <th className="p-4 text-center">Interactive</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-900/10 text-xs">
              {sortedApps.map((app) => (
                <tr 
                  key={app.id} 
                  className={`transition-colors cursor-pointer group ${st.rowHover} border-b ${st.borderSubtle}`}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedApp(app)}
                >
                  <td className={`p-4 font-mono font-bold ${st.textMuted}`}>
                    {app.number}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`p-4 font-bold ${st.text} group-hover:text-teal-500 transition-colors`}>
                    {app.title}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded bg-zinc-500/10 border border-zinc-500/15 text-[10px] font-bold text-sky-500">
                      {app.category}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className={`p-4 min-w-[260px] whitespace-normal break-words ${st.textDim}`} title={app.description}>
                    {app.description}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 font-mono">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-500 font-medium">
                      <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60" />
                      {formatDateToDDMMYY(app.creationDate)}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-pink-500 font-semibold">
                      <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60" />
                      {app.author}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-center">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setSelectedApp(app)}
                        className={`p-1.5 border rounded-lg transition-all ${st.btnInactive}`}
                        title="View specifications details"
                      >
                        <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => onRunTool(app.id)}
                        className="p-1.5 bg-teal-500/10 hover:bg-teal-500/20 border border-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 hover:text-teal-300 rounded-lg transition-all"
                        title="Run this application directly"
                      >
                        <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}

              {sortedApps.length === 0 && (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className={`p-12 text-center ${st.textMuted}`}>
                    No applications matched your search filters. Try typing another criteria.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* App Details Slide-Out / Drawer overlay */}
      {selectedApp && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-end animate-fade-in">
          <div className={`w-full max-w-2xl h-full border-l p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col justify-between shadow-2xl relative ${st.bg} ${st.border}`}>
            
            {isEditing ? (
              /* Editable Registry Form */
              <div className="space-y-6 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div className="space-y-5">
                  <div className={`flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-4 ${st.border}`}>
                    <div className="space-y-1">

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/SubtitlerTranslator.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { Video, Languages, Loader2, Download, Copy, Play } from 'lucide-react';
import { themeStyles } from '../../constants/creativeStudioTheme';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface SubtitlerTranslatorProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
  localTheme: string;
}

export const SubtitlerTranslator: React.FC<SubtitlerTranslatorProps> = ({ onBack, localTheme }) => {
  const [videoFile, setVideoFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [videoBase64, setVideoBase64] = useState<string>('');
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState<string>('English, Spanish, French');
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [subtitles, setSubtitles] = useState<{ language: string; srt: string }[]>([]);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const st = themeStyles[localTheme as keyof typeof themeStyles] || themeStyles.charcoal;

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setVideoFile(file);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        const result = e.target?.result as string;
        setVideoBase64(result.split(',')[1]);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleProcessVideo = async () => {
    if (!videoBase64 || !languages.trim()) return;
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setSubtitles([]);
    try {
      const mediaItem: MediaItem = {
        id: 'upload-video',
        name: videoFile?.name || 'video',
        mimeType: videoFile?.type || 'video/mp4',
        data: videoBase64,
        type: 'video'
      };

      const langList = languages.split(',').map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l);

      const prompt = `You are a professional video subtitler. Extract the spoken audio from this video and generate exact subtitles in standard SRT format. 
Please provide the translation in the following languages: ${langList.join(', ')}.

Format your response EXACTLY as a JSON array of objects. Each object must have a "language" key and an "srt" key containing the complete SRT format string. Do not include markdown codeblocks like \`\`\`json, just return the raw JSON array.`;

      const response = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, [mediaItem]);
      
      let jsonStr = response.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
      
      const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        setSubtitles(parsed);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert('Failed to process video subtitles. Make sure the video is supported and the response is valid JSON.');
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const downloadSRT = (language: string, content: string) => {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `subtitles_${language.toLowerCase()}.srt`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden animate-fade-in relative z-10 w-full">
      <div className={`p-4 sm:p-8 flex-1 overflow-y-auto ${st.bgApp}`}>
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-4 mb-8">
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${st.cardBg} border ${st.border}`}>
              <Languages className={`w-6 h-6 ${st.text}`} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h1 className={`text-2xl font-bold ${st.text}`}>Subtitler & Translator</h1>
              <p className={st.textDim}>Extract audio from video and instantly translate it into multiple standard SRT subtitle files.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <label className={`block text-sm font-medium ${st.text}`}>Upload Video File</label>
              
              <div 
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                className={`w-full h-48 border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors ${st.border} hover:bg-black/20`}
              >
                {videoFile ? (
                   <div className="text-center">
                     <Video className={`w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-2 ${st.textActive}`} />
                     <p className={`font-medium ${st.text}`}>{videoFile.name}</p>
                     <p className={`text-xs ${st.textDim}`}>Click to replace video</p>
                   </div>
                ) : (
                   <div className={`text-center ${st.textDim}`}>
                     <Video className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-50" />
                     <p>Click to upload a video</p>
                     <p className="text-xs">Supports MP4, WebM (max size dependent on API)</p>
                   </div>
                )}
                <input 
                  type="file" 
                  accept="video/mp4,video/webm"
                  className="hidden" 
                  ref={fileInputRef} 
                  onChange={handleFileUpload} 
                />
              </div>

              <label className={`block text-sm font-medium ${st.text} mt-4`}>Target Languages (comma separated)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={languages}
                onChange={(e) => setLanguages(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. English, Spanish, Japanese"
                className={`w-full bg-black/40 border rounded-xl p-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-opacity-50 ${st.border} ${st.text} ${st.focusRing}`}
              />
              
              <button
                onClick={handleProcessVideo}
                disabled={!videoFile || !languages.trim() || isProcessing}
                className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 transition-all mt-4 ${isProcessing || !videoFile || !languages.trim() ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : st.btnActive}`}
              >
                {isProcessing ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <Play className="w-5 h-5" />}
                <span>{isProcessing ? 'Extracting & Translating...' : 'Generate SRT Subtitles'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              <label className={`block text-sm font-medium ${st.text}`}>Generated SRT Files</label>
              <div className={`w-full h-[500px] bg-black/40 border rounded-xl p-4 overflow-y-auto ${st.border} custom-scrollbar`}>
                {subtitles.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className={`h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${st.textDim} text-center p-8`}>
                    <Languages className="w-12 h-12 mb-4 opacity-20" />
                    <p>Generated subtitles will appear here. You can preview and download them individually.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-6">
                    {subtitles.map((sub, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className={`rounded-xl border overflow-hidden ${st.cardBg} ${st.border}`}>
                        <div className={`px-4 py-3 border-b flex items-center justify-between bg-black/20 ${st.border}`}>
                          <h4 className={`font-semibold ${st.text}`}>{sub.language} Subtitles</h4>
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                             <button 
                               onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(sub.srt)}
                               className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg border hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors ${st.border} ${st.text}`}
                               title="Copy SRT"
                             >
                               <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
                             </button>
                             <button 
                               onClick={() => downloadSRT(sub.language, sub.srt)}
                               className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg border hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors ${st.border} ${st.text}`}
                               title="Download SRT File"
                             >
                               <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                             </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <pre className={`p-4 text-xs font-mono overflow-y-auto max-h-64 ${st.textDim} custom-scrollbar`}>
                          {sub.srt}
                        </pre>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/SwotAnalysis.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Eye, ShieldAlert, BarChart2, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface SwotAnalysisProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface SwotResult {
  strengths: string[];
  weaknesses: string[];
  opportunities: string[];
  threats: string[];
  strategicActions: {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    priority: 'High' | 'Medium' | 'Low';
  }[];
}

export const SwotAnalysis: React.FC<SwotAnalysisProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [perspective, setPerspective] = useState('Product Market Fit');
  const [customDrivers, setCustomDrivers] = useState('');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<SwotResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an elite Strategy Consultant and Management Partner. 
Analyze the provided ${selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'} and compile an exhaustive SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) analysis.

STRATEGIC PERSPECTIVE:
- Perspective Focus: ${perspective} (Tailor all parameters to evaluate this specific operational or business facet)
- Custom Constraints/Focus Drivers: ${customDrivers || 'Examine all variables based on general market entry, operations, and resilience.'}

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the SWOT data as a structured JSON object wrapped inside a codeblock.
The object must follow this strict TypeScript structure:
{
  "strengths": ["Strength 1 (Concrete fact from sources)", "Strength 2", "Strength 3"],
  "weaknesses": ["Weakness 1 (Concrete operational or structural risk)", "Weakness 2", "Weakness 3"],
  "opportunities": ["Opportunity 1 (External market or tech opportunity)", "Opportunity 2", "Opportunity 3"],
  "threats": ["Threat 1 (External competitive, regulatory, or market threat)", "Threat 2", "Threat 3"],
  "strategicActions": [
    {
      "title": "Action Item Name (e.g. Mitigate Weakness X with Strength Y)",
      "description": "Short description of how to operationalize this recommendation.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "title": "Action Item Name 2",
      "description": "Description...",
      "priority": "Medium"
    }
  ]
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (parsedData && parsedData.strengths && parsedData.weaknesses) {
        setResult(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed data was not structured correctly.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to formulate SWOT analysis in a structured format. Please verify your selected assets and try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyMarkdown = () => {
    if (!result) return;

    let mdText = `# 📊 Strategic SWOT Analysis: ${perspective}\n\n`;
    mdText += `Generated on: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}\n\n`;
    
    mdText += `## STRENGTHS (Internal, Positive)\n`;
    result.strengths.forEach(s => mdText += `- ${s}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## WEAKNESSES (Internal, Negative)\n`;
    result.weaknesses.forEach(w => mdText += `- ${w}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## OPPORTUNITIES (External, Positive)\n`;
    result.opportunities.forEach(o => mdText += `- ${o}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## THREATS (External, Negative)\n`;
    result.threats.forEach(t => mdText += `- ${t}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## STRATEGIC ACTION STRATEGY MAP\n`;
    result.strategicActions.forEach(act => {
      mdText += `### [${act.priority} Priority] ${act.title}\n`;
      mdText += `${act.description}\n\n`;
    });

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(mdText);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!result) return;

    let mdText = `# 📊 Strategic SWOT Analysis: ${perspective}\n\n`;
    mdText += `Generated on: ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}\n\n`;
    
    mdText += `## STRENGTHS\n`;
    result.strengths.forEach(s => mdText += `- ${s}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## WEAKNESSES\n`;
    result.weaknesses.forEach(w => mdText += `- ${w}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## OPPORTUNITIES\n`;
    result.opportunities.forEach(o => mdText += `- ${o}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## THREATS\n`;
    result.threats.forEach(t => mdText += `- ${t}\n`);
    mdText += `\n`;

    mdText += `## RECOMMENDATIONS\n`;
    result.strategicActions.forEach(act => {
      mdText += `### [${act.priority}] ${act.title}\n`;
      mdText += `${act.description}\n\n`;
    });

    const blob = new Blob([mdText], { type: 'text/markdown' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `swot-analysis-${perspective.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-${Date.now()}.md`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!result || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    let htmlContent = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>SWOT Strategic Evaluation</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <style>
        body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; background-color: #0b0f19; color: #f3f4f6; padding: 2rem; }
        .grid-quad { border: 1px solid #374151; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 12px; height: 100%; }
        .quad-title { font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-size: 0.875rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        <h1 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-violet-400 mb-1">📊 SWOT Strategic Evaluation</h1>
        <p class="text-gray-400 mb-8">Perspective: <strong>${perspective}</strong></p>

        <!-- 2x2 SWOT Grid -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8">
            <div class="grid-quad bg-emerald-950/20 border-emerald-800/40">
                <div class="quad-title text-emerald-400">💪 Strengths (Internal)</div>
                <ul class="space-y-2 text-sm text-gray-300 list-disc pl-5">
                    ${result.strengths.map(s => `<li>${s}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
            </div>
            <div class="grid-quad bg-rose-950/20 border-rose-800/40">
                <div class="quad-title text-rose-400">⚠️ Weaknesses (Internal)</div>
                <ul class="space-y-2 text-sm text-gray-300 list-disc pl-5">
                    ${result.weaknesses.map(w => `<li>${w}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
            </div>
            <div class="grid-quad bg-blue-950/20 border-blue-800/40">
                <div class="quad-title text-blue-400">🚀 Opportunities (External)</div>
                <ul class="space-y-2 text-sm text-gray-300 list-disc pl-5">
                    ${result.opportunities.map(o => `<li>${o}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
            </div>
            <div class="grid-quad bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-800/40">
                <div class="quad-title text-amber-400">🔥 Threats (External)</div>
                <ul class="space-y-2 text-sm text-gray-300 list-disc pl-5">
                    ${result.threats.map(t => `<li>${t}</li>`).join('')}
                </ul>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Recommendations -->
        <div class="p-6 bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 rounded-xl">
            <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-200 mb-4">Strategic Recommendation & Action Map</h2>
            <div class="space-y-4">
                ${result.strategicActions.map(act => `
                <div class="p-4 bg-gray-950 border border-gray-800/50 rounded-lg">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-1">
                        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-200">${act.title}</h3>
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                          act.priority === 'High' ? 'bg-red-900/40 text-red-400' : 'bg-yellow-900/40 text-yellow-400'
                        }">${act.priority} Priority</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">${act.description}</p>
                </div>
                `).join('')}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>`;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(htmlContent);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `SWOT: ${perspective}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-violet-400">
            <BarChart2 className="w-6 h-6" /> SWOT Strategic Desk
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Build interactive SWOT matrices evaluating enterprise, compliance, or strategic market vectors directly from sources.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {result && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopyMarkdown}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {copied ? 'Copied Markdown' : 'Copy MD'}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download Report
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-violet-600/20 text-violet-400 border border-violet-500/30 hover:bg-violet-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved!' : 'Save Report'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">

        {/* Configuration Column */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-400" /> Audit Parameters
            </h3>

            {/* Knowledge base status */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border text-xs text-app-dim space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <strong>Knowledge base:</strong>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-violet-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-violet-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `${useSessionData ? 'Using' : 'Ignoring'} ${selectedItemsCount} selected reference(s) from active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected. Using general market intelligence templates.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Strategic Lens */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Strategic Lens Perspective</label>
              <select
                value={perspective}
                onChange={(e) => setPerspective(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500"
              >
                <option value="Product Market Fit">🎯 Product Market Fit (User value, pricing, retention)</option>
                <option value="Competitive Moat">🛡️ Competitive Moat (Patent defensibility, lock-in, market threats)</option>
                <option value="Security & Compliance">🔒 Security, Risk & Compliance (PII, scale hurdles, tech debt)</option>
                <option value="Financial Scalability">📈 Financial Scalability (Margin models, acquisition costs, LTV)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Custom Constraints */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Specific Focus Drivers (Optional)</label>
              <textarea
                value={customDrivers}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomDrivers(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="e.g. Focus particularly on European GDPR compliance or competitive pressures from hyperscalers..."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Execute Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 disabled:bg-violet-850/40 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Mapping Strategic Coordinates...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <BarChart2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Perform SWOT Analysis
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Matrix & Recommendations Column */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-violet-500/20 border-t-violet-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <BarChart2 className="w-5 h-5 text-violet-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Compiling SWOT Matrix...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Structuring internal strengths and weaknesses alongside external threat landscapes and blue-ocean opportunities.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && !isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Analysis Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !error && !result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <BarChart2 className="w-12 h-12 text-violet-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Strategic Matrix Board</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Trigger the SWOT engine to construct a comprehensive business/product health assessment layout.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && result && (
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto max-h-[70vh] pr-1">
              
              {/* SWOT 2x2 Layout */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {/* Strengths */}
                <div className="p-5 bg-emerald-950/15 border border-emerald-900/30 hover:border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> Strengths (Internal)
                  </h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-2 text-xs text-app-text list-disc pl-5">
                    {result.strengths.map((str, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="leading-relaxed">{str}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                {/* Weaknesses */}
                <div className="p-5 bg-rose-950/15 border border-rose-900/30 hover:border-rose-500/40 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-rose-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" /> Weaknesses (Internal)
                  </h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-2 text-xs text-app-text list-disc pl-5">
                    {result.weaknesses.map((weak, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="leading-relaxed">{weak}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                {/* Opportunities */}
                <div className="p-5 bg-blue-950/15 border border-blue-900/30 hover:border-blue-500/40 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" /> Opportunities (External)
                  </h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-2 text-xs text-app-text list-disc pl-5">
                    {result.opportunities.map((opp, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="leading-relaxed">{opp}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>

                {/* Threats */}
                <div className="p-5 bg-amber-950/15 border border-amber-900/30 hover:border-amber-500/40 rounded-xl transition-colors">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" /> Threats (External)
                  </h4>
                  <ul className="space-y-2 text-xs text-app-text list-disc pl-5">
                    {result.threats.map((thr, index) => (
                      <li key={index} className="leading-relaxed">{thr}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action Blueprint */}
              {result.strategicActions && result.strategicActions.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-5 bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-violet-400 mb-4">
                    Immediate Action Map & Strategic Mitigations
                  </h4>
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {result.strategicActions.map((act, index) => (
                      <div key={index} className="p-3.5 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg text-xs hover:border-violet-500/30 transition-all">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-1.5">
                          <h5 className="font-bold text-app-text text-sm">{act.title}</h5>
                          <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold ${
                            act.priority === 'High' 
                              ? 'bg-red-950 text-red-400 border border-red-900/40' 
                              : 'bg-yellow-950 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-900/40'
                          }`}>
                            {act.priority} Priority
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-app-dim leading-relaxed">{act.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/ThumbnailHookSuite.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Sparkles, Palette, Type, Upload, Download, RefreshCw, 
  ChevronRight, Compass, ShieldAlert, Check, TrendingUp, HelpCircle 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { themeStyles } from '../../constants/creativeStudioTheme';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';

interface TitleHook {
  title: string;
  ctrRating: string;
  psychology: string;
}

interface ThumbnailProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
  localTheme: string;
}

export const ThumbnailHookSuite: React.FC<ThumbnailProps> = ({ onBack, localTheme }) => {
  const st = themeStyles[localTheme] || themeStyles.charcoal;

  const [rawTitle, setRawTitle] = useState('My Coding App Project Showcase');
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [hooks, setHooks] = useState<TitleHook[]>([
    {
      title: 'I Built a Full-Stack Media Suite in 5 Minutes (And It Actually Works!)',
      ctrRating: '9.2% (Very High)',
      psychology: 'Curiosity combined with a time constraint and proof of success.'
    },
    {
      title: 'Why Everyone Is Switching to This New Coding AI Studio',
      ctrRating: '8.5% (High)',
      psychology: 'FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out) and industry standard alignment.'
    }
  ]);

  // Thumbnail Composition State
  const [thumbnailBg, setThumbnailBg] = useState('linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e1b4b 100%)');
  const [overlayText, setOverlayText] = useState('CODE CRACKED!');
  const [textSize, setTextSize] = useState('text-3xl');
  const [textColor, setTextColor] = useState('#f59e0b'); // amber
  const [textY, setTextY] = useState('top-6'); // top-6, bottom-6, middle
  const [hasFace, setHasFace] = useState(true);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState<'YouTube' | 'TikTok' | 'Instagram'>('YouTube');
  const [ctrScore, setCtrScore] = useState(72);

  const calculateCtrScore = () => {
    let score = 50;
    if (overlayText && overlayText.length < 15) score += 15;
    if (textColor === '#f59e0b' || textColor === '#ef4444') score += 10;
    if (hasFace) score += 15;
    if (thumbnailBg.includes('linear-gradient') === false) score += 10; // real image upload
    setCtrScore(Math.min(98, score));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    calculateCtrScore();
  }, [overlayText, textColor, hasFace, thumbnailBg]);

  const handleSuggestHooks = async () => {
    if (!rawTitle.trim()) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const prompt = `You are a high-conversion viral content strategist and thumbnail script doctor. Suggest 3 highly catchy alternative titles/hooks for: "${rawTitle}".
Response must be a raw JSON array of objects (no markdown wrappers):
[
  {
    "title": "Hook Alternative 1",
    "ctrRating": "9.5% (Extremely High)",
    "psychology": "Explain why this hook stimulates clicks..."
  }
]`;
      const response = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt);
      const cleaned = response.replace(/```json/g, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim();
      const data = JSON.parse(cleaned);
      if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        setHooks(data);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert("Failed to parse hooks. Try a shorter baseline title!");
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleBgUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (ev) => {
        setThumbnailBg(ev.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`p-6 min-h-screen ${st.bg} text-slate-100 flex flex-col gap-6 animate-fade-in`}>
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-800 pb-4 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Compass className="text-rose-400 w-5 h-5" />
            Thumbnail & Hook Suite
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Simulate video cards, overlay timeline players, write high-CTR hooks with AI, and view your thumb in recommendation feeds.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {onBack && (
            <button onClick={onBack} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold border ${st.border} ${st.btnInactive}`}>
              Back
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
        
        {/* Left Side: Thumbnail Composition Canvas */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-4">
          <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest block">Composition Canvas</span>

          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
            {/* Visualizer Frame */}
            <div 
              className="aspect-video w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 relative overflow-hidden"
              style={thumbnailBg.startsWith('linear-gradient') ? { background: thumbnailBg } : { backgroundImage: `url('${thumbnailBg}')`, backgroundSize: 'cover', backgroundPosition: 'center' }}
            >
              
              {/* Overlay Text */}
              {overlayText && (
                <div className={`absolute left-6 right-6 text-center select-none ${
                  textY === 'top-6' ? 'top-6' : textY === 'bottom-6' ? 'bottom-20' : 'top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2'
                }`}>
                  <span 
                    className={`${textSize} font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase px-4 py-1.5 bg-black/85 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 inline-block`}
                    style={{ color: textColor }}
                  >
                    {overlayText}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Simulated Face Overlay (extremely common in thumbnails) */}
              {hasFace && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-[85%] w-[45%] flex items-end justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  {/* Stylized face avatar drawing */}
                  <div className="w-24 h-24 sm:w-32 sm:h-32 rounded-full border-4 border-amber-400 bg-slate-850 flex items-center justify-center animate-pulse">
                    <span className="text-3xl">🤩</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* YouTube elapsed time or platforms border overlay */}
              {platform === 'YouTube' && (
                <>
                  <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 right-2 h-1 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="h-full w-2/3 bg-rose-600" />
                  </div>
                  <span className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] text-slate-300 font-mono">
                    14:15
                  </span>
                </>
              )}

              {platform === 'TikTok' && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 border-2 border-cyan-400/20 p-3 flex flex-col justify-between pointer-events-none">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 font-bold bg-black/60 px-1.5 rounded self-start">TikTok Simulation</span>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-slate-800 border" />
                    <div className="w-10 h-1.5 bg-slate-700 rounded" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {platform === 'Instagram' && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 border-2 border-fuchsia-400/20 p-3 flex flex-col justify-between pointer-events-none">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-fuchsia-400 font-bold bg-black/60 px-1.5 rounded self-start">IG Reel Simulation</span>
                  <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded bg-slate-800 border self-end" />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Canvas Customizer Tools */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold block mb-1">Canvas Text</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={overlayText}
                    onChange={(e) => setOverlayText(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold block mb-1">Overlay Position</label>
                  <select
                    value={textY}
                    onChange={(e) => setTextY(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-200"
                  >
                    <option value="top-6">Top Header</option>
                    <option value="middle">Center Stage</option>
                    <option value="bottom-6">Bottom Overlay</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-900">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {['#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#10b981', '#ffffff'].map(c => (
                    <button
                      key={c}
                      onClick={() => setTextColor(c)}
                      className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full border ${textColor === c ? 'border-white scale-110' : 'border-slate-800'}`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: c }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-3 items-center">
                  <label className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer select-none">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={hasFace}
                      onChange={(e) => setHasFace(e.target.checked)}
                      className="accent-rose-500"
                    />
                    Add Expressive Face
                  </label>

                  <label className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-[10px] font-bold rounded cursor-pointer">
                    Upload BG
                    <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handleBgUpload} className="hidden" />

                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Platform Simulator selector */}

                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold">Simulator Device</span>

                  {(['YouTube', 'TikTok', 'Instagram'] as const).map(p => (

                      key={p}
