### --- START FILE: applet/components/CreationStudio/WebsiteBuilder.tsx --- ###
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Layout, Code, Copy, Check, Download, Save, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Eye, Monitor, Sparkles, Play, ToggleLeft, Laptop } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateUnifiedAIResponse } from '../../services/unifiedAi';
import { MediaItem } from '../../types';

interface WebsiteBuilderProps {
  session?: any | null;
  onSaveArtifact?: (mediaItem: MediaItem) => void;
}

interface WebsiteResult {
  title: string;
  theme: string;
  copy: {
    heroHeadline: string;
    heroSubheadline: string;
    ctaText: string;
    featuresHeader: string;
    features: { title: string; desc: string; iconName: string }[];
    testimonials: { quote: string; author: string; role: string }[];
    pricingHeader: string;
    pricingPlans: { name: string; price: string; features: string[]; isPopular: boolean }[];
    footerText: string;
  };
  htmlCode: string;
}

export const WebsiteBuilder: React.FC<WebsiteBuilderProps> = ({ session, onSaveArtifact }) => {
  const [siteTopic, setSiteTopic] = useState('SaaS Analytics Dashboard');
  const [visualTheme, setVisualTheme] = useState('modern-dark');
  const [additionalDirectives, setAdditionalDirectives] = useState('');
  const [useSessionData, setUseSessionData] = useState(false);

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<WebsiteResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [copiedType, setCopiedType] = useState<'code' | 'copy' | null>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'preview' | 'code' | 'copy'>('preview');

  const selectedItemsCount = session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
    session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
  )?.length || 0;

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);
    setSaved(false);

    try {
      const selectedItems = useSessionData 
        ? (session?.mediaItems?.filter((item: MediaItem) =>
            session?.selectedMediaIds?.includes(item.id)
          ) || [])
        : [];

      const prompt = `Act as an expert Frontend Architect, CRO Specialist, and Award-Winning UI Designer.
Based on the provided ${useSessionData && selectedItems.length > 0 ? 'source materials' : 'specifications'}, generate a complete landing page structure, copy elements, and a single-file fully-styled HTML code block using Tailwind CSS.

WEBSITE SPECIFICATIONS:
- Landing Page Topic: ${siteTopic}
- Visual Theme: ${visualTheme} (Values: modern-dark, elegant-light, high-contrast-retro, slate-professional)
- Custom Brand Directives: ${additionalDirectives || 'Make it highly persuasive, modern, responsive, and visually stunning.'}

THEME DESIGN GUIDELINES:
- 'modern-dark': Deep dark slate/indigo backgrounds (e.g. bg-slate-950), lime or cyan neon text accents, glassmorphic card elements, glowing borders.
- 'elegant-light': Soft off-white backgrounds (e.g. bg-zinc-50), dark charcoal text (e.g. text-zinc-900), subtle pastel accents, delicate borders, elegant typography.
- 'high-contrast-retro': Pitch black backdrops, amber/orange glowing text, monospace typeface accents, pixel-like boundaries, solid color blocks.
- 'slate-professional': Refined blue-grey colors (e.g. bg-slate-900 / bg-slate-100), royal blue primary buttons, clean cards, corporate executive structure.

OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:
You MUST output the landing page design as a structured JSON object wrapped inside a codeblock.
The object must follow this strict TypeScript structure:
{
  "title": "Clean Page Title / Brand Name",
  "theme": "${visualTheme}",
  "copy": {
    "heroHeadline": "Catchy headline targeting primary value",
    "heroSubheadline": "Descriptive subheadline explaining how it works",
    "ctaText": "Call to action button label",
    "featuresHeader": "Features section section title",
    "features": [
      { "title": "Feature 1", "desc": "Brief feature benefits context", "iconName": "Lucide icon name (e.g. Zap, Shield, Cpu)" },
      { "title": "Feature 2", "desc": "Brief context", "iconName": "Icon name" },
      { "title": "Feature 3", "desc": "Brief context", "iconName": "Icon name" }
    ],
    "testimonials": [
      { "quote": "User feedback quoting dramatic benefit", "author": "User Name", "role": "CEO, Company" }
    ],
    "pricingHeader": "Flexible Plans for Every Stage",
    "pricingPlans": [
      { "name": "Starter", "price": "$19/mo", "features": ["Feature A", "Feature B"], "isPopular": false },
      { "name": "Growth", "price": "$49/mo", "features": ["Feature A", "Feature B", "Feature C"], "isPopular": true }
    ],
    "footerText": "© 2026 Brand. All rights reserved."
  },
  "htmlCode": "A single-file complete, responsive HTML landing page using Tailwind CSS via its CDN (<script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'></script>). It MUST contain all layout components (Hero, Features Grid, Testimonials Section, Interactive-looking Pricing cards, CTA footer). Ensure all colors, layout spacers, padding, and hover states match the selected visual theme beautifully."
}

Ensure your response is valid JSON that can be parsed by JSON.parse. Wrap it inside a \`\`\`json and \`\`\` block.`;

      const responseText = await generateUnifiedAIResponse(prompt, selectedItems);

      // Extract JSON
      const jsonMatch = responseText.match(/```json([\s\S]*?)```/) || responseText.match(/\{([\s\S]*?)\}/);
      const jsonString = jsonMatch ? (jsonMatch[1] || jsonMatch[0]) : responseText;
      const parsedData = JSON.parse(jsonString.trim());

      if (parsedData && parsedData.title && parsedData.htmlCode && parsedData.copy) {
        setResult(parsedData);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Parsed website data did not match the required JSON structure.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setError("Failed to construct landing page. Please verify your details or try again!");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyCode = () => {
    if (!result) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(result.htmlCode);
    setCopiedType('code');
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedType(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleCopyCopy = () => {
    if (!result) return;
    let textCopy = `TITLE: ${result.title}\n\n`;
    textCopy += `HERO HEADLINE: ${result.copy.heroHeadline}\n`;
    textCopy += `HERO SUBHEADLINE: ${result.copy.heroSubheadline}\n`;
    textCopy += `CTA: ${result.copy.ctaText}\n\n`;
    textCopy += `FEATURES:\n`;
    result.copy.features.forEach(f => {
      textCopy += `- ${f.title}: ${f.desc}\n`;
    });
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(textCopy);
    setCopiedType('copy');
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedType(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!result) return;
    const blob = new Blob([result.htmlCode], { type: 'text/html' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${result.title.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-landing-page.html`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveToSession = () => {
    if (!result || !onSaveArtifact) return;

    const utf8Encode = new TextEncoder().encode(result.htmlCode);
    const base64Data = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(utf8Encode)));

    const newArtifact: MediaItem = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      name: `Landing Page: ${result.title}`,
      mimeType: 'text/html',
      type: 'html',
      data: base64Data
    };

    onSaveArtifact(newArtifact);
    setSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-app-bg text-app-text">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-6 px-2 border-b border-app-border pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400">
            <Layout className="w-6 h-6" /> Website Builder
          </h2>
          <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
            Synthesize your source context files into highly professional, fully responsive HTML/Tailwind landing page layouts and copy.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {result && (
            <>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-app-card border border-app-border hover:bg-app-input text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Download HTML File
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveToSession}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded bg-sky-600/20 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/30 hover:bg-sky-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                {saved ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                {saved ? 'Saved to Session!' : 'Save Page HTML'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 flex-1">
        {/* Left Options Board */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-app-dim border-b border-app-border pb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Design Configuration
            </h3>

            {/* Optional Session Data Checkbox */}
            <div className="bg-app-bg p-3 rounded border border-app-border space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-app-text">Use Session Context</span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={useSessionData}
                  onChange={(e) => setUseSessionData(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500 bg-app-input border-app-border rounded focus:ring-sky-500 focus:ring-2"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-app-dim">
                {selectedItemsCount > 0 
                  ? `Incorporate copy & specs from the ${selectedItemsCount} selected file(s) in active session.`
                  : '⚠️ No reference files selected in active session. Standard generic layouts will be used.'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Topic Input */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Landing Page Topic / Core Concept</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={siteTopic}
                onChange={(e) => setSiteTopic(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500"
                placeholder="SaaS Analytics Dashboard, Creative Agency, etc."
              />
            </div>

            {/* Theme Selector */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Visual Design & Vibe Theme</label>
              <select
                value={visualTheme}
                onChange={(e) => setVisualTheme(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500"
              >
                <option value="modern-dark">🌌 Modern Dark (Glowing neon accents & dark card glassmorphism)</option>
                <option value="elegant-light">☀️ Elegant Light (Clean slate, crisp margins & warm paper theme)</option>
                <option value="high-contrast-retro">📟 Retro terminal (High-contrast, amber monospace, block grid)</option>
                <option value="slate-professional">💼 Corporate Slate (Refined corporate corporate-blue grids)</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Additional Directives */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-text mb-1.5">Custom Content & Copy Guidelines</label>
              <textarea
                value={additionalDirectives}
                onChange={(e) => setAdditionalDirectives(e.target.value)}
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Include a 30-day trial offer, mention integration with Slack, etc."
                className="w-full bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded px-3 py-2 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Submit Action */}
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerate}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-500 disabled:bg-sky-850/40 text-black font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Assembling Visual Canvas...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Laptop className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate Landing Page
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Preview Workbench */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full min-h-[450px]">
          {isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 space-y-4">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-sky-500/20 border-t-sky-500 animate-spin"></div>
                <Layout className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-400 absolute top-3.5 left-3.5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Generating Code, Copy & Layout...</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim text-center max-w-sm">
                Formulating layout blocks, writing customized performance marketing copy, and coding the responsive HTML with Tailwind CSS.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && !isProcessing && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center">
              <AlertCircle className="w-12 h-12 text-red-500/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400">Design Failed</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-app-dim max-w-md mt-1 mb-4">{error}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGenerate}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-app-input text-app-text"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && !error && !result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-app-dim">
              <Layout className="w-12 h-12 text-sky-500/30 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-app-text">Dynamic Visual Workbench</p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mt-1">
                Configure your proposed landing page layout and visual vibe on the left, then click Generate to render code, copy, and visual design layouts.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isProcessing && result && (
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow">
              {/* Tab Bar */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-app-border bg-app-bg px-4 py-2">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('preview')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      activeTab === 'preview' ? 'bg-sky-600/10 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/30' : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Live Visual Design
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('code')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      activeTab === 'code' ? 'bg-sky-600/10 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/30' : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Code className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> HTML/Tailwind Code
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActiveTab('copy')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                      activeTab === 'copy' ? 'bg-sky-600/10 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/30' : 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Marketing Copy
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div>
                  {activeTab === 'code' && (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleCopyCode}
                      className="text-xs text-sky-400 hover:text-sky-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {copiedType === 'code' ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      {copiedType === 'code' ? 'Copied Code!' : 'Copy Code'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {activeTab === 'copy' && (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleCopyCopy}
                      className="text-xs text-sky-400 hover:text-sky-300 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {copiedType === 'copy' ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      {copiedType === 'copy' ? 'Copied Copy Elements!' : 'Copy Copy Elements'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Tab Contents */}
              <div className="flex-1 min-h-[350px] relative">
                {activeTab === 'preview' && (
                  <iframe
                    title="Landing Page Live Preview"
                    srcDoc={result.htmlCode}
                    className="w-full h-[55vh] border-0 bg-white"
                  />
                )}

                {activeTab === 'code' && (
                  <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-950 h-[55vh] overflow-y-auto">
                    <pre className="text-xs font-mono text-lime-400 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                      {result.htmlCode}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                )}

                {activeTab === 'copy' && (
                  <div className="p-5 overflow-y-auto h-[55vh] space-y-6">
                    {/* Brand Meta */}
                    <div className="border-b border-app-border pb-4">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-sky-400 tracking-wider">Brand Name</span>
                      <h4 className="text-xl font-bold text-app-text mt-1">{result.title}</h4>
                    </div>

                    {/* Hero Section Copy */}
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-sky-400 tracking-wider">Hero Banner Text</span>
                      <h5 className="font-bold text-sm text-app-text">{result.copy.heroHeadline}</h5>
                      <p className="text-xs text-app-dim leading-relaxed">{result.copy.heroSubheadline}</p>
                      <div className="inline-block px-3 py-1.5 bg-sky-600 text-black font-bold text-xs rounded mt-1">
                        {result.copy.ctaText}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Features section */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-sky-400 tracking-wider">Core Feature Pillars</span>
                      <h5 className="font-bold text-xs text-app-text">{result.copy.featuresHeader}</h5>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                        {result.copy.features.map((feat, idx) => (
                          <div key={idx} className="p-3 bg-app-bg border border-app-border rounded-lg">
                            <h6 className="font-semibold text-xs text-app-text mb-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                              <span className="text-sky-400">✦</span> {feat.title}
                            </h6>
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-app-dim leading-relaxed">{feat.desc}</p>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Pricing section */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-sky-400 tracking-wider">Pricing Structures</span>
                      <h5 className="font-bold text-xs text-app-text">{result.copy.pricingHeader}</h5>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                        {result.copy.pricingPlans.map((plan, idx) => (
                          <div key={idx} className={`p-4 rounded-xl border ${plan.isPopular ? 'border-sky-500 bg-sky-500/5' : 'border-app-border bg-app-bg'}`}>
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                              <h6 className="font-bold text-xs text-app-text">{plan.name}</h6>
                              {plan.isPopular && <span className="bg-sky-500 text-black font-bold text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">POPULAR</span>}
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-lg font-bold text-app-text">{plan.price}</span>
                            <ul className="text-[10px] text-app-dim space-y-1 mt-2 list-disc pl-4">
                              {plan.features.map((f, fIdx) => (
                                <li key={fIdx}>{f}</li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface FinanceViewProps {
  onBack: () => void;
}

type ThemeKey = keyof typeof themeStyles;

export const FinanceView: React.FC<FinanceViewProps> = ({ onBack }) => {
  const [activeTool, setActiveTool] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [panelSize, setPanelSize] = useState<'large' | 'strip'>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('pref_financePanelSize');
      if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch {}
    return 'strip';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUserPreference('financePanelSize').then(saved => {
      if (saved) setPanelSize(saved);
    });
  }, []);
  const [localTheme, setLocalTheme] = useState<ThemeKey>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('creative_studio_theme') as ThemeKey;
    if (saved && Object.keys(themeStyles).includes(saved)) {
      return saved;
    }
    return 'charcoal';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleThemeChange = () => {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('creative_studio_theme') as ThemeKey;
      if (saved && Object.keys(themeStyles).includes(saved)) {
        setLocalTheme(saved);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('creative_studio_theme_change', handleThemeChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('creative_studio_theme_change', handleThemeChange);
    };
  }, []);

  const st = themeStyles[localTheme];

  const tools = [
    {
      id: 'stock_trading_assistant',
      title: 'US Stock Trading Assistant',
      icon: <BarChart2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-emerald-500/40',
      pills: ['Equities', 'Nasdaq 500', 'SEK Valuation']
    },
    {
      id: 'crypto_trading_assistant',
      title: 'Crypto Trading Assistant',
      icon: <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-amber-500/40',
      pills: ['Crypto', 'Conversion', 'RSI / MACD']
    },
    {
      id: 'currency_trading_assistant',
      title: 'Currency Trading Assistant',
      icon: <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-sky-500/40',
      pills: ['Forex', 'SEK crosses', 'Live Pips']
    },
    {
      id: 'kelly_criterion',
      title: 'Kelly Criterion Risk Planner',
      icon: <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-emerald-500/40',
      pills: ['Risk Management', 'Monte Carlo', 'Bet Sizing']
    },
    {
      id: 'portfolio_simulator',
      title: 'Stochastic Portfolio Simulator',
      icon: <LineChart className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />,

      pills: ['Stochastic simulation', 'Portfolio projections', 'Tail Risk']
    },
    {

    },
    {
      id: 'arbitrage_matrix',
      title: 'Cross-Asset Arbitrage & Matrix',
      icon: <ArrowUpDown className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-indigo-500/40',
      pills: ['Arbitrage spreads', 'Correlation cluster', 'Live spreads']
    },
    {
      id: 'sentiment_terminal',
      title: 'AI News Sentiment Terminal',
      icon: <Bot className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-teal-500/40',
      pills: ['Gemini 3.5 AI', 'Sentiment parsing', 'Catalyst scores']

    {
      id: 'tv_indicator_studio',
      title: 'TradingView Indicator Studio',
      icon: <Code className="w-5 h-5 text-fuchsia-400" />,
      color: 'hover:border-fuchsia-500/40',
      pills: ['Pine Script v5', 'Combiner Engine', 'Visual Backtest']
    }
  ];

  const defaultOrder = tools.map(t => t.id);
  const [toolOrder, setToolOrder] = React.useState<string[]>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('pref_financeToolOrder');
      if (saved) {
         const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
         if (parsed.length === defaultOrder.length) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {}
    return defaultOrder;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUserPreference('financeToolOrder').then(saved => {
      if (saved && Array.isArray(saved)) {
         let newOrder = [...saved];
         defaultOrder.forEach(id => {
            if (!newOrder.includes(id)) {
               newOrder.push(id);
            }
         });
         setToolOrder(newOrder);
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const [isToolSettingsOpen, setIsToolSettingsOpen] = React.useState(false);

  const orderedTools = [...tools].sort((a, b) => {
    let indexA = toolOrder.indexOf(a.id);
    let indexB = toolOrder.indexOf(b.id);
    if (indexA === -1) indexA = 999;
    if (indexB === -1) indexB = 999;
    return indexA - indexB;
  });

  const handleSaveOrder = (newOrder: string[]) => {
    setToolOrder(newOrder);
    saveUserPreference('financeToolOrder', newOrder);

  return (

          )}

                 const nextSize = panelSize === 'large' ? 'strip' : 'large';
                 setPanelSize(nextSize);

                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />

          {/* Theme cycle button added directly in the finance section header */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              const themes = Object.keys(themeStyles) as ThemeKey[];
              const nextIndex = (themes.indexOf(localTheme) + 1) % themes.length;
              const nextTheme = themes[nextIndex];
              setLocalTheme(nextTheme);
              localStorage.setItem('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
              saveUserPreference('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
              window.dispatchEvent(new Event('creative_studio_theme_change'));

                : localTheme === 'crimson'
                ? 'bg-rose-900 border-rose-500 shadow-md shadow-rose-950/50'

                : 'bg-stone-700 border-stone-500 shadow-md shadow-stone-950/50'

        {!activeTool ? (
          <div className="animate-fade-in space-y-6 pt-0 pb-2">

              <h2 className={`text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight mt-0 mb-1.5 ${st.textHighlight}`}>
                Finance Intell
              </h2>
              <p className={`text-sm leading-relaxed ${st.textDim}`}>
                Analyze price feeds, calculate pip movements, configure watchlists, and map stock vectors. Fully optimized with direct SEK valuation crosses.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Compact panels list using custom pill boxes or grid based on panelSize state */}
            {panelSize === 'strip' ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pt-2">
                {orderedTools.map((tool) => (
                  <button
                    key={tool.id}
                    onClick={() => setActiveTool(tool.id)}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1 cursor-pointer ${st.cardBg} ${st.borderSubtle} ${tool.color}`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="p-2 bg-zinc-900/80 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 flex items-center justify-center">
                        {tool.icon}
                      </div>
                      <h3 className={`text-sm font-bold ${st.textHighlight}`}>
                        {tool.title}
                      </h3>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                      {/* Custom Pill Box badges */}
                      <div className="hidden sm:flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {tool.pills.map((pill, i) => (
                          <span
                            key={i}
                            className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                              i === 0 
                                ? 'bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-400 border-teal-500/20' 
                                : 'bg-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/50'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {pill}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors">
                        <span className={st.textDim}>Launch</span>
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2.5} d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 pt-2">
                {orderedTools.map((tool) => (
                  <button
                    key={tool.id}
                    onClick={() => setActiveTool(tool.id)}
                    className={`flex flex-col text-left p-5 rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg cursor-pointer ${st.cardBg} ${st.borderSubtle} ${tool.color}`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                      <div className="p-2 bg-zinc-900/80 rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 flex items-center justify-center">
                        {tool.icon}
                      </div>
                      <h3 className={`text-sm font-bold ${st.textHighlight}`}>
                        {tool.title}
                      </h3>
                    </div>

                    {/* Custom Pill Box badges */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mb-5 mt-auto">
                      {tool.pills.map((pill, i) => (
                        <span
                          key={i}
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${
                            i === 0 
                              ? 'bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-400 border-teal-500/20' 
                              : 'bg-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-700/50'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {pill}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors pt-2 border-t border-zinc-800/40">
                      <span className={st.textDim}>Launch Interface</span>
                      <svg className="w-4 h-4 ml-1 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2.5} d="M9 5l7 7-7 7" />
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="animate-fade-in">
            {activeTool === 'registry' && (
              <FinanceIntellRegistry 
                theme={localTheme} 
                onClose={() => setActiveTool(null)} 
                onRunTool={(toolId) => setActiveTool(toolId)} 
              />
            )}
            {activeTool === 'tv_indicator_studio' && <TVIndicatorStudio theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'crypto_trading_assistant' && <CryptoTradingAssistant theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'stock_trading_assistant' && <StockTradingAssistant theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'currency_trading_assistant' && <CurrencyTradingAssistant theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'kelly_criterion' && <KellyCriterionCalculator theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'portfolio_simulator' && <MonteCarloSimulator theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'yield_curve_analyser' && <YieldCurveAnalyser theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'arbitrage_matrix' && <ArbitrageCorrelationTracker theme={localTheme} />}
            {activeTool === 'sentiment_terminal' && <AISentimentTerminal theme={localTheme} />}
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    
      
    
      <ToolOrderSettingsModal
        isOpen={isToolSettingsOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsToolSettingsOpen(false)}
        tools={tools}
        toolOrder={toolOrder}
        onSave={handleSaveOrder}
        viewModeLabel={`Layout: ${panelSize}`}
        onCycleViewMode={() => {
           const nextSize = panelSize === 'large' ? 'strip' : 'large';
           setPanelSize(nextSize);
           saveUserPreference('financePanelSize', nextSize);
        }}
        themeLabel={`Theme: ${localTheme}`}
        onCycleTheme={() => {
           const themes = Object.keys(themeStyles) as ThemeKey[];
           const nextIndex = (themes.indexOf(localTheme) + 1) % themes.length;
           const nextTheme = themes[nextIndex];
           setLocalTheme(nextTheme);
           localStorage.setItem('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
           saveUserPreference('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
           window.dispatchEvent(new Event('creative_studio_theme_change'));
        }}
      />
</div>
  );
};

### --- END FILE: applet/components/FinanceView.tsx --- ###


### --- START FILE: applet/components/LibraryView.tsx --- ###

import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Session } from '../types';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import SessionModal from './SessionModal';
import { TemplateManagerModal, getCustomTemplates, addCustomTemplate } from './TemplateManager';

interface LibraryViewProps {
  sessions: Session[];
  onSelectSession: (id: string) => void;
  onCreateSession: () => void;
  onDeleteSession: (id: string) => void;
  onRenameSession: (id: string, newName: string) => void;
  onReorderSession: (sourceIndex: number, destIndex: number) => void;
  onCombineSessions?: (ids: string[], newName: string, description?: string) => void;
  onOpenSettings?: () => void;
  onOpenStudio?: () => void;
  onOpenOfficeTools?: () => void;
  onOpenMedia?: () => void;
  onOpenMIPrOMPT?: () => void;
  onOpenFinance?: () => void;
}

const LibraryView: React.FC<LibraryViewProps> = ({ 
  sessions, 
  onSelectSession, 
  onCreateSession,
  onDeleteSession,
  onRenameSession,
  onReorderSession,
  onCombineSessions,
  onOpenSettings,
  onOpenStudio,
  onOpenOfficeTools,
  onOpenMedia,
  onOpenMIPrOMPT,
  onOpenFinance
}) => {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list' | 'icon'>('grid');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [editingSessionId, setEditingSessionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editName, setEditName] = useState('');
  const [isCombineModalOpen, setIsCombineModalOpen] = useState(false);
  
  // Template States
  const [isTemplateManagerOpen, setIsTemplateManagerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [changeTemplateSession, setChangeTemplateSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [customCategoryInput, setCustomCategoryInput] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    setTemplates(getCustomTemplates());
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      setTemplates(getCustomTemplates());
    };
    window.addEventListener('aggrigator_templates_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('aggrigator_templates_updated', handleUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  const getNextSessionName = (category: string, sessionsList: Session[]): string => {
    let maxNum = 0;
    const prefix = `${category} `;
    sessionsList.forEach(s => {
      if (s.name && s.name.startsWith(prefix)) {
        const numPart = s.name.substring(prefix.length).trim();
        const num = parseInt(numPart, 10);
        if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxNum) {
          maxNum = num;
        }
      }
    });
    const nextNum = maxNum + 1;
    return `${category} ${nextNum.toString().padStart(3, '0')}`;
  };

  const handleSaveAsTemplate = (e: React.MouseEvent, sessionName: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    // Clean up number suffixes like "Research 001" if present, or just use the name
    let cleanName = sessionName.trim();
    const regex = /\s\d{3,}$/; // Matches spaces followed by 3+ digits at the end
    if (regex.test(cleanName)) {
      cleanName = cleanName.replace(regex, '');
    }
    
    if (confirm(`Do you want to add "${cleanName}" as a new Category Template?`)) {
      const success = addCustomTemplate(cleanName);
      if (success) {
        alert(`Successfully added "${cleanName}" as a template category!`);
      } else {
        alert(`"${cleanName}" is already a template category.`);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleChangeSessionTemplate = (session: Session, newTemplateCategory: string) => {
    const newName = getNextSessionName(newTemplateCategory, sessions);
    onRenameSession(session.id, newName);
    setChangeTemplateSession(null);
  };
  
  // Drag and Drop State
  const dragItem = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const dragOverItem = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const [selectedSessionIds, setSelectedSessionIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const toggleSessionSelection = (id: string) => {
    const newSelection = new Set(selectedSessionIds);
    if (newSelection.has(id)) {
      newSelection.delete(id);
    } else {
      newSelection.add(id);
    }
    setSelectedSessionIds(newSelection);
  };

  const handleBatchDelete = () => {
    if (selectedSessionIds.size === 0) return;
    if (confirm(`Are you sure you want to delete ${selectedSessionIds.size} sessions?`)) {
      selectedSessionIds.forEach(id => onDeleteSession(id));
      setSelectedSessionIds(new Set());
    }
  };

  const handleClearEmptySessions = () => {
    const emptySessionIds = sessions.filter(s => s.mediaItems.length === 0 && s.history.length === 0).map(s => s.id);
    if (emptySessionIds.length === 0) {
        alert("No empty sessions found.");
        return;
    }
    if (confirm(`Found ${emptySessionIds.length} empty sessions. Delete them?`)) {
        emptySessionIds.forEach(id => onDeleteSession(id));
    }
  };

  const filteredSessions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!search.trim()) return sessions;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return sessions.filter(s => 
      s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || 
      s.history.some(m => m.content.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }, [sessions, search]);

  const getSessionGradient = (id: string) => {
    const gradients = [
      'from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/5',
      'from-purple-500/20 to-pink-500/5',
      'from-emerald-500/20 to-teal-500/5',
      'from-amber-500/20 to-orange-500/5',
      'from-rose-500/20 to-red-500/5',
    ];
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < id.length; i++) { hash = id.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash); }
    return gradients[Math.abs(hash) % gradients.length];
  };

  const handleStartRename = (e: React.MouseEvent, session: Session) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setEditingSessionId(session.id);
    setEditName(session.name);
  };

  const handleDownloadSessionTxt = (e: React.MouseEvent, session: Session) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    let txt = `Session: ${session.name}\n`;
    txt += `Created: ${new Date(session.createdAt).toLocaleString()}\n\n`;
    if (session.description) {
        txt += `Description: ${session.description}\n\n`;
    }
    txt += `--- SOURCES ---\n`;
    session.mediaItems.forEach(item => {
        txt += `\n[${item.type.toUpperCase()}] ${item.name}\n`;
        if (item.type === 'text' || item.type === 'link' || item.type === 'html') {
           try {
               const decoded = new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(item.data), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
               txt += `${decoded}\n`;
           } catch(err){}
        } else {
           txt += `(Binary or Base64 data hidden)\n`;
        }
    });
    txt += `\n--- HISTORY ---\n`;
    session.history.forEach(msg => {
        txt += `\n[${msg.role.toUpperCase()}] ${new Date(msg.timestamp).toLocaleString()}\n`;
        txt += `${msg.content}\n`;
    });
    
    const blob = new Blob([txt], { type: 'text/plain' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `session_${session.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_').toLowerCase()}.txt`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleSaveRename = (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (editingSessionId && editName.trim()) {
      onRenameSession(editingSessionId, editName.trim());
    }
    setEditingSessionId(null);
  };

  const handleDragStart = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>, position: number) => {
    dragItem.current = position;
    // Set transparent image or effect
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
    e.currentTarget.style.opacity = "0.5";
  };

  const handleDragEnter = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>, position: number) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    dragOverItem.current = position;
  };

  const handleDragEnd = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.currentTarget.style.opacity = "1";
    if (dragItem.current !== null && dragOverItem.current !== null && dragItem.current !== dragOverItem.current) {
        onReorderSession(dragItem.current, dragOverItem.current);
    }
    dragItem.current = null;
    dragOverItem.current = null;
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full w-full bg-app-bg text-app-text overflow-y-auto animate-fade-in p-6 md:p-10">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto mb-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-app-text to-blue-500 mb-1">
              {t('library.title')}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-app-dim text-xs">
              {sessions.length} {t('library.sessionsStored')}
            </p>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
            {selectedSessionIds.size > 0 && (
                <>
                {selectedSessionIds.size > 1 && onCombineSessions && (
                    <button 
                        onClick={() => setIsCombineModalOpen(true)}
                        className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path d="M8 5a1 1 0 100 2h5.586l-1.293 1.293a1 1 0 001.414 1.414l3-3a1 1 0 000-1.414l-3-3a1 1 0 10-1.414 1.414L13.586 5H8zM12 15a1 1 0 100-2H6.414l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 10-1.414-1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 000 1.414l3 3a1 1 0 001.414-1.414L6.414 15H12z" />
                        </svg>
                        Combine ({selectedSessionIds.size})
                    </button>
                )}
                <button 
                    onClick={handleBatchDelete}
                    className="px-3 py-2 bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M9 2a1 1 0 00-.894.553L7.382 4H4a1 1 0 000 2v10a2 2 0 002 2h8a2 2 0 002-2V6a1 1 0 100-2h-3.382l-.724-1.447A1 1 0 0011 2H9zM7 8a1 1 0 012 0v6a1 1 0 11-2 0V8zm5-1a1 1 0 00-1 1v6a1 1 0 102 0V8a1 1 0 00-1-1z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                    </svg>
                    {t('library.delete')} ({selectedSessionIds.size})
                </button>
                </>
            )}
            <button 
                onClick={handleClearEmptySessions}
                className="p-2 bg-app-panel hover:bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-lg text-app-dim hover:text-app-text transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center"
                title={t('library.clearEmpty')}
            >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                   <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.895-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" />
                </svg>
            </button>
            <button 
                onClick={() => setIsTemplateManagerOpen(true)}
                className="p-2 bg-app-panel hover:bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-lg text-app-dim hover:text-app-text transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center"
                title="Manage Category Templates"
            >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                   <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6h16M4 10h16M4 14h16M4 18h16" />
                </svg>
            </button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 p-1 bg-app-panel border border-app-border rounded-lg mr-1 hidden sm:flex">
               <button
                  onClick={() => setViewMode(prev => prev === 'grid' ? 'list' : prev === 'list' ? 'icon' : 'grid')}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors bg-app-card text-app-text shadow-sm hover:bg-app-card/80"
                  title="Toggle View Mode"
               >
                  {viewMode === 'list' ? (
                      <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                         <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" />
                      </svg>
                  ) : viewMode === 'grid' ? (
                      <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                         <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z" />
                      </svg>
                  ) : (
                      <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                         <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM10 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM16 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6z" />
                      </svg>
                  )}
               </button>
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex-1 md:w-80 group">
                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-4 w-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-app-dim group-focus-within:text-app-text transition-colors" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                </svg>
                <input 
                type="text" 
                placeholder={t('library.search')} 
                value={search}
                onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-app-panel border border-app-border rounded-lg pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-app-text/50 focus:border-transparent transition-all shadow-sm"
                />
            </div>
            {onOpenStudio && (
                <button 
                    onClick={onOpenStudio}
                    className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-pink-600 hover:from-purple-500 hover:to-pink-500 text-white rounded-lg transition-all shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/20 flex items-center justify-center"
                    title={t('nav.studio')}
                >
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M11.3 1.046A1 1 0 0112 2v5h4a1 1 0 01.82 1.573l-7 10A1 1 0 018 18v-5H4a1 1 0 01-.82-1.573l7-10a1 1 0 011.12-.38z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
            )}
            {onOpenMedia && (
                <button 
                    onClick={onOpenMedia}
                    className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-500 hover:from-orange-600 hover:to-amber-600 text-white rounded-lg transition-all shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20"
                    title="Media Suite"
                >
                    <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
            )}
            {onOpenFinance && (
                <button 
                    onClick={onOpenFinance}
                    className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white rounded-lg transition-all shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 flex items-center justify-center"
                    title="Finance Terminal"
                >
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2.5} d="M12 8c-1.657 0-3 .895-3 2s1.343 2 3 2 3 .895 3 2-1.343 2-3 2m0-8c1.11 0 2.08.402 2.599 1M12 8V7m0 1v8m0 0v1m0-1c-1.11 0-2.08-.402-2.599-1M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
            )}
            {onOpenOfficeTools && (
                <button 
                    onClick={onOpenOfficeTools}
                    className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-teal-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg transition-all shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/20 flex items-center justify-center"
                    title="Office Tools"
                >
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 5H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2M9 5a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m-3 7h3m-3 4h3m-6-4h.01M9 16h.01" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
            )}
            {onOpenSettings && (
                <button 
                    onClick={onOpenSettings}
                    className="p-2 bg-app-panel hover:bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-lg text-app-dim hover:text-app-text transition-colors"
                    title={t('nav.settings')}
                >
                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                        <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M11.49 3.17c-.38-1.56-2.6-1.56-2.98 0a1.532 1.532 0 01-2.286.948c-1.372-.836-2.942.734-2.106 2.106.54.886.061 2.042-.947 2.287-1.561.379-1.561 2.6 0 2.978a1.532 1.532 0 01.947 2.287c-.836 1.372.734 2.942 2.106 2.106a1.532 1.532 0 012.287.947c.379 1.561 2.6 1.561 2.978 0a1.533 1.533 0 012.287-.947c1.372.836 2.942-.734 2.106-2.106a1.533 1.533 0 01.947-2.287c1.561-.379 1.561-2.6 0-2.978a1.532 1.532 0 01-.947-2.287c.836-1.372-.734-2.942-2.106-2.106a1.532 1.532 0 01-2.287-.947zM10 13a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                    </svg>
                </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grid / List */}
      <div className={`max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'grid grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-6 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-10 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-4' : 'flex flex-col gap-3'}`}>
        
        {/* Create New Card */}
        <button 
          onClick={onCreateSession}
          className={`flex ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'flex-col justify-center min-h-[160px]' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[80px]' : 'flex-row items-center min-h-[80px] px-6'} p-4 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-app-border hover:border-app-text hover:bg-app-panel/50 transition-all group`}
        >
          <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-app-panel border border-app-border flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform shadow-lg group-hover:shadow-app-text/20 ${viewMode === 'grid' || viewMode === 'icon' ? 'mb-3' : 'mr-4'}`}>
             <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5 text-green-500" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
               <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" />
             </svg>
          </div>
          {viewMode !== 'icon' && <span className="font-bold text-sm text-green-500">{t('library.newSession')}</span>}
        </button>

        {/* Session Cards */}
        {filteredSessions.map((session, index) => {
          return (
            <div 
              key={session.id}
              draggable={!search.trim()} // Only draggable if not searching
              onDragStart={(e) => handleDragStart(e, index)}
              onDragEnter={(e) => handleDragEnter(e, index)}
              onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
              onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
              onClick={() => onSelectSession(session.id)}
              className={`relative flex ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'flex-col min-h-[160px]' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[80px] aspect-square p-2' : 'flex-row items-center min-h-[80px] p-4'} rounded-xl border border-app-border hover:border-app-text/50 bg-gradient-to-br ${getSessionGradient(session.id)} hover:shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer group active:scale-95`}
            >
              <div className={`flex ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'justify-between items-start mb-2 w-full' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'absolute top-1 left-1 right-1 justify-between' : 'items-center mr-4 w-auto'}`}>
                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                     <div 
                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); toggleSessionSelection(session.id); }}
                        className={`w-5 h-5 rounded border flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors ${selectedSessionIds.has(session.id) ? 'bg-blue-500 border-blue-500 text-white' : 'bg-app-bg/60 border-app-border/50 hover:border-app-text/50'}`}
                     >
                        {selectedSessionIds.has(session.id) && <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor"><path fillRule="evenodd" d="M16.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414l-8 8a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-4-4a1 1 0 011.414-1.414L8 12.586l7.293-7.293a1 1 0 011.414 0z" clipRule="evenodd" /></svg>}
                     </div>
                 </div>
                 {(viewMode === 'grid' || viewMode === 'icon') && (
                 <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity ${viewMode === 'icon' ? 'bg-black/40 rounded-md backdrop-blur-sm' : ''}`}>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleStartRename(e, session)}
                        className={`p-1.5 text-green-500 hover:text-green-500 hover:bg-green-500/20 rounded-md transition-colors ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'text-app-dim hover:text-app-text hover:bg-app-bg/80' : ''}`}
                        title="Rename"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path d="M13.586 3.586a2 2 0 112.828 2.828l-.793.793-2.828-2.828.793-.793zM11.379 5.793L3 14.172V17h2.828l8.38-8.379-2.83-2.828z" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleSaveAsTemplate(e, session.name)}
                        className={`p-1.5 text-green-500 hover:text-purple-300 hover:bg-green-500/20 rounded-md transition-colors ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'text-app-dim hover:text-purple-400 hover:bg-app-bg/80' : ''}`}
                        title="Save Name as Template"
                    >
                        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 7H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v9a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-3m-1 4l-3 3m0 0l-3-3m3 3V4" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setChangeTemplateSession(session); }}
                        className={`p-1.5 text-green-500 hover:text-blue-300 hover:bg-green-500/20 rounded-md transition-colors ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'text-app-dim hover:text-blue-400 hover:bg-app-bg/80' : ''}`}
                        title="Change Category Template"
                    >
                        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M7 7h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleDownloadSessionTxt(e, session)}
                        className={`p-1.5 text-green-500 hover:text-emerald-300 hover:bg-green-500/20 rounded-md transition-colors ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'text-app-dim hover:text-emerald-500 hover:bg-app-bg/80' : ''}`}
                        title="Save to TXT"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 17a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 110 2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1zm3.293-7.707a1 1 0 011.414 0L9 10.586V3a1 1 0 112 0v7.586l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onDeleteSession(session.id); }}
                        className={`p-1.5 text-green-500 hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-green-500/20 rounded-md transition-colors ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'text-app-dim hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-app-bg/80' : ''}`}
                        title="Delete Session"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                 </div>
                 )}
              </div>

              <div className={`flex-1 ${viewMode === 'list' ? 'flex items-center gap-6 justify-between overflow-hidden' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full mt-2' : 'flex flex-col'}`}>
                  {editingSessionId === session.id ? (
                      <form onSubmit={handleSaveRename} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className={viewMode === 'grid' ? "mb-2" : viewMode === 'icon' ? "w-full" : "flex-1 mr-4"}>
                      <input 
                          type="text" 
                          value={editName}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditName(e.target.value)}
                          onBlur={() => handleSaveRename()}
                          autoFocus
                          className={`w-full bg-app-input/80 border border-app-text rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-sm text-app-text focus:outline-none ${viewMode === 'icon' ? 'text-center' : ''}`}
                      />
                  </form>
              ) : (
                  <h3 className={`text-sm font-bold text-green-500 truncate leading-tight drop-shadow-md ${viewMode === 'grid' ? 'mb-2' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'm-0 text-center text-xs max-w-full' : 'flex-1 m-0 text-base max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-md'}`} title={session.name}>{session.name}</h3>
              )}
              
              {viewMode !== 'icon' && (
              <div className={`mt-auto pt-2 border-t border-green-500/20 flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-green-500/80 font-medium ${viewMode === 'list' ? 'border-none pt-0 ml-auto gap-4' : ''}`}>
                 <span>{new Date(session.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                 <span className="bg-black/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-green-500/10 backdrop-blur-sm shadow-sm">{session.mediaItems.length} items</span>
              </div>
              )}
              </div>
              
              {viewMode === 'list' && (
                 <div className="flex items-center gap-1 opacity-100 sm:opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity ml-4 pl-4 border-l border-app-border/40">
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleStartRename(e, session)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-app-dim hover:text-app-text hover:bg-app-bg/80 rounded-md transition-colors"
                        title="Rename"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path d="M13.586 3.586a2 2 0 112.828 2.828l-.793.793-2.828-2.828.793-.793zM11.379 5.793L3 14.172V17h2.828l8.38-8.379-2.83-2.828z" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleSaveAsTemplate(e, session.name)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-app-dim hover:text-purple-400 hover:bg-app-bg/80 rounded-md transition-colors"
                        title="Save Name as Template"
                    >
                        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 7H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v9a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V9a2 2 0 00-2-2h-3m-1 4l-3 3m0 0l-3-3m3 3V4" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setChangeTemplateSession(session); }}
                        className="p-1.5 text-app-dim hover:text-blue-400 hover:bg-app-bg/80 rounded-md transition-colors"
                        title="Change Category Template"
                    >
                        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M7 7h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => handleDownloadSessionTxt(e, session)}
                        className="p-1.5 text-app-dim hover:text-emerald-500 hover:bg-app-bg/80 rounded-md transition-colors"
                        title="Save to TXT"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M3 17a1 1 0 011-1h12a1 1 0 110 2H4a1 1 0 01-1-1zm3.293-7.707a1 1 0 011.414 0L9 10.586V3a1 1 0 112 0v7.586l1.293-1.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414l-3 3a1 1 0 01-1.414 0l-3-3a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                    <button 
                        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onDeleteSession(session.id); }}
                        className="p-1.5 text-app-dim hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-app-bg/80 rounded-md transition-colors"
                        title="Delete Session"
                    >
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
                            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                        </svg>
                    </button>
                 </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {isCombineModalOpen && (
        <SessionModal
          isOpen={isCombineModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsCombineModalOpen(false)}
          defaultValue="Combined Session"
          sessions={sessions}
          onCreate={(name, description) => {
            if (onCombineSessions) {
              onCombineSessions(Array.from(selectedSessionIds), name, description);
              setSelectedSessionIds(new Set());
              setIsCombineModalOpen(false);
            }
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Template Manager Modal */}
      <TemplateManagerModal 
        isOpen={isTemplateManagerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsTemplateManagerOpen(false)}
      />

      {/* Change Session Category Template Overlay */}
      {changeTemplateSession && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm p-4" onClick={() => { setChangeTemplateSession(null); setCustomCategoryInput(''); }}>
          <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-xl w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl p-6 space-y-4 animate-pulse-fast-once" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-app-text">Change Category Template</h3>
              <p className="text-app-dim text-xs mt-1">
                Select a category template to rename and re-number session <span className="font-semibold text-app-text">"{changeTemplateSession.name}"</span>.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-dim uppercase tracking-wider">
                Select Category
              </label>
              {templates.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-sm text-app-muted py-2">
                  No templates available. Create templates first or import them.
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1.5 max-h-[140px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
                  {templates.map(category => (
                    <button
                      key={category}
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleChangeSessionTemplate(changeTemplateSession, category);
                        setCustomCategoryInput('');
                      }}
                      className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 bg-app-panel hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white text-app-text rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all"
                    >
                      {category}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-app-border/40">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-app-dim uppercase tracking-wider">
                Custom Assignment
              </label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={customCategoryInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomCategoryInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter custom category..."
                  className="flex-1 bg-app-input border border-app-border rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-app-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    const trimmed = customCategoryInput.trim();
                    if (trimmed && changeTemplateSession) {
                      addCustomTemplate(trimmed);
                      handleChangeSessionTemplate(changeTemplateSession, trimmed);
                      setCustomCategoryInput('');
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={!customCategoryInput.trim()}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Assign
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end pt-2 border-t border-app-border/40">
              <button
                onClick={() => { setChangeTemplateSession(null); setCustomCategoryInput(''); }}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-panel hover:bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-lg text-app-text text-xs font-semibold transition-all"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default LibraryView;
