      color: 'bg-rose-500/10 border-rose-500/30 hover:border-rose-500',
      disabled: false
    },
    {
      id: 'cue_sheet_planner',
      title: 'A/V Sound & Cue Sheet Planner',
      description: 'Choreograph audio stems, volume slopes, and trigger conditions on a synchronized timeline.',
      icon: (
        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 19V6l12-3v13M9 19c0 1.105-1.343 2-3 2s-3-.895-3-2 1.343-2 3-2 3 .895 3 2zm12-3c0 1.105-1.343 2-3 2s-3-.895-3-2 1.343-2 3-2 3 .895 3 2zM9 10l12-3" />
        </svg>
      ),
      color: 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30 hover:border-amber-500',
      disabled: false
    },
    {
      id: 'voiceover_director',
      title: 'Voiceover Script Director',
      description: 'Format script lines, auto-calculate reading timings, set tone guides, and test spoken playbacks.',
      icon: (
        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 11a7 7 0 01-7 7m0 0a7 7 0 01-7-7m7 7v4m0 0H8m4 0h4m-4-8a3 3 0 01-3-3V5a3 3 0 116 0v6a3 3 0 01-3 3z" />
        </svg>
      ),
      color: 'bg-indigo-500/10 border-indigo-500/30 hover:border-indigo-500',
      disabled: false
    },
    {
      id: 'shot_list_builder',
      title: 'Cinematic Shot List Builder',
      description: 'Define camera types, lens lengths, moody lighting, and track production status on set.',
      icon: (
        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-teal-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 10l4.553-2.276A1 1 0 0121 8.618v6.764a1 1 0 01-1.447.894L15 14M5 18h8a2 2 0 002-2V8a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" />
        </svg>
      ),
      color: 'bg-teal-500/10 border-teal-500/30 hover:border-teal-500',
      disabled: false
    },
    {
      id: 'thumbnail_mockup_suite',
      title: 'Thumbnail & Hook Suite',
      description: 'Simulate user social media cards, generate alternative high-CTR hooks, and preview feeds.',
      icon: (
        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-fuchsia-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
        </svg>
      ),
      color: 'bg-fuchsia-500/10 border-fuchsia-500/30 hover:border-fuchsia-500',
      disabled: false
    },
    {
      id: 'miprompt_library',
      title: 'MyPrompt Lib',
      description: 'Access, manage, import, and export your structured prompts and blueprints.',
      icon: (
        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-fuchsia-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253" />
        </svg>
      ),
      color: 'bg-fuchsia-500/10 border-fuchsia-500/30 hover:border-fuchsia-500',
      disabled: false
    },
    {
      id: 'sxa_board',
      title: 'SeqFrame Editor',
      description: 'Create and organize storyboards with multi-select support, sketching, and export capabilities.',
      icon: (
        <svg className="w-8 h-8 text-sky-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10" />
        </svg>
      ),
      color: 'bg-sky-500/10 border-sky-500/30 hover:border-sky-500',
      disabled: false
    }
  ];

  const defaultOrder = tools.map(t => t.id);
  const [toolOrder, setToolOrder] = React.useState<string[]>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('pref_mediaSuiteToolOrder');
      if (saved) {
         const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
         if (parsed.length === defaultOrder.length) return parsed;
      }
    } catch {}
    return defaultOrder;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUserPreference('mediaSuiteToolOrder').then(saved => {
      if (saved && Array.isArray(saved)) {
         let newOrder = [...saved];
         defaultOrder.forEach(id => {
            if (!newOrder.includes(id)) {
               if (id === 'storyboard_xl') {
                  newOrder.splice(4, 0, id);
               } else {
                  newOrder.push(id);
               }
            }
         });
         setToolOrder(newOrder);
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const [isToolSettingsOpen, setIsToolSettingsOpen] = React.useState(false);

  const orderedTools = [...tools].sort((a, b) => {
    let indexA = toolOrder.indexOf(a.id);
    let indexB = toolOrder.indexOf(b.id);
    if (indexA === -1) indexA = 999;
    if (indexB === -1) indexB = 999;
    return indexA - indexB;
  });

  const handleSaveOrder = (newOrder: string[]) => {
    setToolOrder(newOrder);
    saveUserPreference('mediaSuiteToolOrder', newOrder);
  };

  
  const handleGenerateTranscript = () => {
    if (!ytLink && !ytFile) {
      alert("Please provide a YouTube link or upload a video or audio file.");
      return;
    }
    
    if (ytFile) {
      if (ytFile.size > 19 * 1024 * 1024) {
        alert("File is too large for direct upload (max 19MB). Please use a YouTube link instead.");
        return;
      }
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        const result = e.target?.result as string;
        const base64Data = result.split(',')[1];
        const mediaItem: MediaItem = {
          id: Math.random().toString(36).substring(7),
          name: ytFile.name,
          type: ytFile.type.startsWith('audio/') ? 'audio' : 'video',
          mimeType: ytFile.type,
          data: base64Data
        };
        onRunTool('youtube_transcript', { mediaItem, duration: ytDuration });
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(ytFile);
    } else {
      const mediaItem: MediaItem = {
        id: Math.random().toString(36).substring(7),
        name: ytLink,
        type: 'link',
        mimeType: 'text/uri-list',
        data: ytLink
      };
      onRunTool('youtube_transcript', { mediaItem, duration: ytDuration });
    }
  };

  const handleToolClick = (id: string) => {
    if (id === 'image_generator') {
      onRunTool('image_generator');
      onBack();
    } else {
      setActiveTool(id);
    }
  };

  const renderActiveTool = () => {
    switch (activeTool) {
      case 'seg_carver':
        return <SegCarverTool />;
      case 'filmstrip_editor':
        return <FilmStripEditor onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} activeSession={session} onSaveArtifact={onSaveArtifact} />;
      case 'sxa_board':
        return <SxaBoardTool onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} activeSession={session} onSaveArtifact={onSaveArtifact} />;
      case 'script_writer':
        return <ScriptWriter session={session} onSaveArtifact={onSaveArtifact} />;
      case 'video_script_writer':
        return <VideoScriptWriter session={session} sessions={sessions} onSaveArtifact={onSaveArtifact} />;
      case 'image_describer':
        return <ImageDescriber session={session} onSaveArtifact={onSaveArtifact} />;
      case 'image_carver':
        return <ImageCarverTool />;
      case 'youtube_transcript':
        return (
          <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto p-6 md:p-10 animate-fade-in">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
              <h2 className={`text-2xl font-bold ${st.text} flex items-center gap-3`}>
                <span className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-500/20 text-red-400">
                  <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M14.752 11.168l-3.197-2.132A1 1 0 0010 9.87v4.263a1 1 0 001.555.832l3.197-2.132a1 1 0 000-1.664z" />
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                  </svg>
                </span>
                YouTube Transcript Generator
              </h2>
            </div>
            
            <div className={`space-y-6 ${st.cardBg} border ${st.border} rounded-xl p-6`}>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className={`block text-xs font-bold ${st.textDim} uppercase mb-2`}>YouTube Link</label>
                  <input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={ytLink}
                    onChange={(e) => { setYtLink(e.target.value); setYtFile(null); }}
                    placeholder="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..."
                    className={`w-full bg-zinc-900/50 border ${st.border} rounded-lg p-3 ${st.text} focus:border-red-500 focus:outline-none transition-colors`}
                  />
                </div>
                
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className={`h-px flex-1 ${st.border}`}></div>
                  <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${st.textDim} uppercase`}>OR</span>
                  <div className={`h-px flex-1 ${st.border}`}></div>
                </div>
                
                <div>
                  <label className={`block text-xs font-bold ${st.textDim} uppercase mb-2`}>Upload Video or Audio File</label>
                  <div className="relative">
                    <input 
                      type="file" 
                      accept="video/*,audio/*"
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        if (e.target.files?.[0]) {
                          setYtFile(e.target.files[0]);
                          setYtLink('');
                        }
                      }}
                      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                    />
                    <div className={`w-full border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-colors ${ytFile ? 'border-red-500 bg-red-500/5' : `${st.border} bg-zinc-900/20 hover:border-red-500/50 hover:bg-red-500/5`}`}>
                      <svg className={`w-8 h-8 mb-2 ${ytFile ? 'text-red-400' : st.textDim}`} fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M7 16a4 4 0 01-.88-7.903A5 5 0 1115.9 6L16 6a5 5 0 011 9.9M15 13l-3-3m0 0l-3 3m3-3v12" />
                      </svg>
                      <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${ytFile ? 'text-red-400' : st.text}`}>
                        {ytFile ? ytFile.name : 'Click or drag media file here'}
                      </span>
                      {!ytFile && <span className={`text-xs ${st.textDim} mt-1`}>MP4, MP3, WAV, etc.</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className={`pt-6 border-t ${st.border}`}>
                <label className={`block text-xs font-bold ${st.textDim} uppercase mb-3`}>Transcription Duration</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                  {['1', '3', '5', 'All'].map((dur) => (
                    <button
                      key={dur}
                      onClick={() => setYtDuration(dur)}
                      className={`py-2 rounded-lg border text-sm font-bold transition-all ${ytDuration === dur ? 'bg-red-500 text-white border-red-500 shadow-lg shadow-red-500/20' : `bg-zinc-900/30 ${st.border} ${st.textDim} hover:${st.text} hover:border-red-500/50`}`}
                    >
                      {dur === 'All' ? 'Full Video' : `${dur} Min`}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="pt-6">
                <button 
                  onClick={handleGenerateTranscript}
                  disabled={isLoading || (!ytLink && !ytFile)}
                  className="w-full py-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 to-orange-600 hover:from-red-500 hover:to-orange-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-red-500/20 transition-all transform hover:scale-[1.02] disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:hover:scale-100 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  {isLoading ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                      <span>Generating Transcript...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 11a7 7 0 01-7 7m0 0a7 7 0 01-7-7m7 7v4m0 0H8m4 0h4m-4-8a3 3 0 01-3-3V5a3 3 0 116 0v6a3 3 0 01-3 3z" />
                      </svg>
                      <span>Generate Transcript</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      case 'broll_searcher':
        return <BRollSearcher onBack={onBack} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'subtitler':
        return <SubtitlerTranslator onBack={onBack} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'audio_cleaner':
        return <AudioCleanerWorkspace onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'color_grader':
        return <ColorGraderWorkspace onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'advanced_storyboarder':
        return <AdvancedStoryboarder onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'storyboard_xl':
        return <StoryboardXL onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'moodboard_creator':
        return <MoodboardGenerator onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'cue_sheet_planner':
        return <CueSheetPlanner onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'voiceover_director':
        return <VoiceoverDirector onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'shot_list_builder':
        return <ShotListBuilder onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'thumbnail_mockup_suite':
        return <ThumbnailHookSuite onBack={() => setActiveTool(null)} localTheme={localTheme} />;
      case 'miprompt_library':
        return (
          <MIPrOMPTLibraryView 
            miprompts={miprompts}
            onAdd={onAddMIPrOMPT}
            onUpdate={onUpdateMIPrOMPT}
            onDelete={onDeleteMIPrOMPT}
            onImport={onImportCSV}
            currentTheme={currentTheme}
          />
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  if (activeTool) {
    const activeToolData = tools.find(t => t.id === activeTool);
    const hasCustomHeader = activeTool === 'storyboard_xl' || activeTool === 'filmstrip_editor' || activeTool === 'sxa_board';
    return (
      <div className={`fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex flex-col ${st.bg}`}>
        {!hasCustomHeader && (
          <header className={`p-4 border-b flex items-center justify-between ${st.panelBg} ${st.border}`}>
            <h1 className={`text-xl font-bold ${st.text}`}>{activeToolData?.title}</h1>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setActiveTool(null)} 
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600/20 hover:bg-rose-600 text-rose-400 hover:text-white border border-rose-500/20 hover:border-rose-600 rounded-lg text-xs font-black transition-all duration-150 cursor-pointer shadow flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span>Close Tool</span>
            </button>
          </header>
        )}
        <div className={`flex-1 overflow-auto ${st.bg}`}>
          {renderActiveTool()}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col h-full ${st.bg}`}>
      <header className={`p-4 border-b flex items-center justify-between ${st.panelBg} ${st.border}`}>
        <h1 className={`text-xl font-bold ${st.text}`}>Media Suite</h1>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              const nextIndex = (themes.indexOf(localTheme) + 1) % themes.length;
              const nextTheme = themes[nextIndex];
              setLocalTheme(nextTheme);
              localStorage.setItem('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
              saveUserPreference('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
              window.dispatchEvent(new Event('creative_studio_theme_change'));
            }}
            className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full border-2 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
              localTheme === 'charcoal' ? 'bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-600 shadow-md shadow-black/40'
              : localTheme === 'silver' ? 'bg-zinc-300 border-zinc-400 shadow-md shadow-zinc-500/20'
              : localTheme === 'white' ? 'bg-white border-zinc-300 shadow-md'
              : localTheme === 'cosmic' ? 'bg-indigo-900 border-indigo-500 shadow-md shadow-indigo-950/50'
              : localTheme === 'emerald' ? 'bg-emerald-900 border-emerald-500 shadow-md shadow-emerald-950/50'
              : localTheme === 'amber' ? 'bg-amber-600 border-amber-500 shadow-md shadow-amber-950/50'
              : localTheme === 'cyberpunk' ? 'bg-fuchsia-900 border-cyan-400 shadow-md'
              : localTheme === 'slate' ? 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-500 shadow-md'
              : localTheme === 'crimson' ? 'bg-rose-900 border-rose-500 shadow-md shadow-rose-950/50'
              : localTheme === 'orchid' ? 'bg-fuchsia-700 border-fuchsia-500 shadow-md shadow-fuchsia-950/50'
              : 'bg-stone-700 border-stone-500 shadow-md shadow-stone-950/50'
            }`}
            title={`Cycle theme (current: ${localTheme})`}
          />
          <button
            onClick={handleViewModeChange}
            className={`p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors shadow-sm ${st.btnInactive}`}
            title="Toggle View Mode"
          >
            {viewMode === 'strip' ? (
                <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                   <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" />
                </svg>
            ) : viewMode === 'compact' ? (
                <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                   <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z" />
                </svg>
            ) : (
                <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                   <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM10 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM16 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6z" />
                </svg>
            )}
          </button>
          {!activeTool && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsToolSettingsOpen(true)}
              className={`p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors shadow-sm ${st.btnInactive}`}
              title="Reorder Tools"
            >
              <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          )}
          <button 
            onClick={onBack} 
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-red-600/20 hover:bg-red-600 text-red-400 hover:text-white border border-red-500/20 hover:border-red-600 rounded-lg text-xs font-black transition-all duration-150 shadow cursor-pointer"
            title="Back to Library"
          >
            <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m-7 7h18" />
            </svg>
            <span>Return to Tools</span>
          </button>
        </div>

      </header>
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-6">
        <div className={`grid ${viewMode === "icon" ? "grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-6 lg:grid-cols-8" : viewMode === "compact" ? "grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" : "grid-cols-1"} gap-6`}>
          {orderedTools.map((tool, index) => (
            <button
              key={tool.id}
              onClick={() => {
                if (tool.disabled) return;
                handleToolClick(tool.id);
              }}
              disabled={tool.disabled}
              className={`flex ${viewMode === 'strip' ? 'flex-row items-center space-x-6' : viewMode === 'icon' ? 'flex-col items-center justify-center p-4' : 'flex-col items-start'} ${viewMode !== 'icon' ? 'p-6' : ''} rounded-2xl border transition-all text-left group ${tool.color} ${tool.disabled ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'hover:shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.02] cursor-pointer'}`}
            >
              <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${st.cardBg} border ${st.border} group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform ${viewMode === 'strip' || viewMode === 'icon' ? 'mb-0' : 'mb-4'}`}>
                {tool.icon}
              </div>
              {viewMode !== 'icon' && (
              <div>
                <h3 className={`font-semibold text-lg mb-2 ${st.text}`}>{index + 1}. {tool.title}</h3>
                <p className={`text-sm ${st.textDim}`}>{tool.description}</p>
              </div>
            )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    
      
    
      <ToolOrderSettingsModal
        isOpen={isToolSettingsOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsToolSettingsOpen(false)}
        tools={tools}
        toolOrder={toolOrder}
        onSave={handleSaveOrder}
        viewModeLabel={`Layout: ${viewMode}`}
        onCycleViewMode={handleViewModeChange}
        themeLabel={`Theme: ${localTheme}`}
        onCycleTheme={() => {
           const themes = ['charcoal', 'silver', 'white', 'cosmic', 'emerald', 'amber', 'cyberpunk', 'slate', 'crimson', 'orchid', 'olive'];
           const nextIndex = (themes.indexOf(localTheme) + 1) % themes.length;
           const nextTheme = themes[nextIndex];
           setLocalTheme(nextTheme);
           localStorage.setItem('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
           saveUserPreference('creative_studio_theme', nextTheme);
           window.dispatchEvent(new Event('creative_studio_theme_change'));
        }}
      />
</div>
  );
};

// ==========================================
// AI AUDIO CLEANER WORKSPACE
// ==========================================
interface AudioCleanerProps {
  onBack: () => void;
  localTheme: string;
}

const AudioCleanerWorkspace: React.FC<AudioCleanerProps> = ({ onBack, localTheme }) => {
  const st = themeStyles[localTheme] || themeStyles.charcoal;
  const [noiseReduction, setNoiseReduction] = useState(85);
  const [voicePresence, setVoicePresence] = useState(60);
  const [bassBoost, setBassBoost] = useState(20);
  const [activePreset, setActivePreset] = useState('diner_hiss');
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [isCleaned, setIsCleaned] = useState(true);
  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const oscRef = useRef<OscillatorNode | null>(null);
  const gainNodeRef = useRef<GainNode | null>(null);

  const presets = {
    diner_hiss: { name: 'Diner Background Gossip', freq: 150, noiseLevel: 0.25 },
    windy_street: { name: 'Windy City Alleyway', freq: 60, noiseLevel: 0.4 },
    ac_hum: { name: 'Server AC Unit Hum', freq: 50, noiseLevel: 0.15 }
  };

  const handlePlaySim = () => {
    if (isPlaying) {
      handleStopSim();
      return;
    }

    try {
      const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
      const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
      audioContextRef.current = ctx;

      // Create "Voice" representation
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, ctx.currentTime);
      oscRef.current = osc;

      // Create "Background Noise" representation
      const humOsc = ctx.createOscillator();
      humOsc.type = 'sawtooth';
      humOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime((presets as any)[activePreset].freq, ctx.currentTime);
      
      const noiseGain = ctx.createGain();
      const targetNoise = isCleaned 
        ? (presets as any)[activePreset].noiseLevel * (1 - noiseReduction / 100)
        : (presets as any)[activePreset].noiseLevel;
      noiseGain.gain.setValueAtTime(targetNoise, ctx.currentTime);

      const mainGain = ctx.createGain();
      mainGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, ctx.currentTime);
      gainNodeRef.current = mainGain;

      // Connect nodes
      osc.connect(mainGain);
      humOsc.connect(noiseGain);
      noiseGain.connect(mainGain);
      mainGain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start();
      humOsc.start();
      setIsPlaying(true);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setIsPlaying(true);
    }
  };

  const handleStopSim = () => {
    try {
      if (oscRef.current) oscRef.current.stop();
      if (audioContextRef.current) audioContextRef.current.close();
    } catch {}
    setIsPlaying(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isPlaying) {
      handleStopSim();
      setTimeout(() => handlePlaySim(), 100);
    }
  }, [isCleaned, noiseReduction, activePreset]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      try {
        if (oscRef.current) oscRef.current.stop();
        if (audioContextRef.current) audioContextRef.current.close();
      } catch {}
    };
  }, []);

  const runMockClean = () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsProcessing(false);
      setIsCleaned(true);
      alert("Audio cleaned successfully using custom AI profile!");
    }, 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-zinc-800 pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-400">
            <svg className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 11a7 7 0 01-7 7m0 0a7 7 0 01-7-7m7 7v4m0 0H8m4 0h4m-4-8a3 3 0 01-3-3V5a3 3 0 116 0v6a3 3 0 01-3 3z" />
            </svg>
            AI Audio Cleaner Studio
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1">Isolate voices, dial down room rumble, and filter wind hiss interactively.</p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={onBack} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold border ${st.border} ${st.btnInactive}`}>Back</button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        
        {/* Visual Waveform & Control Playback */}
        <div className="md:col-span-7 bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-extrabold uppercase">Audio Input Reference</span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsCleaned(!isCleaned)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${isCleaned ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/20'}`}
              >
                Output: {isCleaned ? 'Filtered Clean voice' : 'Original Raw Noise'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Real Animated Waveform Bars */}
          <div className="h-28 bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-850 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center px-6 gap-0.5 overflow-hidden relative">
            {Array.from({ length: 42 }).map((_, i) => {
              const baseHeight = Math.sin(i * 0.3) * 30 + 40;
              const cleanHeight = baseHeight * (1 - noiseReduction / 120);
              const activeHeight = isPlaying ? (isCleaned ? cleanHeight : baseHeight) : 6;
              return (
                <div 
                  key={i} 
                  className={`w-1 rounded transition-all duration-300 ${isCleaned ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-amber-500'}`}
                  style={{ 
                    height: `${activeHeight}%`,
                    animationDelay: isPlaying ? `${i * 30}ms` : '0s',
                    animationDuration: '600ms',
                    animationIterationCount: 'infinite',
                    animationName: isPlaying ? 'bounce' : 'none'
                  }}
                />
              );
            })}
            <style>{`
              @keyframes bounce {
                0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(1); }
                50% { transform: scaleY(0.4); }
              }
            `}</style>
          </div>

          {/* Simulated Controls */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <button
              onClick={handlePlaySim}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 ${isPlaying ? 'bg-amber-500 text-black' : 'bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-700'}`}
            >
              {isPlaying ? (
                <>
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4 fill-black" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 19h4V5H6v14zm8-14v14h4V5h-4z"/></svg>
                  Stop Test Signal
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4 fill-zinc-200" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>
                  Simulate Play Signal
                </>
              )}
            </button>

            <button 
              onClick={runMockClean}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-zinc-950 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              {isProcessing ? 'Enhancing...' : 'Recalculate AI Voice Filter'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Sliders Configuration */}
        <div className="md:col-span-5 bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-5">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-extrabold uppercase">Parameter Settings</span>

          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold block mb-1">Preset Scene Sample</label>
            <select
              value={activePreset}
              onChange={(e) => setActivePreset(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-200"
            >
              {Object.entries(presets).map(([k, v]) => (
                <option key={k} value={k}>{v.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold mb-1">
                <span>Noise Isolation Strength</span>
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono font-bold">{noiseReduction}%</span>
              </div>
              <input 
                type="range"
                min="10"
                max="100"
                value={noiseReduction}
                onChange={(e) => setNoiseReduction(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-amber-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold mb-1">
                <span>Voice Presence Boost</span>
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono font-bold">{voicePresence}%</span>
              </div>
              <input 
                type="range"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                value={voicePresence}
                onChange={(e) => setVoicePresence(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-amber-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold mb-1">
                <span>Sub-Bass Vocal Warmth</span>
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono font-bold">{bassBoost}%</span>
              </div>
              <input 
                type="range"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                value={bassBoost}
                onChange={(e) => setBassBoost(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-amber-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface ColorGraderProps {
  onBack: () => void;
  localTheme: string;
}

const ColorGraderWorkspace: React.FC<ColorGraderProps> = ({ onBack, localTheme }) => {
  const st = themeStyles[localTheme] || themeStyles.charcoal;

  const presets = {
    warm_blockbuster: { name: 'Teal & Orange', brightness: 105, contrast: 115, saturate: 125, sepia: 15, hueRotate: 0, desc: 'Cozy skin-tones paired with cool shadows.' },
    cyberpunk: { name: 'Cyberpunk Grid', brightness: 110, contrast: 130, saturate: 180, sepia: 0, hueRotate: 310, desc: 'Highly vibrant neon purples and hot pinks.' },
    noir: { name: 'Detective Noir', brightness: 90, contrast: 140, saturate: 0, sepia: 5, hueRotate: 0, desc: 'Classic monochromatic heavy-shadow styling.' },
    vintage: { name: 'Vintage Kodak', brightness: 95, contrast: 105, saturate: 90, sepia: 30, hueRotate: 15, desc: 'Warm 1970s film nostalgia grain.' }
  };

  const [brightness, setBrightness] = useState(105);
  const [contrast, setContrast] = useState(115);
  const [saturate, setSaturate] = useState(125);
  const [sepia, setSepia] = useState(15);
  const [hueRotate, setHueRotate] = useState(0);

  const applyPreset = (key: keyof typeof presets) => {
    const p = presets[key];
    setBrightness(p.brightness);
    setContrast(p.contrast);
    setSaturate(p.saturate);
    setSepia(p.sepia);
    setHueRotate(p.hueRotate);
  };

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setBrightness(100);
    setContrast(100);
    setSaturate(100);
    setSepia(0);
    setHueRotate(0);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-zinc-800 pb-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-400">
            <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M7 21a4 4 0 01-4-4V5a2 2 0 012-2h4a2 2 0 012 2v12a4 4 0 01-4 4zm0 0h12a2 2 0 002-2v-4a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2.343M11 7.343l1.657-1.657a2 2 0 012.828 0l2.829 2.829a2 2 0 010 2.828l-8.486 8.485M7 17h.01" />
            </svg>
            Cinematic Color Grader
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-1">Configure real-time CSS lookup filter attributes and cinematic LUT maps.</p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={onBack} className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-xs font-bold border ${st.border} ${st.btnInactive}`}>Back</button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        
        {/* Visual Canvas Image Preview */}
        <div className="md:col-span-7 bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-extrabold uppercase">Live Grading Board</span>

          <div className="aspect-video w-full rounded-lg bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-850 overflow-hidden relative flex items-center justify-center">
            <svg 
              className="w-full h-full transition-all duration-300"
              viewBox="0 0 400 225"
              style={{
                filter: `brightness(${brightness}%) contrast(${contrast}%) saturate(${saturate}%) sepia(${sepia}%) hue-rotate(${hueRotate}deg)`
              }}
            >
              <defs>
                <linearGradient id="grad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                  <stop offset="0%" style={{ stopColor: '#1e1b4b', stopOpacity: 1 }} />
                  <stop offset="100%" style={{ stopColor: '#311042', stopOpacity: 1 }} />
                </linearGradient>
              </defs>
              <rect width="400" height="225" fill="url(#grad1)" />
              <circle cx="200" cy="112" r="50" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.8" />
              <polygon points="0,225 150,120 300,225" fill="#0f172a" />
              <polygon points="180,225 310,140 400,225" fill="#090d16" />
              <text x="20" y="40" fill="#ffffff" fontSize="12" fontWeight="bold" opacity="0.6" fontFamily="sans-serif">CAMERA INPUT A1</text>

          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">

          <div>

                  <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 leading-tight block">{v.desc}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Sliders */}
          <div className="space-y-4 border-t border-zinc-800 pt-4">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-extrabold uppercase block">Precision Adjustments</span>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold mb-1">

                <span className="text-rose-400 font-mono font-bold">{contrast}%</span>
              </div>
              <input type="range" min="50" max="200" value={contrast} onChange={(e) => setContrast(parseInt(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-rose-500" />

            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-bold mb-1">
                <span>Vintage Warmth (Sepia)</span>
                <span className="text-rose-400 font-mono font-bold">{sepia}%</span>
              </div>
              <input type="range" min="0" max="100" value={sepia} onChange={(e) => setSepia(parseInt(e.target.value))} className="w-full accent-rose-500" />
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

### --- START FILE: applet/components/MediaViewer.tsx --- ###

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { MediaItem } from '../types';

interface MediaViewerProps {
  item: MediaItem;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const MediaViewer: React.FC<MediaViewerProps> = ({ item, onClose }) => {
  
  // Helper to decode Base64 content for text viewing
  const decodedContent = useMemo(() => {
    if (item.type === 'link') return item.data;
    if (item.type === 'text' || item.type === 'sql' || item.type === 'html') {
      try {
        const binaryString = atob(item.data);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
          bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
        }
        return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to decode base64 text", e);
        return "Error decoding text content.";
      }
    }
    return "";
  }, [item]);

  const renderContent = () => {
    switch (item.type) {
      case 'image':
        return (
          <img 
            src={`data:${item.mimeType};base64,${item.data}`} 
            alt={item.name} 
            className="w-full h-full object-contain"
          />
        );
      case 'video':
        return (
          <video 
            src={`data:${item.mimeType};base64,${item.data}`} 
            controls 
            className="w-full h-full active-media-viewer bg-black object-contain"
          />
        );
      case 'audio':
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-gray-200 to-gray-300">
            <div className="w-40 h-40 bg-gray-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-10 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden border-4 border-white/50">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-blue-500/10 animate-pulse"></div>
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-20 w-20 text-blue-600 relative z-10" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M9 19V6l12-3v13M9 19c0 1.105-1.343 2-3 2s-3-.895-3-2 1.343-2 3-2 3 .895 3 2zm12-3c0 1.105-1.343 2-3 2s-3-.895-3-2 1.343-2 3-2 3 .895 3 2zM9 10l12-3" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <audio 
              src={`data:${item.mimeType};base64,${item.data}`} 
              controls 
              className="w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl rounded-full active-media-viewer bg-gray-100"
            />
          </div>
        );
      case 'pdf':
        return (
          <iframe 
            src={`data:${item.mimeType};base64,${item.data}`}
            title={item.name}
            className="w-full h-full"
          />
        );
      case 'html':
        return (
          <iframe 
            srcDoc={decodedContent}
            title={item.name}
            className="w-full h-full border-none bg-white"
            sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals allow-same-origin allow-downloads"
          />
        );
      case 'document':
        return (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-gray-500">
             <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-20 w-20 mb-4 opacity-50" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z" />
             </svg>
             <p className="text-lg font-bold">Document Preview Unavailable</p>
             <p className="text-sm mt-2 max-w-md text-center">
               This is a binary document (Word/Excel). It cannot be previewed directly in the browser, but it has been attached to the chat context for AI analysis.
             </p>
          </div>
        );
      case 'text':
      case 'sql':
      case 'link':
      default:
        return (
          <div className="w-full h-full p-6 overflow-auto bg-gray-200">
            <div className="bg-gray-50 text-slate-900 p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-300 min-h-full">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-4 border-b border-gray-200 pb-2">
                  {item.type === 'link' ? 'URL Link' : (item.type === 'sql' ? 'SQL Query' : 'File Content')}
                </h3>
                <pre className="font-mono text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words leading-relaxed selection:bg-yellow-200 selection:text-black">
                  {decodedContent}
                </pre>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-gray-200 border-l border-app-border">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b border-gray-300 bg-gray-100 shadow-sm z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden flex-1 mr-2">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5 text-fuchsia-600 shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
            <path d="M10 12a2 2 0 100-4 2 2 0 000 4z" />
            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M.458 10C1.732 5.943 5.522 3 10 3s8.268 2.943 9.542 7c-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7S1.732 14.057.458 10zM14 10a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0z" clipRule="evenodd" />
          </svg>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 truncate" title={item.name}>Viewing: {item.name}</span>
          {item.tags && item.tags.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar ml-2">
              {item.tags.map((tag, idx) => (
                <span key={idx} className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-gray-200 text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap border border-gray-300">
                  {tag}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-900 p-1 bg-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-300 rounded transition-colors shrink-0">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-5 w-5" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor">
            <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M4.293 4.293a1 1 0 011.414 0L10 8.586l4.293-4.293a1 1 0 111.414 1.414L11.414 10l4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414L10 11.414l-4.293 4.293a1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414L8.586 10 4.293 5.707a1 1 0 010-1.414z" clipRule="evenodd" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative bg-gray-200">
        {renderContent()}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MediaViewer;

### --- START FILE: applet/components/MindMapPopup.tsx --- ###

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';

interface MindMapPopupProps {
  title: string;
  content: string | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const MindMapPopup: React.FC<MindMapPopupProps> = ({ title, content, isLoading, onClose }) => {
  const [tableStyle, setTableStyle] = useState<'default' | 'modern' | 'minimal'>('default');

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-fade-in">
      <div className="bg-app-card border border-app-border rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[80vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-app-border bg-app-panel">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
             <div className="p-2 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg">
                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-6 w-6 text-blue-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                   <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                </svg>
             </div>
             <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-app-text">
               {title} <span className="text-sm font-normal text-app-dim opacity-75">/ Context Detail</span>
             </h3>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-app-bg text-app-dim hover:text-app-text transition-colors">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className="h-6 w-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 bg-app-bg text-app-text relative">
           {isLoading ? (
             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 space-y-4">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-purple-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                <p className="text-app-dim animate-pulse">Analyzing context from sources...</p>
             </div>
           ) : (
             <div className="markdown-body text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">
                {content ? (
                  <ReactMarkdown
                      remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
                      components={{
                          table: ({node, ...props}) => (
                              <div className="my-4 group relative pt-8">
                                  <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex gap-1 z-10">
                                      <button onClick={() => setTableStyle('default')} className={`px-2 py-1 text-[10px] rounded ${tableStyle === 'default' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-app-card text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'}`}>Default</button>
                                      <button onClick={() => setTableStyle('modern')} className={`px-2 py-1 text-[10px] rounded ${tableStyle === 'modern' ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white' : 'bg-app-card text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'}`}>Modern</button>
                                      <button onClick={() => setTableStyle('minimal')} className={`px-2 py-1 text-[10px] rounded ${tableStyle === 'minimal' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-app-card text-app-dim hover:text-app-text'}`}>Minimal</button>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                      <table className={`min-w-full divide-y ${tableStyle === 'modern' ? 'divide-purple-500/30 border-purple-500/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.15)] bg-purple-900/10' : tableStyle === 'minimal' ? 'divide-transparent border-transparent' : 'divide-app-border border-app-border bg-black/20'} border rounded-lg`} {...props} />
                                  </div>
                              </div>
                          ),
                          thead: ({node, ...props}) => <thead className={`${tableStyle === 'modern' ? 'bg-purple-900/40' : tableStyle === 'minimal' ? 'border-b-2 border-app-text' : 'bg-app-panel/50'}`} {...props} />,
                          th: ({node, ...props}) => <th className={`px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${tableStyle === 'modern' ? 'text-purple-300 border-b border-purple-500/30' : tableStyle === 'minimal' ? 'text-app-text' : 'text-app-text border-b border-app-border'}`} {...props} />,
                          td: ({node, ...props}) => <td className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm ${tableStyle === 'modern' ? 'text-purple-100/90 border-b border-purple-500/20' : tableStyle === 'minimal' ? 'text-app-text/80 py-3' : 'text-app-text/90 border-b border-app-border/50'}`} {...props} />,
                          a: ({node, href, children, ...props}) => <a href={href} className="text-blue-400 hover:underline" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" {...props}>{children}</a>,
                          p: ({node, ...props}) => <p className="mb-2 last:mb-0" {...props} />,
                          ul: ({node, ...props}) => <ul className="list-disc pl-5 mb-2 space-y-1" {...props} />,
                          ol: ({node, ...props}) => <ol className="list-decimal pl-5 mb-2 space-y-1" {...props} />,
                          h1: ({node, ...props}) => <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mt-4 mb-2" {...props} />,
                          h2: ({node, ...props}) => <h2 className="text-lg font-bold mt-3 mb-2" {...props} />,
                          h3: ({node, ...props}) => <h3 className="text-md font-bold mt-2 mb-1" {...props} />,
                          blockquote: ({node, ...props}) => <blockquote className="border-l-4 border-app-border pl-4 italic opacity-80 my-2" {...props} />,
                          strong: ({node, ...props}) => <strong className="font-bold text-current opacity-100" {...props} />,
                      }}
                  >
                      {content}
                  </ReactMarkdown>
                ) : (
                  "No details available."
                )}
             </div>
           )}
        </div>
        
        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 bg-app-panel border-t border-app-border flex justify-end">
           <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-2 bg-app-card hover:bg-app-border text-app-text text-sm font-medium rounded-lg transition-colors border border-app-border">
             Close
           </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MindMapPopup;

### --- START FILE: applet/components/MindMapViewer.tsx --- ###

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MindMapNode, MediaItem } from '../types';
import { expandMindMapNode, fetchNodeDescription } from '../services/mindMapService';

interface MindMapViewProps {
  data: MindMapNode | null;
  sources?: MediaItem[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onRefresh?: () => void;
  onNodeDoubleClick?: (label: string) => void;
}

interface NodePosition {
  id: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  label: string;
  level: number;
  parentId?: string;
  description?: string;
}

const NODE_WIDTH = 160;
const NODE_HEIGHT = 50;
const LEVEL_GAP = 250;
const VERTICAL_GAP = 80;

const MindMapViewer: React.FC<MindMapViewProps> = ({ data, onClose, onRefresh, sources = [], onNodeDoubleClick }) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [treeData, setTreeData] = useState<MindMapNode | null>(null);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1);
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [isPanning, setIsPanning] = useState(false);
  const [lastPanPoint, setLastPanPoint] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState<NodePosition[]>([]);
  const [draggingNodeId, setDraggingNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandingNodeId, setExpandingNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [describingNodeId, setDescribingNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeDescription, setActiveDescription] = useState<{id: string, text: string, x: number, y: number} | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data) {
        setTreeData(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)));
    }
  }, [data]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!treeData) return;
    const newNodes: NodePosition[] = [];
    let currentY = 0;
    const calculateLayout = (node: MindMapNode, level: number, parentId?: string) => {
      const myId = node.id || crypto.randomUUID();
      if (node.children && node.children.length > 0) {
        node.children.forEach(child => {
           calculateLayout(child, level + 1, myId);
        });
        const childNodes = newNodes.filter(n => node.children!.some(c => c.id === n.id));
        if (childNodes.length > 0) {
             const minY = Math.min(...childNodes.map(n => n.y));
             const maxY = Math.max(...childNodes.map(n => n.y));
             currentY = (minY + maxY) / 2;
        }
      } else {
        currentY += VERTICAL_GAP;
      }
      newNodes.push({
        id: myId,
        x: level * LEVEL_GAP,
        y: currentY,
        label: node.label,
        level,
        parentId
      });
    };
    calculateLayout(treeData, 0);
    if (nodes.length === 0 && newNodes.length > 0 && containerRef.current) {
        const bounds = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const treeMinY = Math.min(...newNodes.map(n => n.y));
        const treeMaxY = Math.max(...newNodes.map(n => n.y));
        const initialOffsetY = (bounds.height / 2) - (treeMinY + (treeMaxY - treeMinY) / 2);
        setOffset({ x: 100, y: initialOffsetY });
    }
    setNodes(newNodes);
  }, [treeData]);

  const handleExpand = async (e: React.MouseEvent, nodeLabel: string, nodeId: string) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (expandingNodeId || !sources.length) return;
      setExpandingNodeId(nodeId);
      try {
          const newChildren = await expandMindMapNode(sources, nodeLabel);
          if (newChildren.length > 0) {
              const updateTree = (node: MindMapNode): MindMapNode => {
                  if (node.id === nodeId) {
                      return { ...node, children: [...(node.children || []), ...newChildren] };
                  }
                  if (node.children) {
                      return { ...node, children: node.children.map(updateTree) };
                  }
                  return node;
              };
              setTreeData(prev => prev ? updateTree(prev) : null);
          }
      } catch (err) {
          console.error("Expand failed", err);
      } finally {
          setExpandingNodeId(null);
      }
  };

  const handleInfo = async (e: React.MouseEvent, nodeLabel: string, nodeId: string, x: number, y: number) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (describingNodeId || !sources.length) return;
      if (activeDescription?.id === nodeId) {
          setActiveDescription(null);
          return;
      }
      setDescribingNodeId(nodeId);
      try {
          const text = await fetchNodeDescription(sources, nodeLabel);
          setActiveDescription({
              id: nodeId,
              text,
              x: x + NODE_WIDTH + 20,
              y: y
          });
      } catch (err) {
          console.error("Info failed", err);
      } finally {
          setDescribingNodeId(null);
      }
  };

  const handleNodeDoubleClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, label: string) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (onNodeDoubleClick) onNodeDoubleClick(label);
  }

  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const zoomSensitivity = 0.001;
    const newScale = Math.min(Math.max(0.1, scale - e.deltaY * zoomSensitivity), 4);
    setScale(newScale);
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
     setIsPanning(true);
     setLastPanPoint({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
     setActiveDescription(null); 
  };

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (isPanning) {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastPanPoint.x;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastPanPoint.y;
        setOffset(prev => ({ x: prev.x + dx, y: prev.y + dy }));
        setLastPanPoint({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    } else if (draggingNodeId) {
        const dx = e.movementX / scale;
        const dy = e.movementY / scale;
        setNodes(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === draggingNodeId ? { ...n, x: n.x + dx, y: n.y + dy } : n));
    }
  };

  const handleMouseUp = () => {
    setIsPanning(false);
    setDraggingNodeId(null);
  };

  const handleNodeMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      setDraggingNodeId(id);
  };

  const getNodeColor = (level: number) => {
      if (level === 0) return 'bg-app-text/20 border-app-text';
      if (level === 1) return 'bg-app-card border-app-dim';
      return 'bg-app-panel border-app-border';
  };

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 z-50 bg-app-bg/95 backdrop-blur-sm flex flex-col animate-fade-in">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-app-border relative z-20 bg-app-panel">
         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
             <div className="p-2 bg-purple-500/10 rounded-lg">
                <svg className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19.428 15.428a2 2 0 00-1.022-.547l-2.387-.477a6 6 0 00-3.86.517l-.318.158a6 6 0 01-3.86.517L6.05 15.21a2 2 0 00-1.806.547M8 4h8l-1 1v5.172a2 2 0 00.586 1.414l5 5c1.26 1.26.367 3.414-1.415 3.414H4.828c-1.782 0-2.674-2.154-1.414-3.414l5-5A2 2 0 009 10.172V5L8 4z" /></svg>
             </div>
             <h2 className="text-xl font-normal text-app-text">Mind Map</h2>
             <span className="text-xs text-app-dim bg-app-card px-2 py-1 rounded">Double-click node for details • Drag to stretch</span>
         </div>
         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {onRefresh && (
                <button onClick={onRefresh} className="p-2 hover:bg-app-card rounded-full text-cyan-400 hover:text-cyan-300 transition" title="Regenerate Map">
                   <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 4v5h.582m15.356 2A8.001 8.001 0 004.582 9m0 0H9m11 11v-5h-.581m0 0a8.003 8.003 0 01-15.357-2m15.357 2H15" /></svg>
                </button>
            )}
            <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 hover:bg-app-card rounded-full text-app-dim hover:text-app-text transition">
               <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
            </button>
         </div>
      </div>

      <div 
        ref={containerRef}
        className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative bg-app-bg cursor-move active:cursor-grabbing"
        onWheel={handleWheel}
        onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
        onMouseLeave={handleMouseUp}
      >
         <div 
            className="absolute inset-0 opacity-20 pointer-events-none"
            style={{
                backgroundSize: `${20 * scale}px ${20 * scale}px`,
                backgroundPosition: `${offset.x}px ${offset.y}px`,
                backgroundImage: `radial-gradient(var(--c-border) 1px, transparent 1px)`
            }}
         />
         {!data ? (
             <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                 <div className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-purple-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-4"></div>
                 <p className="text-app-text">Generating Neural Structure...</p>
             </div>
         ) : (
             <div 
                className="absolute left-0 top-0 transition-transform duration-75 ease-out origin-top-left"
                style={{
                    transform: `translate(${offset.x}px, ${offset.y}px) scale(${scale})`
                }}
             >
                <svg className="overflow-visible absolute top-0 left-0 w-1 h-1 pointer-events-none">
                    {nodes.map(node => {
                        if (!node.parentId) return null;
                        const parent = nodes.find(n => n.id === node.parentId);
                        if (!parent) return null;
                        const startX = parent.x + NODE_WIDTH;
                        const startY = parent.y + NODE_HEIGHT / 2;
                        const endX = node.x;
                        const endY = node.y + NODE_HEIGHT / 2;
                        const c1x = startX + (endX - startX) / 2;
                        const c1y = startY;
                        const c2x = endX - (endX - startX) / 2;
                        const c2y = endY;
                        return (
                            <path 
                                key={`link-${node.id}`}
                                d={`M ${startX} ${startY} C ${c1x} ${c1y}, ${c2x} ${c2y}, ${endX} ${endY}`}
                                stroke="var(--c-border)" 
                                strokeWidth="2" 
                                fill="none" 
                                className="opacity-60"
                            />
                        );
                    })}
                </svg>
                {nodes.map(node => (
                    <div
                        key={node.id}
                        onMouseDown={(e) => handleNodeMouseDown(e, node.id)}
                        onDoubleClick={(e) => handleNodeDoubleClick(e, node.label)}
                        className={`absolute flex items-center justify-center p-3 rounded-xl shadow-lg border cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing group transition-all duration-200 ${getNodeColor(node.level)}`}
                        style={{
                            left: node.x,
                            top: node.y,
                            width: NODE_WIDTH,
                            minHeight: NODE_HEIGHT,
                        }}
                    >
                        <span className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-app-text leading-tight pointer-events-none">
                            {node.label}
                        </span>
                        <div className="absolute -top-3 -right-2 flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                            <button 
                                onClick={(e) => handleExpand(e, node.label, node.id)}
                                disabled={!!expandingNodeId}
                                className="w-5 h-5 bg-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-blue-500 shadow-md text-white"
                                title="Expand topics"
                            >
                                {expandingNodeId === node.id ? (
                                    <div className="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                                ) : (
                                    <svg className="w-3 h-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={3} d="M12 4v16m8-8H4" /></svg>
                                )}
                            </button>
                            <button 
                                onClick={(e) => handleInfo(e, node.label, node.id, node.x, node.y)}
                                disabled={!!describingNodeId}
                                className="w-5 h-5 bg-gray-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-500 shadow-md text-white"
                                title="Get Definition"
                            >
                                {describingNodeId === node.id ? (
                                    <div className="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                                ) : (
                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold serif">i</span>
                                )}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
                {activeDescription && (
                    <div 
                        className="absolute bg-app-card border border-app-border p-4 rounded-lg shadow-2xl w-64 text-sm text-app-text z-50 animate-fade-in"
                        style={{ left: activeDescription.x, top: activeDescription.y }}
                    >
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                             <h4 className="font-bold text-blue-400">Description</h4>
                             <button onClick={() => setActiveDescription(null)} className="text-app-dim hover:text-app-text">✕</button>
                        </div>
                        <p className="leading-relaxed text-xs">{activeDescription.text}</p>
                    </div>
                )}
             </div>
         )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MindMapViewer;

interface OfficeToolsProps {
  onBack: () => void;
  voiceSettings: VoiceSettings;
  onUpdateVoiceSettings: (settings: VoiceSettings) => void;
  onRunTool: (toolId: string, payload?: any) => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
  hasActiveSession: boolean;
  session?: Session | null;
  sessions?: Session[];
  previewCode: string | null;
  onClosePreview: () => void;
  generatedAudio: string | null;
  onSaveAudio: (audioData: string, filename: string) => void;
  onLoadAudio?: (item: MediaItem) => void;
  onRemoveMediaItem?: (id: string) => void;
  onRenameMediaItem?: (id: string, name: string) => void;
  onRegenerate?: (newScript: string) => void;
  prompts: PromptTemplate[];
  onAddPrompt: (title: string, content: string) => void;
  onDeletePrompt: (id: string) => void;
  castLibrary: CastMember[];
  onAddCastMember: (member: Omit<CastMember, 'id'>) => void;
  onUpdateCastMember: (id: string, updates: Partial<CastMember>) => void;
  onDeleteCastMember: (id: string) => void;
  isCastLibraryOpen: boolean;
  setIsCastLibraryOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
      onOpenMIPrOMPT?: () => void;
  miprompts?: any[];

        const sysPrompt = `You are an expert Data Analyst and spreadsheet model builder.
Analyze the request and build a structured spreadsheet (columns and rows) containing realistic and useful data.
User Instructions: ${sheetCustomPrompt || `Generate a spreadsheet using the ${sheetTemplate} template.`}
Spreadsheet Name: ${sheetName}
Number of Rows to generate: ${sheetRows}

You MUST return ONLY a valid raw JSON object matching the following TypeScript schema. Do NOT wrap it in markdown code blocks like \`\`\`json, do NOT include any other text or explanation:
{
  "sheetName": "Descriptive Spreadsheet Name",
  "columns": ["Col1", "Col2", "Col3", ...],
  "rows": [

    ["cell2a", "cell2b", "cell2c", ...],
    ...
  ]
}`;

        if (codeBlockMatch) {
            cleanText = codeBlockMatch[1].trim();
        }
        
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cleanText);

            setSpreadsheetResult({
              sheetName: parsed.sheetName || sheetName,
              columns: parsed.columns,
              rows: parsed.rows
            });
            setIsGeneratingSheet(false);
            return;
          }
        } catch (jsonErr) {
          console.warn("JSON parsing of AI output failed, falling back to structured list parser", jsonErr);
        }
      }

      // Offline fallback / Standard Template Generation
      const template = SHEET_TEMPLATES[sheetTemplate as keyof typeof SHEET_TEMPLATES] || SHEET_TEMPLATES.budget;

      const rows = [];

        sheetName: sheetName || template.name,
        columns: cols,
        rows: rows

      console.error("Spreadsheet generation failed", err);

      const template = SHEET_TEMPLATES[sheetTemplate as keyof typeof SHEET_TEMPLATES] || SHEET_TEMPLATES.budget;
      const cols = template.columns;
      const rows = [];

        sheetName: sheetName || template.name,

        rows: rows

    const escapeCsv = (val: any) => {
      const s = String(val);
      if (s.includes(',') || s.includes('"') || s.includes('\n')) {
        return '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
      }
      return s;

      csv += row.map(escapeCsv).join(',') + '\n';
    });

    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const filename = (name || 'spreadsheet').trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '-').toLowerCase() + '.csv';
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();

    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
